body:
The facts, plain as I can tell them.
No ask at the bottom of this one.
| | | Peter,
---
I don't talk about this part much, and I hope you don't mind me doing it here.
---
[TWENTY DAYS’ NOTICE](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=8ba4413e80d24ca7aa28e05f52f7b46f&_e=J6mqsvM9iRwGwGgMW-P1ksIiNhjF5hl6uavKYKFvRUKLdPJkcmPyJuLiZCBbONmD-hNEsesEAc1VnJkL2co6do-dE1CA3UmN9fOC7wRluS4T9DM1Ua2waFhYASDO0zeqP29RQERiq0PtR0GRkMOkUXc1YduS0JkyT16nNrc3DRomvJhUVzgEGzEETHL2p2VLQhLmYY43-QiTBsjdTskg90Wpu9rxy8x-n2NtaEmvFrMrUWx4qAg9lFGsQKQg_2CiAAwaOhnKqsUmfHTkuNDWcddqJZ7NDswpUK9hfqexBcp8Q5p2g_6ZENpe_Kh6oojNXMNJwBpNnHMAms8jwA4AYu0SSlkbFospfhqsfpWr0T8itHyE_CS7t6EvjdD5APTmD3bDub4ifEwSAA46sLaCrBNfPSUTa75PzzPQ51MBO7PTzMNUZghgOTa2erBTgmJy-8A74InSFBmw5XKjWwLOVYL29dBio_JPEcI6v0JmWP0%3D)
---
That's how long there was between the phone call and the plane.
---
Nine months in Iraq, as the Enabling Officer for a Military Advisory Group. My job was movingsecurity assistance -- more than **$450 million** of it -- to the partner forces fighting ISIS, and flying out to advise their generals face to face.
---
I was awarded the Bronze Star for it.
---
I want to be careful how I say this next part. I didn't do anything the people beside me weren't doing. I did my job, they did theirs, and some of them did a great deal more than I did.
---
**That 's the whole story. No embellishment.**
---
My oath still stands, by the way. Not to a president, not to a party -- to the Constitution. That one doesn't have an expiration date, and it's most of the reason I'm doing this instead of taking a comfortable job somewhere.
---
My grandfather built cars at the GM plant in Warren for thirty-three years. My dad has worn a badge in Oakland County for thirty-eight. Nobody in my family ever asked what the country could do for them -- they asked where they were needed.
---
I'm asking the same question now, and the answer is Michigan's 10th District.
---
**[If you’d like to help, here’s where.](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=8ba4413e80d24ca7aa28e05f52f7b46f&_e=J6mqsvM9iRwGwGgMW-P1ksIiNhjF5hl6uavKYKFvRUKLdPJkcmPyJuLiZCBbONmD-hNEsesEAc1VnJkL2co6do-dE1CA3UmN9fOC7wRluS4T9DM1Ua2waFhYASDO0zeqkuAt0ocI0vQa2VB_Vv1RYaf4ObVp1GjdMpZQs9xs2oPhmhDFdyaeSWB_jX2RzkXh3jdaFoQ-ibBLqHEtK82Bd0wuT-6bRr_jpGKaDKMo9aAqZc3b0vFiy9G822NWMmpuwMh0p2x6jGM-rlbvhg8iVnaahQ9b42qJDC8DNBBJjX5doIiRGme3TzQsDB_58OKwmQTMcEHgqiknyoJFg51mGqteALQ-dJOr525f_o-40Ss9OfTbAZwZJ4PScfohOPie9XvNC9pG6y-tcEYYYlsHiYnfnyiWvSNi1w56d7GiDNTfszOrt6GaR9PyV93zH938syPVWJ8bDTLFfk8mFpUnmQbkIxjOUuBJHs-FfsapXMw%3D)**
---
And if you can't right now, I'd be grateful for your prayers instead. I'm not saying that because it reads well in an email. I mean it.
---
Thank you for letting me tell you that.
---
Duty First,
---
Captain Mike Bouchard

body:

The fight over New Mexico's doctor shortage is on your ballot.
Rep. Nicole Chavez helped pass the malpractice reform doctors fought for. Now one of the lawyers who fought it hardest wants her seat.
[Plus, should New Mexico legislators get paid?](https://us.list-manage.com/Vo6IypYNJlY?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) And imagine getting fired for something you said when you were 15 years old!

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/PQVzBpKdf0L?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🩺 **WHY NEW MEXICO DOCTORS ARE LEAVING — AND THE LAWYER WHO WANTS NICOLE'S SEAT
**
Mark was just told it’d take 18 months to see a dermatologist! One local provider's malpractice insurance jumped from $4,000 to $14,000 a month. Guess which services they had to drop.
Then Rep. Nicole Chavez opponent mailed out a flyer about how hard it is to see a doctor. Wait until you hear who her law firm sues.
Nicole takes us inside the fight that got this reform passed, and explains why this one House seat matters to every patient in New Mexico.

🏛️ **SHOULD WE PAY LAWMAKERS $67,800 A YEAR? IT'S ON YOUR BALLOT**
Amendment 4 would give New Mexico legislators a salary for the first time.
Krysty says yes. Nicole, a sitting lawmaker, says no. Wait until you hear what she wants passed first.

When I first ran for Senate six years ago, the pundits and pollsters counted me out.
Many said unseating an entrenched GOP incumbent in Georgia couldn't be done.
Republicans spent $269 million to defeat me.
_But we won._
We won because you believed -- not just in me, but in the idea that Georgia could lead, and that our Republic is worth defending.
And not only did we win a Senate seat, but we won the Senate majority for Democrats.
Now, this Georgia Senate seat and the Senate majority are up for grabs again. These midterm elections will be pivotal to the future of our Republic.
**[Can I count on your support again? If you 're ready to win, hold Trump accountable, and send me back to the U.S. Senate, chip in to my reelection campaign today.](https://substack.com/redirect/97273ce5-fc82-4011-80ff-506775e11854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The final weeks of this race won't be easy.
This is battleground Georgia we're talking about.
This Senate race is going to be a fight to the finish, right down to the wire.
Because Trump and MAGA know that if they defeat me, we can wave goodbye to any chance of taking back the Senate.
_I am their #1 target for defeat._
I don't love asking for money. I don't think anyone does. But the reality is I can't win without you. So I wouldn't be asking again if it didn't make a huge difference for my chances this November.
**[Please, donate what you can to my reelection campaign today. In a race this close, every single donation makes a real impact on our ability to organize and WIN.](https://substack.com/redirect/97273ce5-fc82-4011-80ff-506775e11854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ CONTRIBUTE](https://substack.com/redirect/97273ce5-fc82-4011-80ff-506775e11854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
Jon

name: Abdul
subject: I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same question
disclaimer_text: paid for by people
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7 ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7 ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

I know you hear from a lot of campaigns this time of year, so before I
share something with you, I want to tell you up front why I'm writing.

There are just over 4 weeks left until Election Day. Mike Rogers has MAGA
Republicans in his corner, and they’ve committed over $70 million to flip
this seat. I don't take corporate PAC money. That means every ad we run
and every door we knock between now and November 3 is paid for by people
like you.

I recently wrote a column for the Lansing City Pulse about why I'm
running. I want to share it with you, because it's the clearest answer I
can give you about what your support is for.

But first, I have to ask: [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261005-4-ak.rPcnqF&amount=10&refcode=em20261005-3425&t=1004&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7 ]can you chip in $10 or any
amount to fuel our work? We’re counting on your support to spread the word
about what our campaign is fighting for.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261005-4-ak.rPcnqF&amount=10&refcode=em20261005-3425&t=1005&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7 ]Donate $10 ››

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I’m running because our kids are the whole point.

At a recent town hall in Grand Rapids, a young boy asked me a question:
"What was the driving factor for you to run for Senator?"

I didn't have to think twice. My answer was as simple as it was automatic:
"You."

As a father, my "why" in this race has always been clear. Our kids are the
whole point. In every child, I see my own children.

[ Abdul ]Abdul playing with his two daughters

My brilliant daughters, Emmalee and Serene, are eight and three. I'm
running for Senate because I want them to grow up in a world where they
and all the children they're growing up with have a shot at the future
they deserve.

But right now, our politics are keeping that out of reach. For far too
long, billionaires and corporations have rigged the system against us all.
Special interests buy and sell politicians while everyday Michiganders
strain under record-breaking costs and stagnating wages. Utilities,
insurance premiums, mortgages, gas and groceries — none of them are
affordable alone. Together, they're pushing us to the brink.

I'm running for Senate because in the richest, most powerful country in
the world, it shouldn't be this hard to simply get by. That's why I've
never taken a dime of corporate money and never will. And on day one as
Michigan's next Senator, I will champion legislation to overturn the
catastrophic Citizens United ruling to get corporate money out of our
politics — so that we can finally build the world our children deserve.

I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same
question. We may never know, because he doesn't do town halls where such
questions are often asked. Considering the consequences of the full scope
of his career, his honest answer would likely be the exact opposite: "To
make more money."

We've seen what happens when Mike Rogers gets a taste of power. We've
suffered through it before.

Rogers spent twenty years in the state Senate and then in Congress abusing
his office to enrich himself at the expense of Michiganders.

He took money from Big Oil — then voted to keep gas prices high.

He took money from Wall Street — then voted for higher credit rates.

He took money from Big Pharma — then voted to gut Medicaid and raise
prescription drug costs.

And upon leaving Congress, he spun through the revolving door to rake in
millions by advising the very corporations he was supposed to regulate in
office.

Mike Rogers has never met a billionaire or a corporation he wouldn't
eagerly sell us out to. We know this to be true: life gets harder for
Michiganders when Mike Rogers is in charge. Because, like his puppet
master Trump, Rogers represents the worst in our politics.

As I've crisscrossed the state over the past year, I've had a chance to
speak with voters of all backgrounds. We've held over 600 events in each
corner of Michigan, and everywhere I go, I hear the same concerns. Trump
is running wild in Washington without any checks or balances, and it has
led us into a disastrous trade war with Canada as well as an immoral
regime change in Iran. Mike Rogers has only cheered Trump's extreme
policies, and, if elected, he'd rubber-stamp them without a second
thought.

Folks can't afford their groceries. Gas is too expensive. Young people
worry they'll never be able to hold a job or own a home, and healthcare
access continues to be stripped away.

This November, we can do something about that.

We can get money out of politics. We can put money in your pocket. And we
can deliver Medicare for All.

This election is a referendum on politics as usual.

We have a choice between a government that serves Michigan or a government
that serves Donald Trump and the corporations from which he's enriching
himself.

Michiganders, the choice is yours. Our children are counting on us.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter, that's
the column. Here's the part I didn't have room to say in the paper.

I can't keep that promise to Emmalee and Serene, or to that kid in Grand
Rapids, all on my own. Mike Rogers is banking on his corporate backers to
carry him into the Senate. I'm counting on you.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261005-4-ak.rPcnqF&amount=10&refcode=em20261005-3425&t=1006&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7 ]So please, contribute $10 or any amount today so that we
can keep putting Mike Rogers's record in front of Michigan voters — on the
air, at the doors, and at every town hall he won't show up to — through
Election Day.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261005-4-ak.rPcnqF&amount=10&refcode=em20261005-3425&t=1025&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7 ]Donate $10 ››

Thank you so much,

Abdul

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Emails like this help us stay connected with grassroots supporters like you, so thank you for taking the time to read this message. To contribute via check, please address it to Abdul for U.S. Senate, PO Box 126, St. Clair Shores, MI 48080.

Receive Fewer Emails: https://act.abdulformichigan.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=1026&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7
Update Your Information: https://act.abdulformichigan.com/signup/update-your-information
Unsubscribe: https://act.abdulformichigan.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1027&akid=3431%2E251025%2E9PwqR7

Email us: info@abdulformichigan.com
Volunteer: https://go.abdulforsenate.com/

I have a simple question: Why is the President banning imports from one of our closest allies? _And why is he calling them “one of the worst countries in the world”?_ He’s talking about Canada – one of America's largest trading partners, and Minnesota’s biggest trading partner of all. Last week, the Trump administration announced they were banning nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports, from alcoholic beverages and dairy products to motorcycles. Our state’s small businesses, farmers, and working families depend on that relationship, and Trump is torching it for no discernible reason. He’s raising prices for Minnesotans at a time when grocery bills are already higher than ever, and these bans will only make them worse. And the most important question of all: what are Republicans in Congress – who currently control all branches of the federal government – doing about all this? Absolutely nothing. **We need more leaders in Washington who understand that our relationships with our allies matter – and that reckless decisions like this have real consequences for real people. That’s why it’s so critical that we flip the House in November. **

clean_body: | | | | = I have a simple question: Why is the President banning imports from one of our closest allies? And why is he calling them “one of the worst countries in the world”? He’s talking about Canada – one of America's largest trading partners, and Minnesota’s biggest trading partner of all. Last week, the Trump administration announced they were banning nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian imports, from alcoholic beverages and dairy products to motorcycles. Our state’s small businesses, farmers, and working families depend on that relationship, and Trump is torching it for no discernible reason. He’s raising prices for Minnesotans at a time when grocery bills are already higher than ever, and these bans will only make them worse. And the most important question of all: what are Republicans in Congress – who currently control all branches of the federal government – doing about all this? Absolutely nothing. We need more leaders in Washington who understand that our relationships with our allies matter – and that reckless decisions like this have real consequences for real people. body:
This is a long but critically important read.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Hi, Peter — it's Gina.
Everywhere I go in Texas, I hear the same thing: people are struggling in ways they've never struggled before. Working people donating plasma before their shift just to cover the bills. Families rationing insulin. Small businesses closing because property taxes have gotten so out of hand.
And everywhere I go, _I hear something else too: that this movement is giving them hope._ We’re closer than we’ve ever been before, but we have a long way to go. People still worry if we can actually win here.
I understand that skepticism. Democrats have been saying Texas is turning for years. **But something is different now, and I need you to see the numbers.**
My campaign manager Amy put together a memo on exactly where this race stands. Three independent polls now show us ahead. Abbott's own strategist is admitting it will be close. Conservatives across Texas are crossing over — on schools, on data centers, on the simple question of whether this state belongs to the people or to Greg Abbott's billionaire donors.
**[Read the memo. Then, if you believe what I believe — that we can actually win this — I'm asking you to pitch in whatever you can.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_1_memo.iwpZZK&refcode=em20261005-2336&t=1&akid=2336%2E299639%2EkYBirD)**
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_1_memo.iwpZZK&refcode=em20261005-2336&t=2&akid=2336%2E299639%2EkYBirD)
=============================================================
**OCTOBER 2026 CAMPAIGN MEMO ON TX-GOV**
**FROM:** Amy Friedman, Campaign Manager, Gina for Texas
**TO:** Interested Parties
Let me tell you where this race actually stands — because what's happening in Texas right now is something I don't think the national establishment fully understands yet.

**Gina Hinojosa is leading Greg Abbott in three of the most recent polls. That’s never happened before.**
This race is closer than ever but some people still don’t believe we can win — that’s exactly why I'm writing this memo. And it's exactly why this race could slip away if we don't act.
Here's the polling picture. This race has moved steadily and dramatically in Gina's direction since the spring:
* Texas Politics Project (April 2026): Abbott +5
* TPOR (July 2026): Abbott +3, inside the margin of error
* N+ Univision (September 9): Tied 47–47, with Gina leading Latino voters by 12
* ReconMR/Siena (September 17): **Gina leads 49–45** — independents breaking for Gina 65–27
* NPR/Marist (September 23): **Gina leads 49–46** , winning independents 52–39, pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans
* NYT/Siena (October 4): **Gina leads 49–46** , winning independents 55–39, and leading among Latino voters by 31 points

Both RealClearPolitics and Nate Silver's Silver Bulletin have the polling average under 2 points. This is a toss-up.
**Abbott is outspending us 10 to 1 — and he still isn’t getting the result he wants.**
Between July 30 and September 8 alone, Abbott outspent Gina $28 million to $2 million on advertising. Over the full race, he's spent $47 million to our $5 million. Despite that, Gina leads in three of the most recent polls. Abbott's favorability has gone deeply negative — 45% favorable, 53% unfavorable — and his job approval has flipped the same way. He's even polling 13% unfavorable among his own Republicans.
Abbott is a damaged incumbent with a nine-figure war chest. The only thing keeping this race from breaking open is the spending gap.
But here’s the truth: The more money Abbott spends lying about Gina’s record, the more vulnerable we are. _We have to raise more money to reach the voters who haven’t heard from us yet._
**Something real is happening on the ground — and Republicans know it.**
Lifelong conservative voters are publicly breaking with Abbott over two issues.
On education: conservative moms who backed Abbott before are now appearing at Gina's events, frustrated by a decade of voucher schemes and defunded public schools. Gina is running an ad featuring a self-described MAGA conservative who protested on January 6 — and is now voting for Gina because of schools.
On data centers: rural Republican protest groups — including one in Lubbock led by Republicans — are furious about unregulated expansion driving up electricity bills. Abbott championed data centers for years, took millions from their developers, and is now scrambling to reverse course. Gina called for a moratorium from day one.
As Gina put it to The Nation: The data-center issue is the latest example of a governor doing the bidding of moneyed interests and not the people of Texas. And it is angering MAGA Republicans — not country-club Republicans, not Chamber of Commerce Republicans. There is an opportunity for alliances to be forged when we are pursuing a populist agenda.
**Even Abbott's own team is admitting this race is close.**
Abbott's longtime political strategist was asked about the tightening polls. His response: "Is it going to be close on Election Day? Yes." That’s Abbott's own guy publicly conceding this goes to the wire. And when pressed on his best argument against Gina? He went to culture wars and lies on income tax votes — not data centers, not schools, not the affordability crisis Abbott has presided over for twelve years. When culture wars are the best attack you can come up with, you're losing ground.
**The coalition winning this race doesn't look like past Texas Democratic coalitions.**
Gina leads independents by 38 points in the Siena poll. She's winning women 57–40%, voters under 45 by 60–33%, and Gen Z 71–19%. She's pulling 9% of self-identified Republicans. In TX-15 — a district Trump carried 58–41 — a House Majority PAC poll shows Gina leading 52–47.
This is a cross-partisan, cross-regional majority being built in real time. _Gina is earning support from Texans who have never voted for a Democrat before in their lives._
**When Texas Democrats run strong, the whole map shifts.**
In 2018, when Beto lost the Senate race by just 2.6 points, that wave energy flipped 12 State House seats, 2 State Senate seats, and 2 congressional seats. And the stakes this cycle go even further: if Abbott wins another term, Republicans will redraw the congressional map again. Combined with seats Texas gains after the next Census, that could put nine or ten congressional seats permanently out of Democratic reach — one-party control of Congress, likely for a generation. A governor who vetoes rigged maps changes all of that. As Gina said: _"We flip Texas, and it's over."_
**The bottom line.**
Three polls show Gina leading. One has us tied. Abbott is underwater on favorability and approval. Conservatives are crossing over to support our campaign. The polling average is under 2 points. Abbott's own strategist admits this race will be close.
_This race is winnable._ But Abbott is going to spend over $106 million to try to buy his lead back in the final few weeks of this race.
Gina has raised a fraction of Abbott’s war chest. The only thing that closes the spending gap is donors who understand what's actually happening in Texas right now — and decide this race is worth their investment.
We can win this. But only if people show up.
=============================================================
Peter, I'll leave you with this.
Greg Abbott has been in statewide office for 30 years. He has 98 percent name recognition. He has raised over $106 million to run this campaign. And he still can’t grab onto an insurmountable lead in this race.
Texans know his record. They know who he works for. And they're ready for something different.
The only question is whether we have what it takes to close this out — whether the people who believe Texas can change are willing to put real resources behind it in these final weeks.
We have people working in every corner of this state who are hungry for this. Abbott's own team is bracing for a close race. Three polls have us ahead.
We can win this. But not without you.
**[Will you rush a donation to our campaign right now?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_1_memo.iwpZZK&refcode=em20261005-2336&t=3&akid=2336%2E299639%2EkYBirD)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_1_memo.AijdNu&amount=5&refcode=em20261005-2336&t=4&akid=2336%2E299639%2EkYBirD)
Thank you for believing in what we're building together.
— Gina Hinojosa
Democratic Nominee for Governor of Texas

[ Donate » ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_footer?refcode=em20261005-4&t=5&refcode2=2336_299639_kYBirD&akid=2336%2E299639%2EkYBirD)
[ Donate Weekly » ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_footer?refcode=em20261005-4&recurring=1&t=6&refcode2=2336_299639_kYBirD&akid=2336%2E299639%2EkYBirD)

Austin, TX 78703

**Minnesota 's 2026 General Election will introduce a significant change in voting procedures--one that has arrived with surprisingly little public attention.** For the first time statewide, Minnesota will use a statutory **Early Voting** process that is different from the traditional absentee-voting system Minnesotans have used for decades. 1
As described on the Minnesota Secretary of State's [website](https://substack.com/redirect/306cef9f-fbac-43c4-aa49-4bb0a70f884d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
@Bendasense Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5kYXNlbnNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.xZHIYwRNOmYB2CPv4wgL7uQHymsiLtMSTYUdeQnUm4c?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=218854949)
> **Early Voting**
> "Early Voting" will be available for the first time in 2026. This is more like voting in a polling place on Election Day and starts 18 days before the election. For all statewide elections, every county will have at least one location where early voting is offered.
> * You will complete a short certificate
> * You will receive a ballot and vote it there
> * After completing the ballot, you will insert it in a ballot counter
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/15970e8b-900b-4434-8beb-b4ba0d653d39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This distinction matters because, during the final 18 days before Election Day - starting October 16, 2026 - ballots cast at participating 2 Early Voting locations will no longer be placed into individual absentee-ballot envelopes for later review by an absentee ballot board. Instead, after completing the required procedures, the voter will place the ballot **directly into the ballot counter.**
# Two Different Systems Before Election Day
For voting prior to the November 3, 2026 General Election, Minnesota will effectively operate two different systems for voting before Election Day.
**September 18 through October 15 - Traditional Absentee Voting**
During the traditional absentee-voting period, a voter completes an absentee ballot and places it into the required envelope system. The voter's eligibility and accompanying documentation are subsequently reviewed through the absentee ballot-board process before the ballot is accepted and ultimately prepared for counting.
**October 16 through November 2 - Early Voting**
Beginning 18 days before the election, Minnesota's new Early Voting procedures become available at participating locations.
Under **Minn. Stat. §§ 203B.081, subd. 1a, and 203B.30**, an eligible voter appearing at an Early Voting location may vote in person and, after completing the statutory requirements, deposit the ballot directly into a ballot counter. The ballot is therefore separated from the voter without first passing through the traditional individual absentee-envelope and ballot-board review process.
Election Day follows on **November 3, 2026**.
### Safeguards You Should Be Aware Of: Daily Reconciliation and Party-Balanced Election Judges
With this new process come new procedures and safeguards. Two deserve particular public attention:
**1\. Daily reconciliation of ballots and voter certificates; and**
**2\. Election judges appointed and staffed in accordance with Minnesota 's party-balance requirements.**
Voters, election judges, political parties, and interested citizens can **watch, ask questions, and verify that these requirements are being followed.**
#### **Reconcile Ballots**
One of the most important safeguards in Minnesota's new Early Voting process occurs at the **end of each day**. The Legislature amended **Minn. Stat. § 203B.30, subd. 3**, in 2026. The statute requires early-voting officials each day to remove and secure the ballots, document the date, voting location and number of ballots cast, and reconcile the ballots against the voter certificates completed that day.
Those procedures matter. Section 204C.20 requires election judges to determine the proper number of ballots by reference to signed voter certificates or the election register and provides procedures for addressing **excess ballots** when the numbers do not match. This is particularly important under the new Early Voting system because once a ballot has been deposited into the ballot counter and ballot box, it can no longer be individually associated with the voter who cast it.
That makes **daily reconciliation something worth watching and verifying.**
If you are in a **" trust but verify"** mood, ask to see copies of the completed daily reconciliation records. The point is not to assume that something has gone wrong. The point is to verify that an important safeguard required by Minnesota law is actually being performed and documented.
When Minnesota moves from an individual envelope-based system to ballots being deposited directly into a ballot counter, **the daily reconciliation becomes an important means of verifying that the numbers match.**
#### **Party Balance Election Judges**
There is a second safeguard Minnesotans should know about before Early Voting begins: **election judges.** This issue was recently addressed directly by the Minnesota Supreme Court.
In **Minnesota Voters Alliance, et al. v. City of Minneapolis, No. A26-0997** , the Minnesota Voters Alliance and Dianne Napper brought an election petition challenging Minneapolis's planned staffing of Early Voting locations. The Supreme Court [described](https://substack.com/redirect/4bf96262-e3b9-4a12-814d-5eeeed5ecc9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the dispute as whether election judges are required under Minnesota's new Early Voting statute and notes that the petition sought party-balanced election judges during the 18-day Early Voting period.
The Minnesota Supreme Court ultimately determined that **election judges are required at Early Voting polling places.** That ruling matters as it confirms that early voting is not simply a process in which administrative personnel receive ballots. Election judges perform statutory election functions, including administering voter challenges, participating in voter-registration procedures, assisting voters as authorized by law, _**monitoring the operation of the ballot counter**_ , and carrying out other safeguards and procedures established by Minnesota election law.
**Minn. Stat. § 204B.21 **provides that election judges are appointed by the appropriate municipal governing body or county board and expressly provides that **at least two election judges in each precinct must be affiliated with different major political parties.** [Minn. Stat. § 204B.21](https://substack.com/redirect/6617f925-b1ce-49e0-b8f7-2a487b2ec213?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This Supreme Court ruling therefore provides another concrete safeguard that voters and interested citizens can **watch and verify during this new Early Voting Process.**
**If you have concerns that your local voting location is not following this requirement, the Minnesota Voters Alliance has a[submission form](https://substack.com/redirect/04d98ca4-b04c-46e1-bfc0-f9c719ccb706?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for you to document your concerns and request follow-up.**
# Know the Process. Watch the Process. Verify the Safeguards.
Minnesota's new Early Voting law represents a significant procedural change to voting before Election Day. The traditional system relies heavily upon an individual envelope process followed by absentee ballot-board review. The new Early Voting system places greater importance on procedures performed **at the voting location before the ballot enters the ballot counter** , the election judges staffing that location, and the reconciliation performed after voting concludes each day.
The Minnesota Supreme Court has confirmed that election judges have a role at Early Voting polling places. And the Legislature has required daily reconciliation of the ballots cast through the new system.
Ask the questions.
Watch the process.
And, when necessary, **verify.**
1
As [reported by](https://substack.com/redirect/62ed3f15-848b-46d7-a2e7-92ad7174e98c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Minnesota Public Radio, New this year, voters can participate in what the state calls "early voting" -- though it starts later than absentee voting -- up to 18 days before the election. That's when you go to a polling location, mark your ballot and then place your completed ballot directly into a tabulator machine.
2
The Secretary of State has identified polling locations and designated a few precincts that will only offer envelope voting - this is a summary of these locations. If your precinct is not on this list assume that it is an early in-person voting location.

A LETTER FROM THE DESK OF CONGRESSMAN JIMMY PATRONIS

Fellow Republican,
I know you get flooded with political emails and texts, especially this close to Election Day.
That's why I try not to waste your time.
But what I'm seeing right now in Florida is serious enough that I decided I needed to write to you personally.
I've rewritten this letter several times trying to figure out the right way to say it.
Eventually, I decided to forget the polished Washington talking points and tell you exactly what's on my mind.
I'm a fourth-generation Floridian. I was born here. I raised my family here. I've spent years fighting for the people of this state.
And Florida is becoming one of the major battlegrounds in the fight for the House.
Just look at the latest House race ratings:
**FLORIDA RACES ARE SITTING IN THE TOSS-UP AND LEAN COLUMNS.**
* **FL-14: TOSS UP**
* **FL-22: TOSS UP**
* **FL-25: TOSS UP**
* **FL-13 and FL-27: LEAN REPUBLICAN**

These seats should be **SOLID REPUBLICAN!**
This fight is happening right here in our backyard.
And that's why I'm writing to **YOU**.
Republicans cannot afford to look at Florida and assume somebody else has this handled.
We need voters across our state engaged, informed, and prepared to cast their ballots come November.
Because control of the House is being fought over district by district -- and several of those fights are happening right here in Florida.
| | [HELP REPUBLICANS WIN FLORIDA >>](https://links.stayinformednow.net/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=6e3e804ea4e649a1a83030249552524f&_e=Rt6DsxfUGbiglwrtqgI2XofDf74tk5q5G9bURsWBI46twPOOjR7L7D-sLN_aTCC0THj0Mr2r71yJFSCNa-OUmnJdbF31S5PGAq-Z8AU-n8NR04LFVcaQk1q3e4isbdh_jHatk9EdWxm5WZnzjFYAfsS15OMo2cQO-_zq6yLcROs6YGmkfzqT3ucEwzSGfCzRg-hyIiYkgvQlsHhSImJ1JD_3eAglfpXzYqny62wrzWdcOX_fKDDHv4Nlhr5SKu_iINfEqJf3v5LlIFRqtx-3bxq6ubHs1KLxtmgUATd4W-52yVBqxCef7tLRBxJdXcfR9OV9aIkf55CideAPhYjlgk1v3xDVq0mET0CrhCojzYR5tM1_3p-KAK_-kza6TKcbpRaG1vi6U-x6Z_v5ea3e5A4MNcSY2JP8WLQGR6SrHQShoFEDm7gmtaTndOPRQHP0AQHOsnbD7DmCstfA0gj45iw_hb_P04Qvmrit3kquJRHD0uA9cp5Rnj__y-5xNL7KnyMcULaKyvTIbMM9sF-jpPLUA4_gqMP1EX68msmzgM-maARBkmiRmQN32ziL-L2FBr42Mxr0AnQ3oTVZW78C9ayJhkjNI9L9XWpnlOMhlu-Stf8iLhotrOaSttGPpnJsnUvHt5UUaMYclYnK3J9sA4rDesXiZ2u3pUTGStwcpd0%3D)
---
If Republicans don't turn out and we **LOSE** the midterms, the consequences for our country will be downright catastrophic.
Far Left Democrats will seize power in the people's House, and they'll immediately move forward with **IMPEACHMENT**.
They'll go after every MAGA patriot in Congress (me included).
That's why we need every conservative reading this letter to help fuel our efforts to win over undecided voters across Florida.
Campaign war chests are being drained every single day on TV ads, digital outreach, mail, and voter turnout operations.
And with multiple Florida races sitting in the TOSS-UP and LEAN columns, we cannot afford to let Democrats dominate the airwaves in the final stretch.
It's going to come down to grassroots, small-dollar donations from patriots like you to help us reach the voters we need before Election Day.
I'm not asking you to write some enormous check.
I'm asking you to chip in $5, $10, $25 -- whatever you can afford -- to help Republicans reach undecided voters, turn out our supporters, and fight for these critical Florida seats.

Friend: There are _only a few hours_ left until my reporting deadline at midnight — **and I still need to raise another $6,108 to reach this critical goal.** ****

_**[Will you please rush a gift right now to help power my campaign to become Governor of New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17370?refcode=jtk1505-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12974%2E400544%2EdPbOGd)**_
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17370?refcode=jtk1505-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12974%2E400544%2EdPbOGd)
---
Right now, all eyes are on our gubernatorial race in New Mexico, as the GOP spends millions to flip this seat. And that's because they know, just as well as we do, that New Mexico’s governorship tends to flip parties every eight years **— and they’re coming for this seat right on schedule.**
We cannot back down without a fierce fight, friend — early voting starts TOMORROW!
**I'm in this race to lower costs, invest in education, and make healthcare more accessible and affordable. I am also ready to be a brick wall to Donald Trump and his administration when they want to sow violence and fear and drag an extremist agenda to our state. But I can't win in November and deliver on these promises without your support.**
**_[Please, will you chip in whatever you can spare before tonight's midnight deadline so we can win this race and deliver progress for New Mexico's working families?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17370?refcode=jtk1505-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12974%2E400544%2EdPbOGd)_**

Thank you for your support, friend.

Be fierce,
Deb

body:

https://jonnyutah4congress.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID

** Jonny’s Team Needs YOU 🫵
------------------------------------------------------------

Hi Friend,

http://jonnylarsen.com/debatenight2026This?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID Thursday, October 8, Jonny will debate current CD-03 Republican Representative Mike Kennedy at Snow College in Ephraim. We’re looking forward to addressing Rep. Kennedy’s destructive actions towards our precious public lands, his anti-vaccine beliefs, and his 100% MAGA voting record. Mark your calendar for October 8 for our 4th Congressional district debate hosted by the Utah Debate Commission! (https://utahdebatecommission.org/schedule/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) You can watch on TV or stream it online beginning at 6 pm.

Host a debate watch party and play Debate Bingo with our custom Bingo cards! (http://jonnylarsen.com/debatenight2026?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) Gather your friends and neighbors and watch the debate live in your living room, community center, or local restaurant! Take a photo during the debate and tag us (@jonnyutah4congress (https://www.instagram.com/jonnyutah4congress?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) ) on Instagram and Facebook!

How many days until...
https://jonnylarsen.com?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID
DONATE (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jonnyutah?refcode=newsletter&refcode2=countdown&utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID)
YARD SIGNS (https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeh6veN3HXzR2B-jKKO2bOFgy4uqPabX0Xr2W3gVYNuirN6yg/viewform?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID)
STORE (https://store.jonnylarsen.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID)

I’m asking for your help right now. Please tell your friends, family, neighbors, and coworkers about our campaign, and if you can, make a financial contribution. More than 1,000 people open and read our emails every week, just a fraction of our entire list. If everyone who reads this gives $100, we can send postcards to 100,000 targeted voters in the district and make a real impact.

Thank you for supporting the campaign!

** Full Survey Results Released
------------------------------------------------------------

Did you receive our summer survey https://jonnyutah4congress.com/sept-2026-survey-resultsin?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID late August? We texted thousands of CD-04 residents and asked about the issues most important to them, how they view Representative Kennedy’s performance in Congress, and how they’re thinking about voting in November. We’ve been releasing snippets of our internal poll every week, and we’re excited to finally share the full report with you.

Check out the full report and pfd here (https://jonnyutah4congress.com/sept-2026-survey-results?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

** Inside Utah Politics - ABC4
------------------------------------------------------------

Inhttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z9b3CEJfPYs&t=697s case you missed Jonny’s interview on Inside Utah Politics (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z9b3CEJfPYs&t=697s&utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) with Lindsay Aerts on ABC4 last week, you can watch it here. This is Jonny’s first major sit-down TV interview. Stay tuned for more TV interviews later this week.

** Upcoming Events 🎡
------------------------------------------------------------

** Come meet me in person
------------------------------------------------------------

Check our Facebook events page (https://www.facebook.com/jonnyutah4congress/events?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) for more events!

Tuesday, October 6, 10:30 am -1:30 pm
* UVU Meet The Candidates - Connect directly with Utah Valley University students, faculty, and community members before ballots are mailed out for the upcoming election. Hosted by the Gary R. Herbert Institute for Public Policy, this tabling event provides congressional, statewide, and Utah County candidates with a dedicated platform to engage with the campus community, discuss critical issues, and hear directly from prospective voters. UVU Hall of Flags (HF), Utah Valley University, 800 West University Parkway, Orem

Wednesday October 7th, 12:30 - 1:30 pm
* Draper Senior Center Candidate Days (https://www.saltlakecounty.gov/aging?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) - 2026 Candidate Days at Salt Lake County Senior Centers allow candidates to engage with older adult constituents, share information about their candidacy, and hear directly from members of the community prior to the November election. 1148 Pioneer Road, Draper

Wednesday, October 7, 5:30 pm - 7:30 pm
* Strong Futures Start Small - Salt Lake County (https://actionnetwork.org/events/strong-futures-start-small-salt-lake-county-se?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Join us for a nonpartisan event focused on the childcare crisis, where parents, early childhood educators, providers, legislators, and candidates gather for an informal meet-and-greet. The focus is on listening, connecting, and hearing directly from the families and providers who are experiencing the challenges of early childhood care every day. Questions? email careforkids@uaeyc.org (mailto:careforkids@uaeyc.org?subject=&body=) Bicentennial Park, 530 E 8680 S, Sandy

Wednesday October 7th, 6:30 - 8 pm - CORRECTED DATE
* Utah Region 6 PTA Meet the Candidates - Nonpartisan candidate forum hosted by Utah Region 6 PTA. Open to all community members (Republicans & Democrats); free admission. Questions? Contact Amanda Snow (801) 361-6863 South Jordan Middle School, 10245 S 2700 W, South Jordan

Thursday October 8, 6 - 7 pm
* DEBATE NIGHT! (http://jonnylarsen.com/debatenight2026?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Get ready for the CD-04 Congressional Debate! Gather with friends, neighbors, and supporters to follow along. Be sure to print out your Bingo cards! Watch on TV or stream online. (http://jonnylarsen.com/debatenight2026?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Tuesday October 13th, 6 - 8 pm
* Utah Region 7 PTA Meet the Candidates - Nonpartisan candidate forum hosted by Utah Region 7 PTA. Open to all community members (Republicans & Democrats); free admission.
Union Middle School, 615 E 8000 S, Sandy

Wednesday October 14th, 12 - 1 pm
* Richfield Area Chamber of Commerce (https://richfieldareachamber.com/blog/monthly-chamber-luncheons?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) - The Richfield Area Chamber of Commerce Monthly Luncheons bring together local business owners, community leaders, and professionals for an engaging afternoon of networking, learning, and collaboration.
Sevier County Fairgrounds 410 E 200 S, Richfield

* Utah Veterans Town Hall and Roundtable (https://www.facebook.com/events/1813849083130435/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) - Hosted by the Utah VFW, this nonpartisan forum will bring veteran candidates and leaders together to discuss issues affecting Utah’s veterans and military families. Miller Free Enterprise Center - SLCC’s Miller Campus, 9690 S 300 W, Sandy

* Riverton Senior Center Candidate Days (https://www.saltlakecounty.gov/aging?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) - 2026 Candidate Days at Salt Lake County Senior Centers allow candidates to engage with older adult constituents, share information about their candidacy, and hear directly from members of the community prior to the November election. 12914 S Redwood Road, Riverton

** Volunteer Opportunities 🤝
------------------------------------------------------------

** Canvass with us
------------------------------------------------------------

Come canvass with us today! We need people to help distribute our door hangers in Utah County and in south Salt Lake County. You'll not only help us, but other candidates like, Lillian Bowels (https://www.lillianbowles.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Benyde Walker (https://www.benydewalker.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Rod Moser (https://www.utahgrit.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Brett Nielsen (https://www.brettforutah.com/?utm_source=Jonny+Larsen+for+Congress&utm_campaign=d24a8cbe61-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2026_09_06_07_12_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_50a203dec4-bcdbe79a1e-746037882&mc_cid=d24a8cbe61&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and many others that need extra hands. When we work together as a team, anything is possible.

Email Alex at fieldops@jonnyutah4congress.com (mailto:fieldops@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=RSVP%20for%209%2F15%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20with%20Jonny&body=) to join the canvass team!

Working for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time.

We need to fill some specialty roles as well as have volunteers to accompany us for events, town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an ALL HANDS ON DECK request!

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Not my style
body:
Being transparent.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1600&source=&t=1&akid=4274%2E124072%2EO3mSYu) | | | |
---
Peter,
I’m not here to plead for a donation, or to tell you the sky will fall if we don’t raise a certain amount of money from this exact email.
I am here, though, to be crystal clear about where we stand in this Senate race. This is a grassroots campaign, you are part of our team and you deserve to know exactly where we are: **At our current fundraising pace, things aren’t where we need them to be.**
We urgently need additional resources to fight back. Even worse, the last FEC deadline of this election is right around the corner. It’s the last chance we have to publicly show the power of this grassroots campaign.
**If we continue to fall behind, we’ll be putting our chances of flipping this seat at serious risk, and with the future of our democracy at stake, we simply cannot let that happen.**
[**_Please, Peter: I don’t expect you to chip in to every email I send, but I do hope you’ll make a donation to this one. Will you give $5 or whatever you can to help us get back on track, win in North Carolina and flip the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1600&amount=5&t=8&akid=4274%2E124072%2EO3mSYu)

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3375%2E259176%2ELZe-2b) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3375%2E259176%2ELZe-2b)_

**We’re incredibly close to flipping the House blue.**

I’m Elaine Luria – a 20-year Navy veteran and former member of Congress from Virginia’s 2nd District. I’ve spent my career serving my country, and I’m running again because the work is far from finished.

**Here’s the thing about VA-02: It’s the ultimate swing seat.** Trump won it by less than half a point in 2024, polls show a dead heat, and the Cook Political Report rates this race a Toss-Up.

When this district flipped blue in 2018, the House flipped with it.

When it flipped red in 2022, so did the House.

**The path to a Democratic House runs straight through Hampton Roads.**

That's why October 14th matters so much. It's my final FEC deadline before Election Day, and my last chance to show reporters, MAGA, and special interest groups that we’re unstoppable.

Time is of the essence. Early voting is already underway in Virginia, and Election Day is 28 days away. What we raise now will fuel our voter turnout efforts in the final stretch. If you’re ready to end MAGA’s reign and take back the House, [will you split a $15 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action right away? subject: ICYMI: Braun Extends Gas Tax Relief, Expands Support for Indiana Farmers
body:
No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-e-fdrdrit-hhlljjcji-n/)
# ICYMI: Governor Braun Continues Historic Major Savings at the Pump for Hoosier Families, Delivers New Relief for Farmers
Indiana** **[Governor Mike Braun](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdrdrit-hhlljjcji-r/) renewed Indiana's statewide energy emergency and extended his suspension of the state's Gasoline Use Tax and Gasoline Excise Tax through November 4, continuing uninterrupted relief for Hoosiers from high gas prices. Governor Braun is also delivering more relief for farmers by suspending the special fuel restrictions for dyed diesel. Farmers will now be able to use dyed diesel for any farm related activities. This is a direct response to concerns raised by the farming community and will help ease that burden. "Affordability is my top priority, and my gas tax suspensions have delivered immediate tax relief and some of the cheapest gas in America for Hoosier families. I'm delivering relief for Hoosier farmers by lifting special fuel restrictions to help ease the burden, and providing relief from high gas prices to keep more money in Hoosiers' pockets and make life more affordable." -- **Governor Mike Braun** The renewal follows continued disruptions to the global oil supply, which have placed continued pressure on fuel prices.The renewed declaration will take effect October 6, following the expiration of the current energy emergency. It will keep both state gas taxes suspended without interruption through November 4 in all 92 counties.Governor Braun first suspended the Gasoline Use Tax in April and expanded the relief in May to include the Gasoline Excise Tax. His continued action to suspend the gas taxes have provided Hoosier families additional breathing room to make ends meet while protecting funding for state and local infrastructure projects. Over 100 years ago, my great-grandfather came here from Greece and opened
our family restaurant that became a beloved local spot. That’s where I
learned how to work hard and show up for my community – lessons I carried
with me into the State House, Congress, and now my run for Senate.

I’m running against John Sununu, the son of a political dynasty family
with deep pockets. He said he’d like to “send me back to bussing tables,”
as if that’s an insult.

John Sununu doesn’t know a thing about hard work.

I’m proud to be running this race the right way – no corporate PACs, just
a grassroots team built by people like you, chipping in what they can,
when they can.

But with just 28 days until the election, recent polls show Sununu is
surging into the lead, and this race has officially shifted to a Toss Up.

I know what it takes to win in a swing state like New Hampshire – and we

Chris

With your help, we shocked the nation and we WON, alongside Rev. Warnock, to secure the Senate majority in 2021.

My team and I are fighting back against these attacks and redoubling our voter protection efforts all across the state. **But we can’t do it alone.**

# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, we just filed our latest campaign finance report with the Texas Ethics Commission, and I wanted you to hear what it shows from me first.
**From July 1 through September 24, our campaign raised $13,244,462.**
That money came from 248,148 contributions from about 136,000 people. 99% of those donations were under $250. The average contribution was about $53.
Think about that for a second. Just in the last few months, more than 136,000 people looked at this race and decided it was worth investing in, most of them chipping in small amounts — $5, $25, $50.
That's the difference between our campaign and Greg Abbott's. Abbott relies on million-dollar checks from billionaire megadonors and corporate special interests. We rely on people like you. _**Our reports show that difference plainly.**_
We've raised just a fraction of Abbott’s resources. But your support has given us what we need to go toe-to-toe with him in a race almost nobody thought we could even compete in. _**And your support is the reason why we've led in three independent polls over the last three weeks.**_
Now, with early voting less than two weeks away, we need to keep that momentum going so we can reach every voter who hasn't heard from us yet.
I’d love for you to join the hundreds of thousands of donors who have already invested in our race. **[Will you make your first contribution today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261005_4_numbers.Sx8rOz&refcode=em20261006-2339&amount=5&t=2&akid=2339%2E299639%2EGKXAj9)**

This is what a people-powered campaign looks like. Let's take Texas back.

Gina

Peter,
There are three things my husband, Tim Burchett, has never lacked: [opinions, determination, and love of country.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MTAwNl9TOC1GTC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNDc1MjAtNDEyNSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjEwMDZfUzgtRkwuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDQ3NTIwLTQxMjUifQ/Vcf-3V61U2u9RkalDngG-A)
I've spent enough years married to him to know that once he gets an idea in his head, there is absolutely no changing it.
Believe me, I've tried.
The funny thing is, that same hardheaded streak is exactly why so many people support him.
When Tim sees something that isn't right, he speaks up. When he thinks taxpayers are getting taken for a ride, he says so.
And when somebody in Washington tells him to sit down, be quiet, and go along with the crowd, that's usually when he gets even louder.
That's one reason I've never worried much about Washington changing him.
[The truth is, the same man I married is the one serving in Congress today.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MTAwNl9TOC1GTC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNDc1MjAtNDEyNSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjEwMDZfUzgtRkwuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDQ3NTIwLTQxMjUifQ/OhbPP4C7cvgWO3phqHfDSg)

[](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MTAwNl9TOC1GTC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNDc1MjAtNDEyNSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjEwMDZfUzgtRkwuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDQ3NTIwLTQxMjUifQ/CN740nTC8vFhA6obyODqdg)
---
He's never cared much about the perks or the titles. While plenty of politicians settle into the Washington lifestyle, Tim still sleeps in his office. He'd rather save taxpayers a few dollars than spend them trying to impress somebody.
With Election Day only a few short weeks away, we know what's coming. The attacks will get louder. The special interests will spend millions. And the Washington crowd would love nothing more than to replace independent voices like Tim with people who know how to keep their heads down and fall in line.
That has never been Tim's strong suit.
He's going to keep fighting for Tennessee, for common sense, and for the values that brought so many of us together in the first place.
[If you'd like to help him stay in that fight, I'd be grateful for your support today.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MTAwNl9TOC1GTC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNDc1MjAtNDEyNSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjEwMDZfUzgtRkwuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDQ3NTIwLTQxMjUifQ/xAvtJNMvrFnkUk1B3e4gAw)

There’s no pathway to a gun safety majority in the U.S. Senate without North Carolina.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&source=&t=1&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp) | | | | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&amount=5&t=8&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)
---
Peter, it’s Gabby. Speaking is still tough for me, but I have something important to say:
There’s no pathway to a gun safety majority in the U.S. Senate without North Carolina.
That’s why I’m proud to endorse Roy Cooper’s bid to flip this critical seat – [**_and why, at the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to join me in supporting his grassroots campaign with a contribution today._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&amount=5&t=9&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)
Fifteen years ago, I was shot while hosting a constituent event in Tucson, Arizona.
Because of the bullet’s damage to the left hemisphere of my brain – the part that processes language – I have aphasia. The words are there; it’s just hard to get them out sometimes.
I can’t stay silent now, though, Peter. Not when we have the opportunity to take back power from politicians on the MAGA right who have dismantled our progress and fought to advance the gun lobby’s priorities over the safety of their constituents.
To seize that power, we have to take back the Senate majority. The only way that happens is if Roy Cooper wins his battleground race in North Carolina.
Gun violence is a nationwide epidemic that requires action on the national level – and with Roy on the ballot, North Carolina is our best chance to flip one of the four red U.S. Senate seats necessary to take back the reins in DC. As Governor, he worked tirelessly to pass measures to save lives from preventable gun violence, and I know he’ll be a champion on this issue in Washington. That’s why the GOP has spent tens of millions to keep him out of Congress.
**Roy urgently needs our help to hold his ground and fight back, Peter, so I’m personally asking:[_Will you please chip in $5 now, or anything, to help a gun safety leader like Roy Cooper win in North Carolina, take back the Senate for Democrats and halt the Trump administration’s attacks on gun safety for good?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&amount=5&t=10&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15913?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&amount=5&t=11&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15913?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&amount=25&t=12&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)

Thank you for being a part of this movement. We can’t do it without you.

Gabby Giffords
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&t=2&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1596&source=&t=3&akid=4277%2E124072%2EAmy5yp)

name: Lisa, Campaign Manager
subject: I don’t want the Gov to know about this
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Hi Derek, it’s
Lisa.

Honestly, I thought this would be one of those rare days I could focus on
one thing, and one thing only: Tomorrow night’s debate.

But I was just checking our latest fundraising data before the next debate
prep — and we’ve run into a serious problem:

Our grassroots donations have absolutely plummeted. We’ve only brought in
about half the amount of money we expected in the last 24 hours.

On most days, I’d relay that message to the Governor immediately. But
frankly, I want him 100% focused on tomorrow’s debate until the moment it
concludes — so I’m really hoping you can help me out.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15289?t=1001&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]If this slowdown lasts until tomorrow, I’ll have to tell the Gov just
hours before he takes the stage. So please: Will you do me (and most
importantly, Governor Shapiro!) a favor and chip in whatever you can to
help us break out of this slump? Every dollar makes a difference in a
state as competitive as Pennsylvania.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15290?t=1002&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]Donate $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15291?t=1003&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]Donate $15 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15292?t=1004&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]Donate $25 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15293?t=1005&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]Donate $50 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15294?t=1006&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]Donate $100 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/15289?t=1007&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C ]Other →

I’ve got a 1:1 meeting with the Governor set for 8AM tomorrow morning —
and I’m really hoping I don’t have to report this fundraising slowdown
just hours before he takes the stage.

Thank you in advance for your help. I’m truly grateful.

Lisa
Campaign Manager

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.
Unsubscribe: https://act.joshshapiro.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1008&akid=544%2E245147%2EDwqU0C

We have accomplished so much together, and we are almost to the finish line of Making America Great Again! But that cannot happen without You. So when my team told me you still haven’t re-pledged this year... I had to check. Is that true? Right now the Democrats smell blood. They’re watching the polls, counting votes, and getting ready to stop our momentum cold. They want this movement derailed before the midterms even hit. They’re already planning the next impeachment. And let’s be clear: the fight is nowhere near over. Our majority is thinner than a sheet of paper. Critical seats are on the line. If they flip even a handful, they’ll have the numbers to come after me again impeachment, investigations, the whole playbook. That’s why I’m asking you directly: **Not next week. That will be too late! Not tomorrow. They will have already raised millions in dirty money. I NEED YOU TODAY! The MAGA movement has never needed you more than it does in this exact moment. Before the day ends, will you step up and show them you’re still 100% in? ** If leaders like You step up, you will inspire others to follow. I’m counting on You, lead by example and start the wave of MAGA Patriots to step up and help win these midterms! \- President Donald J. We just finished a three-day swing through the district's northern counties.
It started on Thursday with our Veterans Beer Call in Anniston. It was exactly what we hoped for. We spent time with more than 30 people, not all of whom were veterans, shared some good laughs, and had very emotional conversations about veterans' suicide, the state of the Veterans Health Care System, and how we can care for our veterans.
Friday night was First Friday in Gadsden. The team from the Etowah County Democratic Women's Club turned out, along with a few other supporters, and we handed out nearly 1,000 push cards.
Then, on Saturday, it was Oxfest in Oxford. Okay, I won't lie. It was a long, hot, exhausting day, but here are the good parts. First, we shared a table with the great Pam Howard, who is running in State House District 40; her campaign staff, Carol and Joe, were with us the entire way; and we were right across the street from the Calhoun County Democrats. What kept me going in the 90+ degree heat was the constant stream of people who came over and said, "We've never met, but I'm following you, I'm voting for you, and I want to thank you for campaigning with such a positive message." ....

A CALL TO ACTION
---
|
---
This won't be a year when we can sit back and expect everyone else to do the work. If you want to change the direction of the country, you have to get into the game. If you can help us with any of these efforts, drop us a note, and we will be in touch. Here is what you can do to help us win in November:
---
|
---
Events: We're a grassroots campaign, so we need to meet people face-to-face. If you're having a fall festival, food truck event, flea market, farmers market, or art fair, let us know.
---
| |
---
| Sign Waving: Gather some friends and wave signs on any busy streetcorner, we can get you more signs and t-shirts.
---
| |
---
| Write postcards: We provide postcards, postage, addresses, and even a suggested message; all you need to do is write.
---
| |
---
| Canvassing: We need volunteers to help organize canvassing or work with other candidates to coordinate efforts. We can provide lists of addresses for potential swing voters and as many push cards as you want.
---
| |
---
| Phone banking: If your county already does phone banking, we can team with you to include our campaign in your message.
---
| |
---
| Host an event: We want to meet your friends.
---
| |
---
| Make a plan to vote: Tell everyone you know to vote, offer rides to the polls, THEN VOTE.
---
| |
---
# One Last Thought Until Next Week
---
| | |
---
Hey everybody,
We've started the sprint to the finish line. That means two things:
* First, we're doing more events every week now. In the last two weeks, we spent 11 days on the road meeting people. We've got 5 events this week. We expect it to pick up. If you have public events happening in your area, let us know about them. We'll do our best to get there.
* Second, we're spending money on advertising. We've been waiting for the past few weeks, and they're here. We've got time on over 20 billboards across the district, and in Lee and Chambers County, you can hear our ads on multiple local radio stations.

But what you've been doing is as important as ever. We're still a grassroots campaign. We need you out there talking to your friends, sharing our posts on social media, and putting up those yard signs for people to see.
And that strategy is working. Everywhere we go, people tell us they've seen our signs and want to meet us. They tell us they came across us on social media and liked what they saw. Many of them also say that a friend or family member told them about the campaign, and they looked us up.
It's working, but we have to keep building the momentum. Make sure your friends are registered to vote and make a plan to go with them to the polls. Talk to everyone and ask them to ignore party labels. We don't want their votes just because we're Democrats. We want their votes because we care about the people who live in this district.
There are four weeks... 28 days... to the general election.
Be well.

We'll talk soon,

Lee

If you're having a fall festival, food truck event, flea market, farmers market, or art fair, let us know. | | | Sign Waving: Gather some friends and wave signs on any busy streetcorner, we can get you more signs and t-shirts. | | | Write postcards: We provide postcards, postage, addresses, and even a suggested message; all you need to do is write. | | | Canvassing: We need volunteers to help organize canvassing or work with other candidates to coordinate efforts. | | Dear Friend who has common sense,I'm always going to stand with America.I'm always going to reject the extremes. I'm always going to reject Socialism.I'm always going to fight against the anti-American way of life.And this has enraged a lot of people in the media, in my party, and even former staffers --- disgruntled leakers who are viciously and anonymously attacking me. This is what happens when you put common sense and the wellbeing of the people you are supposed to represent ahead of party loyalty.But most of all, I think this is what happens when you clash with the Socialist movement "DSA!" that is hijacking the Democratic party. name: True the Vote
subject: Tend what's yours to tend
body:
| | | October 06, 2026 | [**Read Online**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr9v7kumhrevzd7lu3h9droq/wnh2hghql6o4ezc7hx/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvZDB1ZWgwaG8za3ZtemhrNHh4NjRvdHpteHc2NW9ibGg1Z3BkMw==) |
---

Friends,
I hope your week is off to a peaceful start.
I've been thinking about one of the quieter responsibilities of citizenship: paying attention to the place where we actually live. So much of our technology pulls our attention elsewhere, toward national outrage, faraway fights, and things we can watch but never touch. Meanwhile the county clerk's office down the road, the precinct where we vote, and the neighbors on our own street can go years without a second thought.
Jeremiah 29:7 says, "_Seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried you_." What strikes me is who those words were first written to. They weren't written to people who were comfortable. They were written to exiles in Babylon, people living somewhere they hadn't chosen, under a government they didn't control. God didn't tell them to wait it out or wash their hands of the place. He told them to build houses, plant gardens, raise their families, and pray for the city. _"For in its peace, you will find your peace."_
That is a wonderfully grounded instruction. Faithfulness looks like showing up where you've been planted.
For us, that means knowing your own voter record. It means understanding how elections are actually administered in your county, asking good questions respectfully and persistently, and helping your neighbors understand it too.
I've watched this play out again and again in my own work, as a mom, as a wife, as a friend, and as a professional: the things that last are rarely built by a viral moment. They're built patiently, locally, and one relationship at a time.
That's what****[**Mobilize A Million**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr9v7kumhrevzd7lu3h9droq/reh8hohmoz5769h2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly9tb2JpbGl6ZWFtaWxsaW9uLm9yZy8=) exists to make possible on a larger scale: a million Americans checking their own voter records, learning how election administration works where they live, getting practical tools and training, and then turning to help the person next to them do the same.
It's yeoman's work. And it doesn't hurt to remember that this country was built by yeomen: ordinary men and women who worked their own land, owned their own responsibilities, and didn't wait for someone else to tend what was theirs to tend. America still needs that kind of citizen. We need people who are loyal, hardworking, reliable, and present, by the million.
So today, put your shoulder to the plow.[ **[Check your voter record here →]**](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr9v7kumhrevzd7lu3h9droq/08hwh9h2pr7xlohlh5/aHR0cHM6Ly9zY2FuY2hlY2twcm90ZWN0Lm9yZy8=) It takes a few minutes, and it's the first furrow.
There is plenty in the world we cannot control. But there is always something nearby we can tend faithfully and well. Start there.
**Wake up. Equip. Mobilize.**
For Freedom,
Sarah
| |
---
P.S. To everyone already supporting this work month after month: thank you. Your recurring gift keeps the tools, training, and infrastructure running between the headlines, quietly and steadily, the way any good harvest is grown. subject: The reality of having an August primary election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tammy Baldwin for Senate
body:
Peter, I have to be honest with you.
Peter, I have to be honest with you.
The reality of having an August primary election date is not great. It’s pretty terrible timing for a campaign powered 100% by people like you.
Let me explain.
For the past few months, we’ve been running ads, making tight budget decisions, and relying on members of our grassroots team to power us through the final stretch of the primary campaign.
We were facing $70 million in outside spending against us. We couldn’t afford to play it safe. **So, to put it bluntly, we practically drained our bank account leading up to August 4th.**
We made it through the primary, but that’s only _half_ the battle.
**The general election is here, and Mike Rogers has $70 million backing him to blanket the airwaves with misleading attack ads.**
It sounds daunting, but I’ve counted on this team before, and you’ve never let me down. I’m hoping I can count on you again today, Peter. **[Please, pitch in a split donation to my campaign and Tammy Baldwin to help us get back on our feet as quickly as possible so that we can reach undecided voters before Rogers does.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261006-partner_ms_aes_em_tammy.xG5Mb3&amount=5&refcode=em20261006-5720&t=1&akid=5720%2E35263%2EOyFYYU)**
