body:
Eugene Vindman needs your support.

**🇺🇸 To all supporters of Eugene Vindman: Please don’t ignore this message. We are at the point of the campaign with weeks to go that we are making some final, critical spending decisions and right now we are short of where we need to be. That could mean cuts. It could put this race (one of the closest in the country last cycle) in jeopardy. ⛅**
Eugene has devoted his life to serving our country: in the Army, the National Security Council, and now as a member of Congress.
But he’s up for re-election against a formidable MAGA opponent who is _attacking him relentlessly._ He’s launched attack ads against him, and even a website dedicated to smearing his record.

Eugene is already a top target for Trump after blowing the whistle on him 7 years ago, and recently calling on Trump to release questionable call transcripts with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. And his race is one of the most competitive races in the country.
So we have no doubt that Eugene will continue to be subjected to limitless attacks by his opponent, Donald Trump, and National Republicans.

**Peter, if we don't have the resources to fight back against these attacks, we could lose this seat.** But to win, it's going to take resources — resources that only this grassroots team can help us build.
But truthfully, we’re seeing a major slowdown in our fundraising, and the timing couldn't be worse as we **make some of the final spending decisions of this race.**
The strength of this campaign has always come from people like you who chip in what they can, when they can. Our average online donation is about $27. Some give more, many give less. What matters is that people give to support Eugene when they can. Especially during a critical moment like this one.

So we’re asking:
[**Peter, if you can, please contribute $3 today to help ensure Eugene has the resources to fight back against the attacks and win this race. The path to the House majority runs through this district.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-oct26?refcode=em261006-av&refcode2=1146_3892029_yQfH-6&akid=1146%2E3892029%2EyQfH-6)

Horrible Hobbs has a four-point lead over conservative Andy Biggs in Arizona.

If we lose Arizona in 2026, we don't just lose one election. We may lose the next decade.

**Arizona controls 11 electoral votes. Soon, it 'll be 12. Without Arizona, roughly 70% of the statistical paths to the White House disappear. **

>>> Whoever is the governor of Arizona will oversee the 2028 election. We need to win to secure the election.

>>> Arizona is the most consequential state in the presidential election. Lose it here, and 2028 gets a lot harder to win.

>>> Whoever wins the White House in 2028 runs the census. Whoever runs the census draws the lines for 2032.

We win by deploying real people, knocking on doors, building real relationships with real voters.

This works. We've proven it works.

Now we need to fund it at scale.

**Turning Point PAC is trying to raise $94,000 this week to put ballot chasers in the field across Arizona.**

Every dollar we raise goes straight to funding that operation: training, deploying, and sustaining the people who chase the vote.

name: James Carville
subject: Don’t let me catch you sleeping on North Carolina
body:
We have a snowball’s chance in hell of taking back the U.S. Senate majority without flipping North Carolina’s seat.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&source=&t=1&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f) | | | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&amount=5&t=8&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)
Now looky here, Peter:
**Democrats have a snowball’s chance in hell of retaking the U.S. Senate majority this fall without flipping North Carolina’s red seat blue.**
Ain’t nobody’s done that since 2008, and the GOP has flooded _beaucoup bucks_ into NC to keep it that way. That’s ‘cause having a proven winner like two-term former Governor Roy Cooper as the Democratic nominee is our best chance of flipping _any_ of the four seats we need.
Roy can’t overcome the full force of the GOP’s dark-money machine on his own, [**_so if you’re my kind of Democrat – the kind who believes our #1 mission is to take back the Senate from Trump’s far-right flunkies – then I’mma need you to get off your derrière and pitch in $5 or more to his grassroots campaign ASAP._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&amount=5&t=9&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)
Now you'll have to pardon my French, but I'm scared sh*tless Democrats just don't get how bad we need to fight for North Carolina this year.
Every election since 2008, the polls and expert ratings had us convinced NC was going our way ... only for some milquetoast Republican jack*ss to beat us by a few points on Election Day.
And believe me: **The jack*ss Roy’s up against this November has _a lot_ going his way.**
His GOP opponent Michael Whatley is the former chair of the RNC, so big-time Republicans like the President and my evil twin Steven Miller are putting their thumbs on the scales in his favor.
On top of that, their super PACs have spent _tens of millions_ on baseless attack ads against Roy.
Without the grassroots resources to surge ahead and reach every last voter between the Outer Banks and the Smokies, Roy could lose this race – and Democrats can say goodbye to flipping the Senate!!!
[**_If you want to stop that from happening, then PLEASE, Peter, before midnight, rush $5 or anything you can spare – _toot sweet_ – to ensure Roy has the grassroots funds to fight back and win in North Carolina. The future of our country depends on it._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&amount=5&t=10&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&amount=5&t=11&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)

| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&amount=25&t=12&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)

| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&amount=50&t=13&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)

| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&t=14&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)
---
Thank you,

James Carville
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&t=2&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1586&source=&t=3&akid=4286%2E124072%2EDSAJ9f)

| | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?

Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

That's why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** --to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.

**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcGK3DAQRL9GvtlILY_tOfgQ4hkIZDeEPeRo5FbbbpAlYUkT9u_Dhp0P2OsreEVRf17mF8OO_fZqDho5pdkGO-_mQe-h-JAZyc4goauVrGU3G8z8oLk1lR0voIZ1qGhU_VXBMIC-VPu4EuoWVrR0ocX0arFwXdYBlxVao-VQ8fjhU1J2CqRWqlHm2mrsFzKS0LaLaGWJ1mRq2Ce2lDCEGIPjzJiacG6VG_ecYxL6m4C7gDv7NTQ7O5escdSQLQLuLmyM9blTDidjnXKx7_VW2JLQ94RCTxL6Xr5KaOHnbZp-TbfbdwFdycecQjmRhJ7iGVIkzOy3z-ggy-UQeqLDsPuEaI5oePNCT_9rnzj4TD4LPf3u6x9vb_VzeXWONv5l5zh1vWjl9uFqMBxV_tIJjxH-BQAA__8BrZPJ)

Inside, you'll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart

* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals

* Think more clearly before reacting

* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that's becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly --and speak with confidence.**

And it's not just theory (although there's a lot of that in the guide)!

These are practical tools you can start using right away...in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.

**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.**

And, if you want to go deeper, you can continue learning in Hillsdale College's full FREE online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric."**

Trust me, the guide becomes even more helpful when you see these ideas explained by a Hillsdale faculty member in the full course.

**So, download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide now:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcGK3DAQRL9GvtlILY_tOfgQ4hkIZDeEPeRo5FbbbpAlYUkT9u_Dhp0P2OsreEVRf17mF8OO_fZqDho5pdkGO-_mQe-h-JAZyc4goauVrGU3G8z8oLk1lR0voIZ1qGhU_VXBMIC-VPu4EuoWVrR0ocX0arFwXdYBlxVao-VQ8fjhU1J2CqRWqlHm2mrsFzKS0LaLaGWJ1mRq2Ce2lDCEGIPjzJiacG6VG_ecYxL6m4C7gDv7NTQ7O5escdSQLQLuLmyM9blTDidjnXKx7_VW2JLQ94RCTxL6Xr5KaOHnbZp-TbfbdwFdycecQjmRhJ7iGVIkzOy3z-ggy-UQeqLDsPuEaI5oePNCT_9rnzj4TD4LPf3u6x9vb_VzeXWONv5l5zh1vWjl9uFqMBxV_tIJjxH-BQAA__8BrZPJ)

It's our gift to you. Part of our educational mission is to help more and more people understand what's true and communicate it clearly.

We hope you find it helpful.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

absentee ballot but have not yet returned it.

These are some of the most impactful calls we can make. Successful calls can directly result in another Republican ballot being
returned and another vote for our candidates. We will all be working from the same list to maximize the number of Republican
ballots we get returned.

The script is already loaded in the app. Once you begin your call, simply click "Start Questionnaire" and follow the script.

First, we ask if they have already returned their ballot. If they haven't, we encourage them to return it as soon as possible and
provide the key information they need to complete and submit it. If they are not planning to vote, the script walks you through a
short persuasion message explaining why their vote matters and encouraging them to make a plan to vote.

If you want to help our Republican candidates win, this is one of the most important things you can help with!

Reminder: You are on Right Insight

Everyone receiving this email is already set up on Right Insight. Simply log in using the email address where you received this
message. You'll receive a six-digit verification code by email. Enter that code, and you're ready to start calling and knocking
doors.

If you'd like to door knock, use the "Near Me" project in the app. It will show you targeted households in your immediate area
wherever you are.

Door knocking is just as important to our other turnout effort. It gives us more opportunities for conversations, and a
face-to-face interaction can make an even greater impact than a phone call. We encourage you to help with both calls and doors as
we work to turn out Republican voters!

We will also have tons of in-person call banks and door knocks you can participate in. Later in the week, I will send out some of
the fun ways to get involved.

some one-on-one help. They can also schedule a training at your BPOU meeting, volunteer event, or other gathering.

I also offer virtual Right Insight training every Tuesday and Thursday at 7:30 PM. Feel free to join anytime if you're new to the
app, have questions, or just need a refresher.

[Pledge your support](https://substack..qgVV6d0vv_aRhcZysYA-aQrR7OEzUwBaNyJa8xRxe-A?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=219016224)

In Bruce Blakeman's speech, to supporters, he described the problems that Democrat control of New York has created.
As I listened to him, I felt like he was describing Connecticut. Electricity prices are among the highest in the nation, taxes are among the highest in the nation, the state budget is double the size of Florida with several million less people. New York has had an exodus of hundreds of thousands of people, and more are continuing to leave. Businesses are leaving or already has left. Healthcare is too expensive, crime is rising, and criminals don't even stay in prison due to cashless bail. New York is spending huge sums of money supporting illegal aliens to the tune of over $80,000 per year, per alien.
**The most significant difference between Connecticut and New York is Comrade Mamdani.**
Mamdani's Communist and antisemitic ideology and policies are the cancer that is destroying New York.
Bruce talked about Mamdani's city owned groceries that were putting Bodegas, small tax paying businesses, out of business with their own tax dollars. Mamdani wants to put landlords out of business by freezing rents, raising taxes and other landlord operating expenses until the point is reached where landlords lose money and eventually abandon buildings.
Bruce did have some positive answers. _**He proposes ending taxpayer subsidized solar and wind farms.**_ He stated that in the colder parts of Upstate New York the solar panels are covered with ice, three to four months per year, and do not generate electricity. _**He also talked about the destruction of farmland and its replacement with solar and wind farms.**_
_To improve energy affordability, he wants to stop the ban on fracking. The huge amount of natural gas in New York will bring tax revenue, prosperity and more natural gas to New York. If surpluses are produced the natural market for this natural gas I believe should be Connecticut and New England._
Blakeman also proposed tax relief to working and middle-class voters by exempting families with less than $100,000 in income from state income tax. This would ease the tax burden on families who are struggling to make ends meet.
Connecticut,without eliminating Democrat control, will be following the same path of Hochul and Mamdani's New York.
It is just a matter of time for some city in Connecticut to get their own Mamdani. We have many ultraliberal voters. We are also plagued by an ultraliberal governor and a super-majority controlled legislature by the Democrats - just like New York. While we cannot get natural gas across the border, their bad ideas of their socialist legislative policies have no problems getting into our state.
The one exception is that New York at least has a few Republicans in Congress - Connecticut has none.
**New York City is expected to send three (3) Democrat Socialists to Congress.**
This is the direction that we are headed unless we do something about it and those in Congress now are already pandering to the DSA agenda.
Connecticut you have seen the future and it is New York. Do you really believe in socialism, do you really enjoy paying taxes so that illegal aliens can get free housing, free healthcare, spending allowances and free public-school education all at the taxpayers' expense.
Many Connecticut residents, especially with the higher gas prices are struggling to make ends meet while their taxpayer dollars are subsidizing government supported illegals. Our priority should be helping our own citizens. Under recently signed Connecticut, passed by the Democrat controlled legislature and signed by Governor Lamont, HB 8002, single family neighborhoods will be destroyed, by free for all state mandated zoning, that allows 14 unit apartment buildings to be built on single family lots without any onsite parking.
This will destroy the equity that homeowners have accumulated in their homes.
**Do you think that following New York and freezing rents on rental apartments will work? The answer is no. Landlords will not build unprofitable rental units. Landlords will not rent vacated units, it is already happening in New York, because renting will prove unprofitable. The housing shortage will worsen.**
What Connecticut needs is a government focused on economic development, lowering energy costs, lowering taxes, eliminating subsidies to illegal aliens, expanding our roads so that people and businesses can travel within the state faster and more efficiently.
Unlike my opponent who votes with the Democrat party over 95% the time and who has spent two months, as a college student, with the Communists who control Nicaragua and then wrote a over 90 page essay glorifying the regime, I will resist the socialist forces in Congress.
Connecticut needs Federal Legislators who collaborate at the Federal level with the Governor and the state legislature as a team to restore greatness to the state of Connecticut.
I am running for Congress so that I harness the power and resources of the Federal Government to bring back prosperity, improve the quality of life and bring a brighter future to the people of Connecticut.

If you and I sat down together, I think we’d walk away as friends...
In fact, I think we’d leave as close allies in a battle for our country's future.
****[This is Vivek Ramaswamy: I’m a husband, a father, and an America First fighter who’s sick and tired of watching our country lose its spine.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MTAwNl9TNy1XUC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNDcyMDQtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjEwMDZfUzctV1AuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDQ3MjA0LTM2MjMifQ/9RIpFYUAKZnNKMtLvxPzmA)
Why does the single mom in Toledo have to work two jobs while illegal immigrants get handed luxury hotel rooms, healthcare, and debit cards?
Why are kids in Cincinnati stepping over used needles while bureaucrats lecture them about “inclusion”?
Let’s call this what it is: America is being hollowed out from the inside.
And I’m not here to nibble around the edges.
[I’m running for Governor to overhaul the system from the ground up. I believe Ohio can be the beating heart of America’s revival.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MTAwNl9TNy1XUC4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNDcyMDQtMzYyMyZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjEwMDZfUzctV1AuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDQ3MjA0LTM2MjMifQ/H7cvmPp99lUTgMg1_RLaTg)
That’s why my entire campaign is centered on:
1) Supporting President Trump's America First Agenda.2) Cutting red tape3) Slashing taxes4) Empowering families5) Unleashing innovation
And let me tell you, the Democrat Machine is ENRAGED by this mission. They’ll do everything they can to stop me from winning this race.

# When the Safety System Wasn’t Safe
| |
---
|
---
A September 16 investigation published by [_The BMJ_ ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MjAwNTgwOTYxMDA1NDcxMDkyLFwiclwiOjIwMDU4MDk5OTc1NDU0ODg2OH0iLCJzIjoiMzVlNWEyODczMGE5ODk3YSJ9)confirms what medical-liberty advocates have argued for years: federal health officials did not provide an honest account of what their own vaccine-safety systems could and could not see. “US officials embraced an algorithm for detecting signals of harm from mRNA covid-19 vaccines,” _The BMJ_ reported, “that they knew was broken and suppressed efforts to fix it.” **Here’s how the problem worked:** The algorithm compared one COVID vaccine largely against the other. If Pfizer and Moderna increased the risk of the same adverse event by similar amounts, the rates could look essentially the same. No meaningful difference meant no alert. Statisticians call this _masking, a flaw that can create false reassurance rather than evidence of safety._ This failure was not subtle or discovered years later and quietly corrected. According to the investigation, federal health officials knew about the problem in 2021 and continued using the system while assuring us that these products were **“safe & effective,” language that was also used to justify vaccine mandates.** That raises a fundamental question about informed consent: How can Americans **make truly informed medical decisions** when the government withholds known limitations in the very systems designed to detect potential harms? Whether that failure was negligence or something more deliberate, the result was the same: Americans were given assurances of safety without being given the full picture. **And there has still been no serious reckoning.** TFVC is fighting to make sure Texans never have to surrender that right to a government mandate or a promise of “safe & effective.” **To that end, look for our General Election Voter Guide coming next week!**

If Pfizer and Moderna increased the risk of the same adverse event by similar amounts, the rates could look essentially the same. No meaningful difference meant no alert. Statisticians call this masking, a flaw that can create false reassurance rather than evidence of safety. This failure was not subtle or discovered years later and quietly corrected. According to the investigation, federal health officials knew about the problem in 2021 and continued using the system while assuring us that these products were “safe & effective,” language that was also used to justify vaccine mandates. That raises a fundamental question about informed consent: How can Americans make truly informed medical decisions when the government withholds known limitations in the very systems designed to detect potential harms? Whether that failure was negligence or something more deliberate, the result was the same: Americans were given assurances of safety without being given the full picture. And there has still been no serious reckoning. Nicholas Farrish did exactly what the law tells people in his position to do. After a felony conviction, he served his sentence, finished his supervision, and rebuilt his life. Then he asked a Mississippi court to restore the firearm rights his conviction had stripped away, a path the statute itself lays out.
What happened next should give every Mississippian pause. A circuit judge weighed the evidence and found, in writing, that Farrish is fully rehabilitated and that his possessing a firearm "would not be dangerous to public safety." That is not a hunch or a technicality. It is a judicial finding, made after a hearing.
And then the same judge gave him back only part of what he had asked for. Long guns, yes. A handgun, no. And whatever firearm he does keep must sit locked in a safe whenever it is not in his hands.
Think about what this means. The only justification for disarming a citizen is the threat they pose to public safety. Taking their guns protects the community. But the State concedes there is no danger here. A judge found this man safe, and the State does not dispute it. Once the danger is gone, so is the reason.
Yet the State still claims the power to tell a man, it admits is harmless, which guns he may own, long guns, yes; a pistol, no, and to make him lock the rest in a safe inside his own home. If he is safe, he is safe with a handgun too; the risk is in the person, not the type of gun. This is not public safety. This is the government treating a constitutional right as a privilege, arbitrarily granting it to citizens as it pleases.
Farrish's felony was a third DUI. Drunk driving kills, it shatters families, and Mississippi is right to treat it as a grave offense. But Farrish is not a predator, and the judge who heard every fact of it found he poses a danger to no one.
Most of us have never really thought this through. We hear "convicted felon" and we nod when the government takes the guns away. It feels like plain common sense. But look closer. We are not talking about arming someone a court believes is dangerous. We are talking about a specific man a court found safe and a government that still refuses to fully let go.
This is no longer an abstract debate. Farrish's case is now before the Mississippi Supreme Court, and Attorney General Lynn Fitch's office has just filed the State's brief. I have read all thirty-two pages. Fitch's lawyers argue that a convicted felon, any convicted felon, has no Second Amendment right in the first place. They argue the courts need not even ask whether a particular person is actually dangerous. And they defend the lock-and-key order on a man already found rehabilitated as a perfectly reasonable condition.
Nowhere in those thirty-two pages does Fitch's brief cite the Mississippi Constitution, which guarantees the right of "every citizen" to keep and bear arms.
Here is the uncomfortable truth the case lays bare. A right the government can switch off for an entire class of people and leave off even after a judge rules the danger gone is not really a right at all. It is a privilege, handed back when the state decides it feels like it.
Farrish served his time. A judge said he is safe. The only question left is whether "shall not be infringed" still means something in Mississippi, or whether our rights now come with a combination lock.

name: Tim Burchett
subject: Washington could learn from a waffle
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Before the pancake crowd comes after me with pitchforks, read what’s been on my mind.

| Hey Peter, it’s Tim Burchett.
I have what my younger staff call a “hot take”: [Waffles are better than pancakes.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._g)
There. I said it.
A pancake’s fine, but a waffle has some backbone to it. Those little squares hold the butter and syrup right where the Good Lord intended. And if you’ve ever seen me at a Waffle House, you already know which side of this debate I’m on.
---
[](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._41OBfD0sm5vwFJkQ)
---
Now, before the pancake crowd comes after me with pitchforks, let me tell you why I’m really writing.
I’ve been thinking about how dadgum strange this job can be.
One minute I’m sitting in a Waffle House drinking coffee, and the next I’m back in Washington arguing with people who could complicate a two-car funeral.
Somewhere in between all that, it’s easy to forget why you got into the fight in the first place.
So I wrote a few things down. Not a campaign speech. Not something cooked up in a conference room. Just what’s been on my mind lately about Tennessee, this country, and the people I’m lucky enough to work for.
[Peter, I’d sure appreciate it if you gave it a read.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._g)
---
| [READ MY NOTE](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-G3pTp6Q)
---
And for the record, I’m still right about the waffles.
Thank y’all for sending me here,Tim Burchett

clean_body: Before the pancake crowd comes after me with pitchforks, read what’s been on my mind. | Hey Peter, it’s Tim Burchett. I have what my younger staff call a “hot take”: There. I said it. A pancake’s fine, but a waffle has some backbone to it. Those little squares hold the butter and syrup right where the Good Lord intended. And if you’ve ever seen me at a Waffle House, you already know which side of this debate I’m on. Now, before the pancake crowd comes after me with pitchforks, let me tell you why I’m really writing. I’ve been thinking about how dadgum strange this job can be. One minute I’m sitting in a Waffle House drinking coffee, and the next I’m back in Washington arguing with people who could complicate a two-car funeral. Somewhere in between all that, it’s easy to forget why you got into the fight in the first place. So I wrote a few things down. Not a campaign speech. Not something cooked up in a conference room. Just what’s been on my mind lately about Tennessee, this country, and the people I’m lucky enough to work for. | And for the record, I’m still right about the waffles. Ten years ago this fall, a single promise carried a candidate to the presidency: "I will build a great wall." Of all the stories born in 2016 -- the hacks, the leaks, the recounts -- none has a longer construction record, a bigger budget, or a harder completion date. Yet in 2026 the largest public-works project on the U.S.-Mexico border in American history is underway largely beneath the national radar.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5e9d6285-7b10-407a-a9a0-f49794b965b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Where it began**
The wall wasn't born in 2016, but the promise was. Candidate Trump made it the spine of his campaign rallies, and historians may argue it helped propel him to victory that November ([U.S. News](https://www.usnews.com/news/politics/articles/2022-02-07/how-much-of-president-donald-trumps-border-wall-was-built)). First-term results were real but narrower than the rhetoric: roughly 458 miles of barrier built at a cost of about $15 billion -- though most of it replaced dilapidated fencing and vehicle barriers rather than walling virgin ground. Construction stopped on January 20, 2021, when President Biden issued a halt order on day one...

Of all the stories born in 2016 -- the hacks, the leaks, the recounts -- none has a longer construction record, a bigger budget, or a harder completion date. Yet in 2026 the largest public-works project on the U.S.-Mexico border in American history is underway largely beneath the national radar. | | ---|---|--- Where it began The wall wasn't born in 2016, but the promise was. Candidate Trump made it the spine of his campaign rallies, and historians may argue it helped propel him to victory that November (). First-term results were real but narrower than the rhetoric: roughly 458 miles of barrier built at a cost of about $15 billion -- though most of it replaced dilapidated fencing and vehicle barriers rather than walling virgin ground. body:
Here are all the new races we’re adding to our map with just 4 weeks to go until Election Day:
#
Hi there,
As we enter the last four weeks of the election, [Democrats are positioned to do well](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2432?t=1&akid=3044%2E1562180%2EeuN2wN) on Election Day. But the fact remains that Republicans have an outside spending money advantage, and they’re using it to reserve millions of dollars of ad space to attack Democrats and distract from their unpopular agenda and the Trump administration’s blatant corruption.
That makes these final weeks especially important. That’s when many voters will start paying attention to races and when campaigns will make their final push to reach voters.
The Swing Left political team has been closely tracking campaigns across the country, looking at polling, voting trends, fundraising, and what we’re seeing on the ground. Based on that analysis, we believe several additional House and Governor’s races could benefit from an investment now.
**As a result, we’re expanding our Must-Win target list to include 6 more U.S. House races and 2 more Governor’s races!**
Here are all the new races we’re adding to our map:
* **New Hampshire’s 1st Congressional District, Democrat Stefany Shaheen (Must-Hold):** After a competitive primary, Shaheen now faces a wealthy opponent who can self-fund his campaign in this historically swingy district. We need to make sure she has the resources and support needed to overcome her opponent’s money.

* **California's 6th Congressional District, Democrat Dr. Richard Pan (Must-Flip):** Dr. Pan is running against Republican-turned-independent Rep. Kevin Kiley in this newly drawn district. The district was redrawn under Proposition 50 to create a stronger opportunity for Democrats, but Kiley is well-funded and mounting a serious campaign to take this seat.

* **Florida’s 13th Congressional District, Democrat Leela Gray (Must-Flip):** Gray is challenging controversial Republican Rep. Anna Paulina Luna in this light red district. Polls show a tight contest, but Gray entered the race late and needs to catch up on fundraising.

* **Florida’s 22nd Congressional District, Democrat Pia Dandiya (Must-Flip):** Republicans redrew this district earlier this year to lean red, but Democrats still have a path to compete. If the 2020 presidential results were applied to the new district lines, President Biden would have won the district by 3%. In this political environment, Dandiya is running a strong campaign to hold on to this seat and overcome the Republican gerrymander.

* **Kentucky’s 6th Congressional District, Democrat Zach Dembo (Must-Flip):** This open seat leans red, but Democratic Governor Andy Beshear carried it by double digits in his 2023 reelection campaign. Dembo, a former military prosecutor and policy advisor to Gov. Beshear, is running against a vulnerable Republican former state legislator who only moved back to Kentucky to run here.

* **Montana’s 1st Congressional District, Democrat Sam Forstag (Must-Flip):** Former smokejumper Sam Forstag is running against right-wing radio host Aaron Flint for this open seat in western Montana that voted for former Democratic Senator Jon Tester. After winning the Democratic primary with an impressive ground game, Forstag is well-positioned to flip this seat.

[**If you’d like to support Swing Left and the Democratic nominees in all of our most critical red-to-blue House races across the country, click here to make a donation to the Flip the House Fund.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1254?refcode=em20261006-3044&t=2&akid=3044%2E1562180%2EeuN2wN)
* **Alaska Governors’ Race, Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins (Must-Flip):** Independent analysts at _Cook Political Report_ just moved this race to “Toss Up” as Democrats have consolidated behind former State Rep. Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, who is facing three conservative Republican candidates. Alaska’s ranked-choice voting means Republicans must ensure that voters rank the other Republican candidates as their second and third choice in order to consolidate the Republican vote–also known as their “rank the red” strategy. That creates an opening for Kreiss-Tomkins to consolidate Democrats, independents, and even moderate Republicans.

* **Texas Governors’ Race, Democrat Gina Hinojosa (Must-Flip):** Polling has shown an increasingly competitive race between state Rep. Gina Hinojosa and 11-year Republican incumbent Governor Greg Abbott. As Trump and GOP Senate nominee Ken Paxton drag down Republicans in Texas, Abbott faces a tough political environment and backlash over positions on issues like data centers. His enormous cash advantage in this expensive state means Hinojosa needs immediate support to stay competitive.

[**You can support Hinojosa and Kreiss-Tomkins by making a donation to the Win in the States Fund today.** ](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1257?refcode=em20261006-3044&t=3&akid=3044%2E1562180%2EeuN2wN)
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/1257?refcode=em20261006-3044&t=4&akid=3044%2E1562180%2EeuN2wN)**
With just 4 weeks left, we’re in a sprint to the finish—and we can’t thank you enough for everything you’re doing to help Democrats win in as many places as possible on November 3rd!
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261006-1&t=5&refcode2=3044_1562180_euN2wN&akid=3044%2E1562180%2EeuN2wN)

Peter,
DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin told reporters that ICE agents can--and very likely will--be deployed to polling places if he so chooses.
Mullin said ICE will conduct operations at polling places "if there is a threat" or if "we're serving a warrant on someone that we have been actively tracking down. If we're serving a warrant we will be where we need to be."

| Trump Cuts Diesel Costs Immediately
---
| |
---
| Dear Friends in Virginia's 5th District,
Yesterday, October 5 at 9pm, President Trump signed an executive order to immediately cut diesel costs for the truckers and farmers who keep America moving. The order temporarily opens highway use of tax-free dyed diesel, deferring the federal diesel tax on that fuel through the end of 2026, with no interest and no penalties. This executive order is effective now.
The federal diesel tax is 24.4 cents per gallon, or about $60 on a 250-gallon fill. Where states match this federal action, savings can reach roughly $100 per fill, a real difference for the hardworking Americans who haul the freight and grow the food that sustain our communities and our country.
While the ongoing conflict with Iran has added pressure to increase diesel prices, we would not be facing these energy challenges without the damaging green-energy policies pushed by the left that forced the closure of many of our refineries, coal plants, and natural-gas facilities. Those decisions reduced American energy production and left our truckers, farmers, and families more vulnerable to global shocks.
Compounding the problem are cap-and-trade schemes that raise energy costs. My opponent, Tom Perriello, voted for and strongly supported national cap-and-trade legislation (the 2009 Waxman-Markey bill) that would have punished American energy production and raised costs on everyday transportation and electricity.
Here in Virginia, Governor Spanberger has put the Commonwealth back into the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI), a classic multi-state cap-and-trade program on power-plant emissions. By increasing the cost of electricity generation, RGGI drives up energy prices for Virginians. Everyone I ask has noticed their electric bill is up due to RGGI. Combined with broader policies that favor forcing a rapid shift to electric vehicles, wind, and solar, these approaches make life more expensive for families, farmers, and truckers who still rely on affordable gasoline and diesel.
This energy weakness is not just an economic problem, it is a national-security threat. A nation that cannot produce abundant, affordable energy at home cannot reliably power its military, sustain its defense industrial base, or respond quickly in a crisis. When we shut down domestic energy infrastructure and drive up costs, we weaken the very industrial capacity needed to build ships, aircraft, vehicles, and munitions. Meanwhile, competitors like China impose no such self-imposed limitations. China can build far more ships in a short period than the United States can produce in a year. We all want a clean environment, but these policies go too far and risk undermining American energy security, industrial strength, and our ability to defend ourselves.
Thankfully, President Trump has us drilling again, "Drill, Baby, Drill", and the United States is now producing more crude oil than ever before. But producing the oil is only half the battle. We still need the refineries to turn that crude into the diesel, gasoline, and other fuels our economy and military require. That is why I wrote a letter to President Trump asking him to declare a state of emergency on refinery permitting and shorten the process from five years to five days. We cannot afford multi-year bureaucratic delays when American energy security and national defense are on the line.
This executive order is practical, common-sense relief. I urge Governor Spanberger to take corresponding action on Virginia's state fuel tax so our truckers and farmers can realize the full benefit of these savings right here at home. Matching the federal relief would put more money back in the pockets of the Virginians who keep our food supply and supply chains running, without the added burden of punitive energy policies that also erode our national security.

clean_body: | | | | == | Trump Cuts Diesel Costs Immediately | | | Dear Friends in Virginia's 5th District, Yesterday, October 5 at 9pm, President Trump signed an executive order to immediately cut diesel costs for the truckers and farmers who keep America moving. The order temporarily opens highway use of tax-free dyed diesel, deferring the federal diesel tax on that fuel through the end of 2026, with no interest and no penalties. This executive order is effective now. The federal diesel tax is 24.4 cents per gallon, or about $60 on a 250-gallon fill. Where states match this federal action, savings can reach roughly $100 per fill, a real difference for the hardworking Americans who haul the freight and grow the food that sustain our communities and our country. While the ongoing conflict with Iran has added pressure to increase diesel prices, we would not be facing these energy challenges without the damaging green-energy policies pushed by the left that forced the closure of many of our refineries, coal plants, and natural-gas facilities. Those decisions reduced American energy production and left our truckers, farmers, and families more vulnerable to global shocks. Compounding the problem are cap-and-trade schemes that raise energy costs. My opponent, Tom Perriello, voted for and strongly supported national cap-and-trade legislation (the 2009 Waxman-Markey bill) that would have punished American energy production and raised costs on everyday transportation and electricity. Here in Virginia, Governor Spanberger has put the Commonwealth back into the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative (RGGI), a classic multi-state cap-and-trade program on power-plant emissions. By increasing the cost of electricity generation, RGGI drives up energy prices for Virginians. Everyone I ask has noticed their electric bill is up due to RGGI. Combined with broader policies that favor forcing a rapid shift to electric vehicles, wind, and solar, these approaches make life more expensive for families, farmers, and truckers who still rely on affordable gasoline and diesel. This energy weakness is not just an economic problem, it is a national-security threat. A nation that cannot produce abundant, affordable energy at home cannot reliably power its military, sustain its defense industrial base, or respond quickly in a crisis. When we shut down domestic energy infrastructure and drive up costs, we weaken the very industrial capacity needed to build ships, aircraft, vehicles, and munitions. Meanwhile, competitors like China impose no such self-imposed limitations. China can build far more ships in a short period than the United States can produce in a year. We all want a clean environment, but these policies go too far and risk undermining American energy security, industrial strength, and our ability to defend ourselves. Thankfully, President Trump has us drilling again, "Drill, Baby, Drill", and the United States is now producing more crude oil than ever before. But producing the oil is only half the battle. We still need the refineries to turn that crude into the diesel, gasoline, and other fuels our economy and military require. That is why I wrote a letter to President Trump asking him to declare a state of emergency on refinery permitting and shorten the process from five years to five days. We cannot afford multi-year bureaucratic delays when American energy security and national defense are on the line. This executive order is practical, common-sense relief. I urge Governor Spanberger to take corresponding action on Virginia's state fuel tax so our truckers and farmers can realize the full benefit of these savings right here at home. Matching the federal relief would put more money back in the pockets of the Virginians who keep our food supply and supply chains running, without the added burden of punitive energy policies that also erode our national security. | Please Remind Friends to Vote By Nov 3rd | | | Please remind friends early voting is underway. Fellow American,

This is the first and last email I'll ever send you.

You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way.

**But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything.**

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I'm honored to have won my race for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District in 2024, and I'm proud to work alongside President Trump to make our nation great again.**

With President Trump in the Oval Office and House and Senate Majorities in Congress, we're more equipped than ever to get our country back on track. The only thing we're missing is the resources to keep going.

clean_body: I'm a little unsure about opening up to you | Fellow American, This is the first and last email I'll ever send you. You see, I'm a little unsure about opening up to you this way. But the deck is stacked against us, my back is against the wall, and your response to this message will decide everything. My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat. After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls. I'm honored to have won my race for North Carolina's 10th Congressional District in 2024, and I'm proud to work alongside President Trump to make our nation great again. With President Trump in the Oval Office and House and Senate Majorities in Congress, we're more equipped than ever to get our country back on track. The only thing we're missing is the resources to keep going. I'm not the kind of guy who asks for help, but running a grassroots campaign is tough - really, really tough. The Democrats won't stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts. Please have my back on this one: | | | Look, I'm not a politician. I'm nothing flashy or special, just a regular guy who loves this country more than anything. I won't give you empty promises & fancy slogans. That's not me. But I'll give you my word as a veteran that I'll fight with all I have to do what's right and make you proud. Thank you & God bless, Pat Harrigan | Paid for by The Pat Harrigan Committee PO Box 97275, Raleigh, NC 27624 Copyright (C) 2026 Pat Harrigan for Congress, All rights reserved.

| | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

clean_body: | | | | | Friend, If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left... If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good... If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, " Is it already too late?" You're not alone. A lot of good people have been asking the same question. But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That was no small feat. Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked. So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle. Then Charlie called me... He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster." I told him, "We are." Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said, "How many are there?" "About 27,000." Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!" I'll be honest -- I froze. We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet. But he wasn't fazed. He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together." That was Charlie. He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday." He believed in going now. And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself. He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality. That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place. That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: We're in 3,300. That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America. Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Friend, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Friend, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

# Yemen
* **Turkey, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia activate Mecca defense pact, will deploy forces to Gulf kingdom against Houthis:** Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia [agreed](https://substack.com/redirect/7e3df8e3-e159-4caf-9725-665ca62f3f80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday to activate "collective deterrence measures: under the Mecca Alliance for Defence after an emergency meeting of their defense and foreign ministers in Riyadh, the first time the pact, agreed to on August 7, has been invoked.
* Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman said the alliance was responding to "the heinous attacks against the Kingdom and holy sites."
* A separate joint statement published by the Pakistani Foreign Ministry said the three would "provide the agreed military forces and capabilities and ensure their rapid deployment" to Saudi Arabia under approved arrangements.
* **Ansarallah strikes Saudi airport, Aramco refinery:** Ansarallah [said](https://substack.com/redirect/4d29c9bc-2891-459d-9642-aa7f63dac790?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it struck King Khalid Airport in Riyadh, disrupting air traffic, and an Aramco refinery in Rabigh, claiming to have set it on fire. It says it also hit Abha Airport, the Khamis Mushait airbase and other sites in Asir, Najran, and Jizan.
* The group warned all airlines to stop flying through Saudi airspace, calling it "a theater for our operations," with the exception of the airspace over the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
* It said the attacks were retaliation for 60 Saudi airstrikes and a missile on Sanaa, Al-Jawf, Taiz, Hodeidah, Saada, and Marib over 24 hours, which it said killed civilians. It says 1,576 Saudi strikes have hit Yemen since the escalation began.
* Three people were lightly injured and infrastructure damaged in attacks on King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Jazan and Najran International Airport on Monday evening, Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority said.
* Ansarallah military spokesperson Yahya Saree claimed Tuesday the group struck Abha International Airport in Saudi Arabia's Asir province with a ballistic missile, disrupting air traffic, though Saudi authorities have not confirmed the attack.
* **Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claim capture of Mocha as coalition expands attacks on Ansarallah:** Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces said Tuesday they had retaken the strategic Red Sea port city of Mocha from Ansarallah following fighting south of the Bab al-Mandab strait, while the Saudi-led coalition announced a naval operation against Ansarallah in Hodeidah.
* The coalition separately said it destroyed a ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa and a storage facility containing 20 ballistic missiles in Saada.
* Control of Mocha could provide government forces with a staging point for further operations along Yemen's Red Sea coast, though the situation on the ground remains fluid and competing territorial claims have emerged during recent fighting.
* Saudi-backed forces also claim to control Bab al-Mandab, an airport in Dhubab district and much of southwestern Taiz's Red Sea coastline, while Ansarallah officials say they repelled some advances and recaptured territory.

# Iran
* **Bessent celebrates collective economic punishment of Iranians:** Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [celebrated](https://substack.com/redirect/9653c291-58c7-4a49-98f4-b44182654e8e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the collapse of Iran's economy, boasting that "Operation Economic Outcast is delivering results": the rial at record lows, and zero Iranian crude loaded onto tankers last month.
* "The Iranian regime allows its own people to suffer," Bessent claimed, as U.S. policies punish ordinary Iranian civilians.
* Nurses and teachers are quitting in large numbers because their salaries no longer cover the cost of living, the New York Times reported Monday.
* And the U.S. blockade and sanctions have cut imports of medicine and pharmaceutical raw materials, pushing prices up and leaving pharmacies short of drugs for serious illnesses, the FT reported. Some medicines have tripled in price.
* **Pezeshkian calls U.S. negotiations "futile": **Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Monday that negotiations with the U.S. had become "futile," accusing Washington of repeatedly attacking Iran following talks and seeking to bring down the Islamic Republic.
* "Every time we come to the negotiating table, war is immediately imposed upon us," Pezeshkian said, according to IRNA, adding that the U.S. had attacked Iran three times following negotiations. "This demonstrates that they do not seek dialogue. On the contrary, their goal is to bring down the Islamic Republic of Iran."
* **Trump defends removal of U.S. bombers from UK base as seventh suspect arrested:** President Donald Trump on Monday defended the Pentagon's decision to remove B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK following what he described as "some threats," after previously linking Iran to a security incident near the base.
* "Rather than tempting the enemy ... why should we leave them there? So, we moved them around a little bit. Not very far," Trump said, adding that Washington knows who made the threat and that "they've gotten themselves into big problems," without elaborating.
* UK counterterrorism police separately arrested a 22-year-old British national in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts in connection with activity near Fairford, bringing the number of arrests linked to the investigation over the past two weeks to seven.
* **Trump calls higher gas prices a "small price to pay" for war with Iran: **Trump said higher gasoline prices for U.S. consumers were a "small price to pay" for what he described as keeping the U.S. and the world safe, as the war with Iran continues to disrupt energy markets.
* Speaking at a Republican midterm campaign rally in Grand Island, Nebraska, Trump said the price increase caused by the war was "just artificial" and "essentially almost over with," while repeating that the U.S. would not allow Iran to obtain a nuclear weapon.
* "They can take out a city. Let them take out Los Angeles or San Diego. This is a very small price to pay," Trump said.
* He claimed gasoline prices would fall below $1.85 a gallon in "a very short period of time," potentially before or shortly after the November 3 midterm elections.
* **Twelve sailors injured in attack on commercial vessel in Strait of Hormuz:** Twelve sailors, including 11 Indian nationals, were injured in an attack on the Panama-flagged commercial vessel MT On Peace off Oman in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, India's Foreign Ministry said.
* The vessel was carrying 19 crew members, including 17 Indians. The injured sailors were evacuated with assistance from Omani authorities and are receiving treatment in Khasab.

# Palestine
* **Killed and wounded in Gaza:** Over the past 24 hours, two Palestinians were killed--one in a new Israeli attack and one due to wounds sustained in an earlier attack--and 35 injured across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 is now 74,245 killed, with 175,267 injured. Since October 11, 2025, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,462 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 5,151, while 836 bodies have been recovered.
* **Israeli attacks kill three, wound several across Gaza:** An Israeli drone [strike](https://substack.com/redirect/83a383cc-966b-4020-bd74-e32964632c34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near the municipal park in central Gaza City killed one Palestinian and wounded another on Tuesday, while several Palestinians were injured in a strike on Al-Wehda Street in the west of the city, WAFA reported. In Khan Younis, an Israeli attack killed two Palestinians, according to Al Jazeera
* Israeli forces also shot and wounded one person in the Karama neighborhood of northwest Gaza City and another near Bir 19, south of the Mawasi area of Khan Younis.
* **Ben-Gvir joins demolition of Jerusalem apartment building as settlers torch Palestinian home, vehicles across the occupied West Bank:**
* **East Jerusalem:** Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir [joined](https://substack.com/redirect/866bba9b-7f54-4419-ab67-5d16c668586e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israeli forces during the demolition of a five-story residential building in Al-Tur containing 10 apartments and housing about 70 Palestinians, mostly women and children, on Tuesday, according to WAFA.
* **Nablus:** Israeli bulldozers [razed](https://substack.com/redirect/affc91b1-f7cb-4a7d-8cb9-b559d42cf94c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) agricultural land and uprooted olive trees in Iraq Burin, while blocking several village roads with earth mounds. In Aqraba, settlers torched four Palestinian vehicles and spray-painted racist slogans.
* **Ramallah:** Settlers [set fire](https://substack.com/redirect/b57548b0-bab9-468d-ab91-563b707ba5ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to a home housing a family of five in Burqa, causing extensive damage. The same homeowner, a U.S. citizen, had his vehicle damaged and dozens of his olive trees cut down by settlers about a month earlier.
* **Salfit:** Settlers attempted to set fire to a poultry structure and spray-painted racist slogans on a livestock farm in Farkha. Israeli forces separately raided Salfit city and [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/4825677f-e8f8-4c0a-bdc0-9a002f9eabeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Nihad Al-Naoura, secretary of Fatah's Salfit branch.

* **UK threatens to expel up to 27 Israeli diplomats over planned closure of East Jerusalem consulate:** The UK [threatened](https://substack.com/redirect/0da9678f-27f2-4822-889c-5da8d0aee1fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to expel one Israeli diplomat for every British diplomat forced out of Israel over Israel's plan to close the UK consulate in occupied East Jerusalem on Thursday, which could mean as many as 27 expulsions, Ynet reported. The Foreign Office declined to comment on "speculation" rather than denying the report.
* Israel threatened to close the consulate this week, as part of its response to the UK's ban on trade in goods from illegal West Bank settlements and sanctions on British firms aiding settlement construction.
* The British Foreign Office was reportedly advised by former UK attorney general Dominic Grieve that such an action would be illegal, given that the United Nations and most of its members recognize East Jerusalem as Palestinian territory.
* **111 Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza in September:** Israeli forces [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/369073e9-0998-417f-866d-165af185a3cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 111 Palestinians in Gaza in September, including 23 children, ten women and four elderly people, according to the Gaza Health Ministry's monthly report. Israel has killed Palestinians in Gaza every month since the ceasefire began. The deadliest month was July, with 152 killed.

# U.S. News
* **DCCC adds six deep-red districts to "Red to Blue" list, predicts House majority of up to 240 seats: **The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee [added](https://substack.com/redirect/0bf7d90f-d599-49e3-927f-b0dfff331f64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) six candidates to its "Red to Blue" list Monday, in districts Trump won by an average of 16 points or more in 2024, signalling that the Democratic Party will allocate extra resources, and perhaps fundraising dollars, to these races.
* The six include:
* Arkansas's 2nd, where Democrat **Chris Jones** faces incumbent Rep. **French Hill** ;
* Colorado's 3rd, where Democrat **Dwayne Romero** faces incumbent Rep. **Jeff Hurd** ;
* Florida's 27th, where Eliott Rodriguez faces incumbent Rep. **Maria Elvira Salazar** ;
* New York's 21st, where Democrat **Blake Gendebien** faces Republican **Anthony Constantino** ;
* Nevada's 2nd, where Democrat **Teresa Benitez-Thompson** faces Republican **David Flippo** ;
* and Tennessee's 9th, where Democrat**Justin J. Pearson** faces Republican **Brent Taylor**.
* DCCC political director **Brooke Butler** told Politico that "anywhere between 218 and 240 feels very viable" for Democrats' potential House majority and that more seats could be added, "if gas keeps going and diesel kicks back up."
* **Obama to campaign in Detroit with El-Sayed, Benson on Oct. 24:** Former President **Barack Obama** will [campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/15a538e2-fff2-4ac4-82a6-1e273f9ac6d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Detroit on Saturday, Oct. 24, with Democratic Senate nominee **Abdul El-Sayed** , gubernatorial nominee **Jocelyn Benson** and other candidates, the Michigan Democratic Party announced Monday.
* El-Sayed faces Republican former Rep. **Mike Rogers** in the race to succeed retiring Sen. **Gary Peters** , while Benson, the secretary of state, faces Republican Rep. **John James** in the open governor's race.
* Obama has made few public stops on the trail this year but previously campaigned in Texas with Senate nominee **James Talarico** and gubernatorial nominee **Gina Hinojosa** and appeared in a campaign ad with Iowa Senate nominee **Josh Turek**. He is also set to headline a Washington-area fundraiser Wednesday for the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee.
* **Soldiers wounded in March Iranian drone strike describe medical failures, red tape, AP reports:** Nine U.S. service members [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/d7aa5703-33fd-4a41-88fc-8368dca84d37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the March 1 Iranian drone strike at Port Shuaiba, Kuwait, which killed six troops on the second day of the Iran war, spoke on the record to the Associated Press about what they describe as a medical system that left them fighting for treatment on their own.
* Lt. Col. **Arturo Linc on**, who suffered shrapnel wounds to his jaw, neck, and spine, including a severed vertebral artery, was sent to barracks and told to seek outpatient appointments after Landstuhl Regional Medical Center in Germany did not admit him. Chief Warrant Officer 4 **Rodney Bearman** said he and others injured in the attacks were not properly registered as "wounded in combat" due to a coding error. Maj. **Stephen Ramsbottom** said he waited over four months for MRI results and has "had to build my own case for everything."
* Lincon, who still has shrapnel near his spinal cord and struggles with dizziness, told the AP that, following the attacks, in which his passport was destroyed, he was issued a temporary substitute and asked to prove his citizenship in the process (he was born in Texas to Mexican parents and graduated from West Point). He was also denied a Servicemembers' Group Life Insurance injury claim.
* **Supreme Court opens new term with Boulder climate case against Exxon, Suncor:** The Supreme Court's new term [began](https://substack.com/redirect/a0cd5a87-d821-4e8e-a602-983e4d316d67?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday with arguments in Boulder's lawsuit accusing Exxon Mobil and Suncor Energy of deceiving the public about the harms of fossil fuels. Boulder says it is seeking to recover past and future costs of repairs, emergency services and property damage, not to regulate emissions.
* The companies argue that only the federal government has the power to address something as large as climate change. The Trump administration has sided with them in the case.
* Justice **Samuel Alito** stepped aside a week before argument, after calls for recusal over his stock in Phillips 66 and ConocoPhillips. A 4-4 tie would leave the Colorado Supreme Court's ruling allowing the suit to proceed in place.
* **Trump signs order allowing the use of untaxed off-road diesel on highways:** President Donald Trump [signed](https://substack.com/redirect/0a5e5bb2-49c5-45c5-9720-6d7dd826c4d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an executive order on Monday temporarily allowing red-dyed diesel, normally reserved for farm and industrial vehicles, to be used on highways while deferring the 24.4-cent-per-gallon federal excise tax for the rest of the year, according to a fact sheet released by the White House.
* Diesel prices have surged from $3.76 a gallon before the war in Iran to a record $6.53 on September 22, according to AAA.
* The change could potentially save truckers roughly $150 per fill-up, according to CNN, though experts noted it does nothing to improve the principal cause of rising fuel prices, a global shortage of working refineries.
* **Trump approves firing squad execution for Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan:** Pentagon spokesperson **Sean Parnell**[announced](https://substack.com/redirect/21a1e3a6-5a04-47c9-923e-e6bf6c511a98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday on X that War Secretary **Pete Hegseth** "recommended" and President Trump "approved" death by firing squad for **Nidal Malik Hasan** , the convicted terrorist who killed 13 people and wounded 32 in the 2009 Fort Hood attack.
* Parnell said the Secretary of the Army will set the time and place of the execution.
* At least 144 civilian prisoners have been executed by shooting since 1608, according to the AP, the most recent being South Carolina's **Brad Sigmon** last year, who chose the method over the electric chair and lethal injection.
* **DOJ seeks to revoke citizenship of 40 naturalized Americans in largest denaturalization push in recent history:** The Justice Department is [moving](https://substack.com/redirect/6402a6fa-03da-488e-8ea0-e6827d3c812b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to revoke the citizenship of 40 foreign-born Americans it accuses of lying about or omitting criminal histories on their naturalization applications, Attorney General **Todd Blanche** announced in a press release Monday.
* The government accuses the applicants of having committed crimes including espionage, transporting child pornography, sexual misconduct against a minor, and voluntary manslaughter.
* The cases far exceed the average of 15 a year under previous administrations. DOJ announced that it would target as many as 300 people for possible denaturalization in April.
* **Border agents raid Arizona protest camp, fell centuries-old cottonwood for Trump 's border wall:** More than 50 Customs and Border Protection agents [raided](https://substack.com/redirect/0b73fd83-8af0-4c12-87f0-41f0fdee6d62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an activist camp in Lochiel, Arizona, on Monday, ending a 70-day protest of a potential tree demolition. Following the raid, an excavator knocked down the tree, a 150-to-250-year-old cottonwood, known as the "grandmother tree," that stood in the path of President Donald Trump's $46.5 billion border wall expansion.
* Activists told the Washington Post that agents dragged, kicked, and knelt on protesters during a sunrise prayer ceremony, with about 10 arrested and another 10 cited.
* **Chicago woman shot five times by Border Patrol agent sues federal government: Marimar Martinez** , a Chicago woman shot five times by Border Patrol agent**Charles Exum** , [sued](https://substack.com/redirect/19a7673a-6e9c-43b9-a047-1742173d46dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the federal government Monday for false arrest and imprisonment, malicious prosecution, emotional distress, and negligence, with her attorneys saying an independent crime scene analysis shows the agent shot her as she turned her car away from him.
* Shortly after the shooting, DHS called Martinez a "domestic terrorist" and charged her, but the charges were later dropped. Exum was later placed on "administrative leave," the department noted, "consistent with policy."
* Martinez said she was prepared to let the matter go after charges against her were dropped, until federal agents killed two people in Minneapolis. "What's happening is not normal," she added.
* **Trump says New York Times, other outlets should be "arrested" over coverage of Ohio rally: **President Trump [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/d458b11b-ef3b-4bea-a570-2d384f5bf9b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Truth Social Monday that the New York Times and "many other Artificial Media Outlets, should be arrested for their dishonesty and disservice to our Country," after Times correspondent **Katie Rogers** reported that "several areas of an upper deck were empty" by the end of his Saturday rally at Butler High School in Vandalia, Ohio. Trump disputed the paper's claims about attendance, saying that the arena was "totally MAXED OUT" and claiming thousands were turned away at the doors.
* **Texas pediatricians face Paxton investigations over childhood vaccinations:** Texas Attorney General **Ken Paxton** , the Republican U.S. Senate nominee, [launched](https://substack.com/redirect/1f398432-30f7-4fbb-a245-3ed9d53d78b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a statewide investigation accusing doctors, drug companies and insurers of conspiring to push parents into vaccinating children, with a New York Times report on Monday highlighting the case of **" Dr. Rachel,"** a central Texas pediatrician of 20 years who says responding to that investigation has cost her nearly $15,000 in legal fees and prompted her to reconsider her career.
* A December letter from the AG's office demanded 10 years of vaccine purchase records and her practice's vaccine policy, and said citing the CDC schedule would not suffice. In August, Paxton opened a separate probe of the American Academy of Pediatrics for "deceptively promoting childhood vaccines for financial gain." Pediatricians reject the profit motive as ludicrous, noting they pay for vaccines upfront and that nearly half of children's vaccines are covered by the federal Vaccines for Children program.
* Texas kindergarten measles and polio vaccine coverage has fallen to about 93 percent from nearly 97 percent in 2019.
