It's been three years since the Oct. 7 massacre in which thousands of Hamas terrorists and other armed civilians poured across Israel's southern border and carried out the deadliest attack on Jews since the Holocaust, [killing roughly 1,200 people from over 30 countries](https://substack.com/redirect/e9ad0fbc-6afa-4493-bdbc-e67fac8ca5e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including 33 Americans, and dragging 251 hostages into Gaza. Among the hostages were 12 Americans and dozens of foreign nationals, including [31 Thai farm workers.](https://substack.com/redirect/4f827ce7-5919-473a-a2ca-e57025d4d884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) One of those killed was Bucks County native [Carol Siman Tov](https://substack.com/redirect/8896d218-31c3-442d-96cc-4340e9fea919?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a 70-year-old grandmother who had later built her life in Kibbutz Nir Oz. Carol was murdered in her home that morning. Nearby, her 36-year-old son Johnny was killed, along with his 35-year-old wife Tamar, their 51⁄2-year-old twin daughters Shahar and Arbel, and 2-year-old son Omer. According to Johnny's sister, the family was shot through a window as the [house was set on fire](https://substack.com/redirect/8b63404a-6566-438f-8706-e32ddc10cd9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be08abfd-0cab-4f0c-9817-89936c1fd5da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The scale of the attack is still almost incomprehensible in its cruelty. Families were burned alive in their homes, women were raped and mutilated, and 379 people were hunted down at the Nova music festival-- billed as a celebration of peace and love. For perspective, Nova killed 6x as many people as the deadliest mass shooting in American history--also an attack on a music festival, in Las Vegas in 2017--which killed 60 people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/87b941d6-5500-4ff6-97f0-c5d8b575add7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Photos of Israelis murdered at the Nova music festival on October 7, 2023, are posted at the site of the massacre, in southern Israel's Re'im, January 16, 2025. (Chaim Goldberg/Flash90)
This year is more hopeful, as it will mark the first anniversary of the return of the remaining 20 living hostages who spent more than two years in Hamas captivity. Many of them were held in the squalor of underground tunnels for their entire capture.
Among those hostages released was [Omri Miran](https://substack.com/redirect/e97058b8-9c04-4280-adad-b17360ad7d11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the brother in law of one of my former Wharton students, Moshe Lavi. (You can find his newly launched [Substack](https://substack.com/@mosheemiliolavi?utm_source=global-search) here.)
Moshe shared the following words with me:
> For two years, October 7 never truly ended for our family, as our odyssey, and that of an entire nation, continued. Omri remained in Gaza, while my sister Lishay and their daughters Roni and Alma waited for him at home. This year, the grief and scars remain, but something fundamental has changed: Omri is home, our family is whole again, and after 738 days of fighting for his return, and 843 for the return of the last remaining hostage, we are finally learning how to live beyond October 7, rather than inside it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fae0a6b3-4271-453e-9d1f-aee742ae3766?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Me with the Wharton Veterans Club, March 2023. Moshe Lavi to the right of me.
While the release of the hostages closed one painful chapter, the political and humanitarian crisis left behind in Gaza remains an unresolved problem. What began on October 7 as an Israeli national catastrophe became a war that decimated Gaza and transformed the politics of the Middle East.
As we reflect on the third anniversary of this horrific tragedy, many will also rightly reckon with the scale of the response by Netanyahu's Likud-led government and the devastation it has wrought in Gaza. [More than 70,000 Gazans have been killed](https://substack.com/redirect/8f7a1c00-829b-4768-a143-c7b8ea5fa26e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the resulting war and nearly the entire population of its 2 million residents was displaced at some point, with [more than 371,000 housing units damaged or destroyed](https://substack.com/redirect/02a4c433-f2ec-41b4-8528-f785529c06e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Rebuilding Gaza is now estimated to cost more than [$71 billion over the next decade](https://substack.com/redirect/17d371ef-0fbf-4888-944c-ea684c825cbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The political shockwave of this war has rippled across the Middle East and the Western world. American politics hasn't been the same since. This has essentially become one of the defining political and moral fault lines of our time. Support for Israel--or opposition to it-- has become a kind of ideological sorting mechanism. And for prominent Jewish politicians, it's most glaring.
Since 2024, Governor Josh Shapiro of Pennsylvania has been smeared by some antizionist activists as ["Genocide Josh"](https://substack.com/redirect/d9bc45b8-af39-4361-87aa-f709faf4242f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an especially stupid nickname when you consider the minor detail that the governor of Pennsylvania does not control the federal budget or, last I checked, the IDF. The insult isn't supposed to make sense, though. It's an explicitly antisemitic slur to demonize the Jewish governor as having [dual loyalty - to his faith and America](https://substack.com/redirect/3ea6f321-c543-4216-a74b-6ddddf908a0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - an old and cheap trope that treats Jews as inherently suspect to whatever country they belong to. Governor Shapiro has repeatedly criticized Netanyahu, calling him "[one of the worst leaders of all time](https://substack.com/redirect/023b793c-ab44-464c-a324-bb5ed4dbecc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in 2024 and in 2025, demanding [more humanitarian aid for Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/0b2d7754-df98-46a9-a422-8225c8e8cfbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Those kinds of targeted slurs against Jewish leaders have ramifications. We saw that in 2025, when Shapiro's official residence was firebombed on the first night of Passover. The arsonist did so in the name of Gaza. It bears repeating that an American governor has exactly zero authority over American foreign policy. I [wrote about this](https://substack.com/redirect/1ffa56b6-91e2-4104-8423-f9b9ba27ccc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the time, and how it reflects a broader trend in political violence. A recent poll from the _[Philadelphia Inquirer](https://substack.com/redirect/b2f7b2e6-bf3b-484e-96ec-b7a42c72731d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _shows that Shapiro is popular in his home state, yet PA voters are evenly split on if he should run for President in 2028.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aaabccfa-e07b-4d0a-8e6e-b265233dfcaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/790c17f3-4d88-4869-a917-d05de96f8f87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My niece Ryan, daughter Maggie, partner Genine Fallon, Gov. Shapiro, me, and son Jack.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/00306478-1db3-42f6-a353-f2fda6a5ff3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's a clip of me from a few years ago speaking out against Hamas and the devestating toll in Gaza.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4e5b7f93-e31b-45c3-bcb0-adfc17a59868?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
One can argue politics all day. What is much harder is to find the appropriate action moving forward.
As part of the 2025 negotiations to end the war in Gaza and return the hostages, President Trump proposed an ambitious [20-point plan](https://substack.com/redirect/e6ace833-12d2-475d-b8ce-0e614e66d59c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) backed by a ['Board of Peace'](https://substack.com/redirect/3fd295ab-05d5-401e-8829-3a454ac9a688?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with over two dozen founding countries. This independent entity was meant to oversee Gaza's postwar transition pairing a Palestinian technocratic government with an [International Stabilization Force (ISF)](https://substack.com/redirect/f445f2d3-04cb-410d-ad95-d6985d364782?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with a phased Israeli withdrawal and plan for Hamas's disarmament. This plan was later endorsed by the UN and formally launched at Davos in Jan 2026. Yet, here we are, a year later and most of that plan has not been implemented. Hamas has not disarmed and Israel has not withdrawn. Most of the technocrats have not stepped foot in Gaza and the ISF barely exists.
> | [](https://substack.com/redirect/7ace4878-5f55-4c40-9e01-82ddf8dfe819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So, what exactly is being done?

The political incentives to make progress should be obvious for both Trump and Netanyahu ahead of the U.S. midterms in November and Israel's October 27 election. Trump badly needs a foreign-policy win as the unpopular Iran war weighs on his presidency. And Netanyahu is fighting for his own political survival.
If Gaza is to have a future, Hamas cannot remain in power. Ahmed Fouad Alkhatib, a Gazan American who has lost 33 immediate and extended family members in Israeli airstrikes, courageously made this case in the _[New York TImes](https://substack.com/redirect/c370cf24-1015-4921-aabb-36e22175381c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_. Hamas has brought ruin to the people it claims to represent while silencing and killing Palestinian dissent.
Removing Hamas, however, only works if a credible political solution replaces it.
That is one lesson I learned from serving in Iraq. Destroying the old order is much easier than building the next one. If Gazans are left with rubble, unemployment, and no political future, another extremist movement will eventually fill the vacuum. Reconstruction therefore cannot be treated as charity handed out after the security questions are settled. It is part of the security strategy itself - much like the Marshall Plan after WWII, in which the U.S. paired European reconstruction with the broader goal of political stability and security.
* * *
Thank you for reading and caring enough about these issues to sit with the complexity instead of reaching for the easiest answer. I'm grateful to have thoughtful readers willing to engage with them in good faith.

Hamas has not disarmed and Israel has not withdrawn. Most of the technocrats have not stepped foot in Gaza and the ISF barely exists. | | ---|---|--- So, what exactly is being done? The political incentives to make progress should be obvious for both Trump and Netanyahu ahead of the U.S. midterms in November and Israel's October 27 election. Trump badly needs a foreign-policy win as the unpopular Iran war weighs on his presidency. And Netanyahu is fighting for his own political survival. If Gaza is to have a future, Hamas cannot remain in power. Ahmed Fouad Alkhatib, a Gazan American who has lost 33 immediate and extended family members in Israeli airstrikes, courageously made this case in the . Hamas has brought ruin to the people it claims to represent while silencing and killing Palestinian dissent. Removing Hamas, however, only works if a credible political solution replaces it. That is one lesson I learned from serving in Iraq. Destroying the old order is much easier than building the next one. If Gazans are left with rubble, unemployment, and no political future, another extremist movement will eventually fill the vacuum. Reconstruction therefore cannot be treated as charity handed out after the security questions are settled. It is part of the security strategy itself - much like the Marshall Plan after WWII, in which the U.S. paired European reconstruction with the broader goal of political stability and security. Thank you for reading and caring enough about these issues to sit with the complexity instead of reaching for the easiest answer. I'm grateful to have thoughtful readers willing to engage with them in good faith. If you value my work, please consider subscribing. Dear Friend,
**I was elected to serve the people of Riverside County, not Sacramento.** My job is to look under every rock and leave no stone unturned, even if the powers that lie in Sacramento don’t like it.
How can voters trust our elections when the state’s highest court authorizes the AG to to shut down investigations and destroy evidence. Thats the real threat to democracy
Ask yourself: **Who destroys evidence? Criminals.**
---
| [Watch Chad on OAN](https://us.list-manage.com/2TCRb3LV63A?e=1facf02470&c2id=205919520b3860dafbe9b9f5dda2019d)
---
| | | | | | The unfortunate news for Bonta is that I will be re-elected to serve as Sheriff, and I will continue to investigate fraud no matter where—or to whom—it leads. Additionally, my team and I are exploring our options to appeal this ruling and are seeking assistance from the federal courts.
I am humbly asking you to support my re-election. Above money, I ask for your prayers. I will leave you with this: The establishment fears an informed and mobilized voter. Elections can only maintain their integrity if we show up and vote.
**Please contribute today to help us fight back.**
Thank you,Sheriff Chad Bianco

# [A shadow budget just bought France its biggest bond rally](https://substack.com/redirect/34cb1002-54bf-49b9-807c-4b924d3b5163?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Marine Le Pen's shadow budget pulled the French 10-year yield down 12 basis points to 4.74% on Tuesday, even as Paris already borrows at a higher cost than Greece and Italy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34cb1002-54bf-49b9-807c-4b924d3b5163?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Her deficit path:** The National Rally outline aims at 3.7% of output next year versus a government target near 5%, then 2.2% by 2032. The savings are meant to come from a smaller state, a thinner check to Brussels and less money spent on migration. She said France could face default if current policy continues, and that the ECB should ease borrowing costs.
* **A low bar:** UBS said the plan would hold the deficit under 5% from 2027, cut more than €140 billion, and get under 3% by 2032 at the latest. Goldman's Rich Privorotsky said OATs "have already done an enormous amount" with the election still months away, so "the bar for a positive surprise feels low."
* **The stock of debt:** A Wall Street Journal report said the 10-year cost has risen toward 5%, the highest since 2002, and that the deficit is exceeded only by the United States among peers. More than $1 trillion comes due by 2030, with about $380 billion set to be sold next year. Debt is nearly 120% of GDP.
* **No budget since 1974:** Debt service is expected to climb 59% by 2030. Kevin Thozet of Carmignac said France "has gotten away with fiscal murder" until "people have started to notice." Centrist Sylvain Maillard called the habit "always asking the state for a bit of magic money."

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34cb1002-54bf-49b9-807c-4b924d3b5163?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **His warning:** Haldane told CNBC that "nothing would be worse both economically and politically than if the ice were to crack," and that the government should "appease financial markets" by showing it will "take the knife to public spending."
* **Burnham bind:** He called spending the government's "Achilles' heel" and said Prime Minister Andy Burnham will remain "in hock to the bond market" until cuts arrive. Burnham, who replaced Keir Starmer over the summer, has used that phrase himself.
* **Cost rank:** Britain has the highest government borrowing costs in the G7. Haldane said inflation is higher and stickier, growth lower, and the books have not balanced this century.
* **Budget open items:** Finance minister John Healey wants a fiscal "buffer against uncertainty." Burnham has not ruled out tax rises, and the press has floated a bank windfall levy that Jamie Dimon lobbied against last month.

# [Altman: Accept some bad AI outcomes for the upside](https://substack.com/redirect/34cb1002-54bf-49b9-807c-4b924d3b5163?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI's Sam Altman told Politico on Sunday the world should accept some AI harms so people keep broad access, while still agreeing labs must pace frontier models.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/34cb1002-54bf-49b9-807c-4b924d3b5163?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Agency vs harm:** "We believe that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency," he said in Politico's Decoded newsletter.
* **Against a lockup:** He said there is "a lot of daylight" between OpenAI and Anthropic, whose chief executive Dario Amodei has urged a slowdown. A single San Francisco lab holding the technology and doling out benefits would be "a completely unacceptable trade-off."
* **No zero-harm deal:** Altman said he would not trade a guarantee of no major hacks, misuse or scams, because people will do "orders of magnitude more" good than bad. OpenAI still backs a lighter-touch rulebook.
* **Shared ground:** He has also agreed that labs should "pace the frontier" so alignment stays ahead of capability, and that independent third parties should have employee-like access to monitor training and report incidents.

Meridian names: Luckey was named days earlier to Project Meridian, a Pentagon effort to identify capabilities for future conflicts. Newt Gingrich and Elon Musk are also on the group. Marc Andreessen and Blake Masters joined the defense policy board this summer. Who still builds: General Dynamics Electric Boat and Huntington Ingalls Industries build the boats. General Dynamics won a $76.6 billion Navy submarine award this summer. Nvidia is back at a record and just shy of a $5.8 trillion market value, on track to be the first $6 trillion company after a 28% gain this year. | | ---|---|--- Year 's swing: The rally has added $1.2 trillion of market value in 2026, after the stock was down 11% for the year on March 30. Nvidia is the biggest contributor to the S&P 500's 14% gain. Buyback and quote: The company authorized another $150 billion under its repurchase program. Jensen Huang said the step "reflects our confidence in the long-term opportunity ahead." Jim Awad of Clearstead Advisors, which owns the shares, said Nvidia "looks like a haven from any damage higher rates could do to the economy." Monday tape: IBD said Nvidia rose 2.1% to 238.90, a fourth straight higher close, and joined the Big Cap 20 list. It bottomed at 189.80 on June 29 and led 17 names onto the firm's best-stock lists. Rate shelter: Larry Tentarelli of Blue Chip Daily said money is rotating back into semiconductors and megacaps because they look more resistant if rates stay high. Former Bank of England chief economist Andy Haldane said Britain is skating on thin ice before the Oct. 28 budget and must cut spending to calm the gilt market. | | ---|---|--- His warning: Haldane told CNBC that "nothing would be worse both economically and politically than if the ice were to crack," and that the government should "appease financial markets" by showing it will "take the knife to public spending." Burnham bind: He called spending the government's "Achilles' heel" and said Prime Minister Andy Burnham will remain "in hock to the bond market" until cuts arrive. Burnham, who replaced Keir Starmer over the summer, has used that phrase himself. Cost rank: Britain has the highest government borrowing costs in the G7. Haldane said inflation is higher and stickier, growth lower, and the books have not balanced this century. Budget open items: Finance minister John Healey wants a fiscal "buffer against uncertainty." Burnham has not ruled out tax rises, and the press has floated a bank windfall levy that Jamie Dimon lobbied against last month. Vice President JD Vance on Monday unveiled $150 million in Defense Production Act funding for a second high-voltage line linking south-central and interior Alaska, covering most of the state. | | ---|---|--- Funding split: The Beluga-Healy project also draws $268 million already committed from non-federal sources. In his remarks Vance called it the Alaska Rail Belt Transmission Project and said it would "devote $400 million" to more than 200 miles of line. Who it serves: Officials said the link would lower costs and firm reliability for 75% of Alaska's population. Wright line: Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Tuesday the project supports a military expansion already underway in Alaska plus mining tied to national security, and thanked Sen. Dan Sullivan. Earlier use: Earlier this year the administration used the same act to order an oil company to restart shuttered offshore operations in California. OpenAI's Sam Altman told Politico on Sunday the world should accept some AI harms so people keep broad access, while still agreeing labs must pace frontier models. | | ---|---|--- Agency vs harm: "We believe that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency," he said in Politico's Decoded newsletter. Against a lockup: He said there is "a lot of daylight" between OpenAI and Anthropic, whose chief executive Dario Amodei has urged a slowdown. A single San Francisco lab holding the technology and doling out benefits would be "a completely unacceptable trade-off." No zero-harm deal: Altman said he would not trade a guarantee of no major hacks, misuse or scams, because people will do "orders of magnitude more" good than bad. OpenAI still backs a lighter-touch rulebook. Shared ground: He has also agreed that labs should "pace the frontier" so alignment stays ahead of capability, and that independent third parties should have employee-like access to monitor training and report incidents. | Peter, early voting in New York opens on October 24. That gives us 18 days before the first ballots in this race are cast.
October 24 is also the last day to register to vote in this election, so for the next two and a half weeks our volunteers are doing two jobs at once. They're out talking with voters about Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and stronger unions, and they're making sure the neighbors who just moved in or just turned 18 get registered before the deadline passes.
Organizing taught me that a vote is usually won in the conversations that happen weeks before it, and this is that stretch of the calendar. Once early voting starts, the window to reach someone for the first time gets a lot smaller.
So I'm asking you to help us out today.

1. If you're eligible, [will you check your current voter registration status now to make sure you're ready to vote in this year's midterms?](https://irrem7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gFcHbSMtEfsPeXqH0vpsKnOTNFKK3HnemzeVka-gwxOM1xA4AUBspShExIoen01Y7bUH1KOGIExq3tMJXepXXXt3BQ07LYlljuKY-4WgrUwNLHZpnF8pP1Ht106mWo3KuMFHk-MGEKc8Wx6eFxafTvDtA82mxcm-X9wrkVz5uOs=&c=lmNLNxzEg68QgdDscUXFh_fyQOJO96VJUmewh-zJOtKrgR6lZmKXyQ==&ch=QF_Mt09qwpRdrZPC7l6T7lhOayCk4xq7xiJk0mUIt9QtwriT5SL4pg==)

2. [Will you consider joining our team for one of our upcoming volunteer events?](https://irrem7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001gFcHbSMtEfsPeXqH0vpsKnOTNFKK3HnemzeVka-gwxOM1xA4AUBspShExIoen01Yh8a46nyBn6J3U968J5lBWbAbL_aHmbO90zg63Cof54qUHtIhQ84R83TABXLoQMq9O-ZdiHVcId0jX5KpZzakS0pZZyz8aB64Ark_0KdvvOLIyIutXksPBg==&c=lmNLNxzEg68QgdDscUXFh_fyQOJO96VJUmewh-zJOtKrgR6lZmKXyQ==&ch=QF_Mt09qwpRdrZPC7l6T7lhOayCk4xq7xiJk0mUIt9QtwriT5SL4pg==)

Dear Friend of Liberty,

As we approach America's 250th anniversary, I have a question for you: **what story will the next generation learn about our country?**

You're an intelligent and civically engaged person. So, you know that right now, far too many colleges and universities teach young people a distorted view of America--as if our nation were built on injustice instead of liberty.

This false story robs college students--our future leaders--of a proper understanding of our American heritage and weakens the informed patriotism that preserves our freedom.

**But you can change that --and receive "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope," one of our most popular online courses, as a DVD box set--for FREE.**

Taught by historian Wilfred McClay and based on his published history of America, "**The Great American Story: A Land of Hope** " presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. It's a magnificent course, perfect for in-home viewing or with a small study group.

We produced this course to help restore intelligent patriotism, especially in young people, which is essential for the survival of free government.

For me, I always know we’re getting close to the general election when it’s time for the annual Twin Cities Marathon. I just ran the 10-mile with my daughter, Hope, on a beautiful fall morning, and it’s got me thinking about the upcoming midterms.

Through Small Town PAC, I’m working to help elect a new generation of Democratic leaders who will stand up for their small towns and take on Trump and his billionaire robber barons exploiting our communities. This is our very first election since we launched, so it’s time to show the strength of our people power.

Tim

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Gv9tSD6cAps?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=6XgFlm4Crqt0vCjHV_6cvb2cjgIVeBsoS23gGVuFSvWCwu8iVvI9XaKNDw==)

**Pappas and Shaheen Turn to Washington Democrats to Boost Their Campaigns**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** October 6th, 2026
---
| | | **CONTACT** karina@nhrsc.com

---
| |
**CONCORD, N.H. —** Today, Chris Pappas and Stefany Shaheen are bringing Raphael Warnock to New Hampshire to campaign alongside them. New Hampshire Republican State Committee Chairman Scott Maltzie released the following statement:“Raphael Warnock is one of the most liberal members of the United States Senate,” **said NHGOP Chairman Scott Maltzie.** “If Chris Pappas is truly the ‘moderate’ Democrats claim he is, his decision to campaign alongside Warnock tells Granite Staters exactly where he stands and how he would vote in the Senate. Stefany Shaheen is also turning to her Washington allies to prop up her campaign, bringing in a senator who voted with Joe Biden more than 96% of the time and supports packing the Supreme Court. It’s clear Pappas and Shaheen are out of touch with Granite Staters and are turning to radical Washington Democrats instead of offering a vision that reflects New Hampshire’s priorities.”
Here are just some of the extreme views of Raphael Warnock:
1. [Attacked](https://us.list-manage.com/p2Rhu5hbXnh?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=jVm9Os7ElwihU9vYIGW4i_pZ3ZZmBlp7e8cRFoaB6DZ6dirHZssm9mPbSg==) police officers as “gangster[s] and thug[s].”
2. Said he’s [“sick and tired”](https://us.list-manage.com/C4mSmS4VPpG?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=nBYm1EUobUughklDAXotSfPHo5L8wpUFu-S6dGAxHinEa5n9RQE3_49KSQ==) of hearing criticism of socialism.
3. Called Black Lives Matter [“a great and marvelous new militancy.”](https://us.list-manage.com/fqRVCX8CdaD?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=ahGQcUBVFHZAD1j4MB_u62vyztWe8yJL2IW086a12WWgH3-DPIGWisMtHA==)
4. Labeled Republican senators [“gangsters and thugs”](https://us.list-manage.com/12BQ8RYIQSO?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=vaal7E15Ho1JDtTbqz5UdvpkYYBM_ZEv-NBgpxWVnz3tOVr9ndErt_z2yg==) for passing tax cuts.
5. [Refused](https://us.list-manage.com/DA8_ZbEtB7z?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=onDzxKRnSYhsq_8WlXg8srsRZxElUVBgqPz55CuKVALMdVdf1vSdQHTUsQ==) to pay expenses for his own children, then [used](https://us.list-manage.com/11_F1lCnebr?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=O5N6vMIhiNY6_GdImesO5aKPVw2lTheipe7ISfWmm_gEgaMkbb3oaog4yw==) his campaign funds to do so.
6. [Doubled](https://us.list-manage.com/heYS9XUp_0R?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=1W2ZuOJlVdMOi9wgZRxhhNnsn6O-mpoQueyglvesvA4FWGX_qkA9IfCZpQ==) his income after just 18 months in office — a practice he previously [decried](https://us.list-manage.com/NmTc5Cg7u39?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=8VZ_0CvIts49ZBZScYuZayKpasdfIXliL71TW94urwb68Nlb3dk1fe7fUA==).
7. [Dodged](https://us.list-manage.com/27L6Iy679LO?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=hzfutirYoffQRucbouT-hR2T9jdcD6IGoll4lCmVb7PV0dY3H3it8EP_Ew==) income taxes on his inflated salary thanks to an [“unusual”](https://us.list-manage.com/jQVnPDZnKDg?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=Q7AtgVCWAGIeMKylpYqmC_m6GgBfddzmZu5dBHn3oqYEz-rXkwdoXzkFcw==) financial arrangement with his church.
8. Voted with Joe Biden more than [96](https://us.list-manage.com/15aZHIFYTMW?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=40QSzos-l_BPIgx8lBFFcu6cYdciWzPLEnTZH_WfpF2XFLNSjJFVvsS4lQ==) percent of the time.
9. [Flip-flopped](https://us.list-manage.com/n_B17uswLZk?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=hwMaiVT539sgIRJSC-cBVAz5izKyukbabcWWaV2F9X8J6iPQwrOXUdfIxg==) on voter ID when it was politically expedient.
10. He [supports](https://us.list-manage.com/RuGrdUThR4u?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=jmvC--uKhG8XoGytymCjjF0vgdPlZMka7sQkP5P88lSvEYPXJWJUFI0f5A==) packing the Supreme Court with far-left activist justices.
11. [Won’t support](https://us.list-manage.com/18TfAZPC0jp?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=4SBk-hmdm_SMPtSLlzVnwfxowX29vfxwAhBeSpaGhpzndDokRIakPE_dFw==) American energy independence or [expanding](https://us.list-manage.com/NruWksDJr5h?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=qGNCTtkj4OVwt6NLiWyu9jxnPTvSQdl_HxPImuDHLfZUNiE5hOvcn0HS6w==) American energy production.
12. Warnock [voted](https://us.list-manage.com/10Ze2VPXZrB?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=G6nlsRkG40029VtxG0xnbyqZitBjmP3buyf8OI_mDf7QWpKnBYdm07diCQ==) to [raise taxes](https://us.list-manage.com/197dwvWTqfW?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=sUT-Wk3H5RQIgNhwjokC08WKcGCvm1BHw8-966L6LD5B-eLe2RMGALOjbg==) on small businesses and middle class Americans, [hire 87,000 new IRS agents](https://us.list-manage.com/EDlxgNCLCHs?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=ar7Ilvvopzz_EBEMt0fh8VQlSMR5I0e6h1A75voVFBIM060TENGpT8Mgaw==), and [worsen inflation](https://us.list-manage.com/PdpqY26bbVV?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=ccv6zcA1CPPDSQ8xnnQ0nhMCNsTFqhCfjbAcCQPeYR1DER5360nBg2SDtw==).
13. [Voted](https://us.list-manage.com/7G2MClSOKqG?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=_DDeMiQ44wGkSGU1BbskAf5pyaVBgl2i4HdqvIXm7HrwRotS-dQQ1kJp2Q==) to send taxpayer-funded stimulus checks to violent criminals in prison.
14. Warnock [repeatedly voted](https://us.list-manage.com/V6tSleFxa3O?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=-P1_Y9KXAUR_DKxd7NMhYM937wDjwqN3y2nDFOqL8RhlS817sQVg3DpSDw==) against border security.
15. Warnock [rubbed elbows](https://us.list-manage.com/FwhOyMT8MiD?e=f3aa6419cd&c2id=cbe815d8d4829b0196839495b093775b&m=7BtFgrUZJVe_-GcDN6D1P7jZ8sRooq4RaPRierXLzfgSsFBROa0edzw8wQ==) with “Green New Deal”-obsessed billionaires.

##### A researcher at a Russian plague lab is dead, nearly 200 people around her were tested, and Moscow is telling everyone to stay calm. Meanwhile, the people whose job was to spot a threat like this before it reached us have been fired.
##### Behind the paywall, David Shuster walks through what happens if a case lands here: who's left at the CDC to notice it, what the latest budget cut does to an emergency response, and why it's much easier to fire a disease detective than to replace one in the middle of an outbreak.

* * *
There are few things more disturbing than the Trump administration dismantling the scientific safeguards, monitoring, and government agencies that keep us alive.
But here we are.
Over the past year, Old Man Orange, RFK Jr. and their lunatic sycophants cut 25 percent of the staff and laboratories at the Centers for Disease Control. The Trumpsters eliminated a third of all senior CDC leadership and ended several teams whose primary responsibility was to track, analyze, and block deadly pathogens that could be part of the next global pandemic.
That pandemic may be approaching.
Russian authorities are investigating the death of a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute who developed pneumonia of unknown origin.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d7162721-b466-4770-8976-28e2eef17ffa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A Russian agency that deals with "emergencies" has been meeting, reviewing the lab death, and trying to track the potential exposure.
The Trump administration says officials are "monitoring the situation."

* * *
Last night I went on Chris Cuomo's show on NewsNation to debate Ben Ferguson about the economy. If you don't know Ferguson, he's Ted Cruz's podcast co-host and one of the most prolific interrupters in cable news. He's the king of it. He thinks he can neg you into submission by talking over you. We've tussled before, so I knew what I was walking into.
But this time he made me angry, and not for the usual reasons.
It wasn't the lying, though there was plenty of it. Republicans keep lying mercilessly about the state of the economy and trying to gaslight people into believing everything is fine. Ferguson spent most of his time sounding unbelievably out of touch, desperately defending the president and the Republican Party ahead of midterms that, by every measurable account, look like a disaster for the GOP.
And it wasn't the interrupting, though he did that constantly.
It was this: In the middle of our argument, while he rattled off economic statistics that weren't even right, I tried to bring the conversation back to how regular Americans are actually experiencing this economy. People are telling us they can't afford their goddamn grocery bill. That's when he said two things I can't stop thinking about.
First, he accused the American people of being "emotional" about the economy. As if your own personal economy isn't emotional. As if the fear of not making rent is some kind of overreaction.
Second, he essentially called me anti-American. He said I was rooting for America to fail because I hate Donald Trump so much.
Both claims are idiotic and offensive. But they're also a perfect example of what Donald Trump has done to the Republican Party. If you don't agree with them, with their vision of the world, their policies, everything they want to do, then you must hate America. Because in their minds, they're the only ones who love it. They wrap themselves in the flag and claim it belongs to them, not to us. They steal our symbols and our patriotism and use them to justify their corruption, their destruction, and their chaos.
I'm tired of it. So I called him out.
Here's what I believe: The people who tell you that you hate America, who tell you you're being emotional because you're angry, they're the ones who are anti-patriotic. You have every right to be angry. You can't afford your groceries. You've watched the American dream slip further away. You've stood at the pump watching the numbers climb to $80, $90, $100 just to fill your tank.
The people dismissing that are the ones who hate this country. They hate the people of this country. They think so little of you that they believe they can get away with these lies. They treat you with that much disrespect.
Every decision made inside Trump's administration gets made without a single thought about what it will do to your life, because they don't fucking care about you. They care about themselves. Donald Trump cares about putting money in his pocket, not yours. Growing his net worth, not yours. And the hacks who defend him on TV care about their proximity to power, their influence, and their own contracts. They don't care about you. They don't care about me. They don't even care about their own voters.

That's a big part of why the bottom is falling out for Republicans right now. They're on defense, and not just in battleground states like Michigan. They're on defense in red states. There's a reason Democrats look competitive in Kansas, Ohio, Iowa, Texas, Florida, Mississippi, and so many other places nobody could have imagined a year and a half ago. Republicans abandoned the very people who elected them, let alone the rest of us they still have a responsibility to serve. They simply don't care. The arrogance is staggering. You can smell the desperation.
I've been stewing on this. Not in the way they want me to, not in some "ooh, I triggered a lefty" way. I'm stewing because I can't believe people who claim to value public service, who say they care about others, would treat their fellow Americans like this.
I don't show up to these conversations looking for a fight. I would be delighted to have a real, honest conversation about the economy and how we fix it, with anybody. When I started doing this, my motto was that I'd talk to anyone. I didn't care how problematic they were or how big their audience was. I reach out to as many people as I can, including people I don't particularly like. You've seen me do it. There's a reason I had Clavicular on my show a few months ago. Pure love of the game, and a real belief that talking to each other is how we close these divides.
So I can't get past it. The last arrow in your quiver is calling someone anti-American for telling the truth about the economy? You're going to scream GDP numbers at me while people tell you they can't pay their bills? It was ridiculous. Chris handled it well, like a lot of the folks who run these shows do. But it's maddening in this moment.
During the segment, Chris put up a statistic showing the average American doesn't have $1,000 saved for an emergency. That floored me.
I came home last night and my wife told me our washer and dryer are on their last legs and we'll probably have to replace them. Thanks to the tariffs, that's going to run about $1,500. We'll be fine. We're a dual-income household and we've done well for ourselves. But for the average person, that bill would be a wrecking ball. It would force impossible choices: the medication or the rent. Whether they can take a family trip this year.
That is not okay. And it is fundamentally anti-American to let so many people have so little and struggle so much while they work so damn hard.
You know they're working hard. You're working hard. And you deserve better than these people. You deserve better than the hacks who will call you anti-American for feeling what you feel, for seeing it with your own eyes, hearing it with your own ears, holding it in your own hands.
You deserve better. And if we elect a Democratic Congress in November, and we do it right, it'll be the beginning of taking this country back.
With urgency,
--Mike

Then like, share, and keep showing up in the comments. It matters more than you know. Last night I went on Chris Cuomo's show on NewsNation to debate Ben Ferguson about the economy. If you don't know Ferguson, he's Ted Cruz's podcast co-host and one of the most prolific interrupters in cable news. He's the king of it. He thinks he can neg you into submission by talking over you. We've tussled before, so I knew what I was walking into. But this time he made me angry, and not for the usual reasons. It wasn't the lying, though there was plenty of it. Republicans keep lying mercilessly about the state of the economy and trying to gaslight people into believing everything is fine. Ferguson spent most of his time sounding unbelievably out of touch, desperately defending the president and the Republican Party ahead of midterms that, by every measurable account, look like a disaster for the GOP. And it wasn't the interrupting, though he did that constantly. It was this: In the middle of our argument, while he rattled off economic statistics that weren't even right, I tried to bring the conversation back to how regular Americans are actually experiencing this economy. People are telling us they can't afford their goddamn grocery bill. That's when he said two things I can't stop thinking about. First, he accused the American people of being "emotional" about the economy. As if your own personal economy isn't emotional. As if the fear of not making rent is some kind of overreaction. Second, he essentially called me anti-American. He said I was rooting for America to fail because I hate Donald Trump so much. Both claims are idiotic and offensive. But they're also a perfect example of what Donald Trump has done to the Republican Party. If you don't agree with them, with their vision of the world, their policies, everything they want to do, then you must hate America. Because in their minds, they're the only ones who love it. They wrap themselves in the flag and claim it belongs to them, not to us. They steal our symbols and our patriotism and use them to justify their corruption, their destruction, and their chaos. I'm tired of it. So I called him out. Here's what I believe: The people who tell you that you hate America, who tell you you're being emotional because you're angry, they're the ones who are anti-patriotic. You have every right to be angry. You can't afford your groceries. You've watched the American dream slip further away. You've stood at the pump watching the numbers climb to $80, $90, $100 just to fill your tank. The people dismissing that are the ones who hate this country. They hate the people of this country. They think so little of you that they believe they can get away with these lies. They treat you with that much disrespect. Every decision made inside Trump's administration gets made without a single thought about what it will do to your life, because they don't fucking care about you. They care about themselves. Donald Trump cares about putting money in his pocket, not yours. Growing his net worth, not yours. And the hacks who defend him on TV care about their proximity to power, their influence, and their own contracts. They don't care about you. They don't care about me. They don't even care about their own voters. * That's a big part of why the bottom is falling out for Republicans right now. They're on defense, and not just in battleground states like Michigan. They're on defense in red states. There's a reason Democrats look competitive in Kansas, Ohio, Iowa, Texas, Florida, Mississippi, and so many other places nobody could have imagined a year and a half ago. Republicans abandoned the very people who elected them, let alone the rest of us they still have a responsibility to serve. They simply don't care. The arrogance is staggering. You can smell the desperation. I've been stewing on this. Not in the way they want me to, not in some "ooh, I triggered a lefty" way. I'm stewing because I can't believe people who claim to value public service, who say they care about others, would treat their fellow Americans like this. I don't show up to these conversations looking for a fight. I would be delighted to have a real, honest conversation about the economy and how we fix it, with anybody. When I started doing this, my motto was that I'd talk to anyone. I didn't care how problematic they were or how big their audience was. I reach out to as many people as I can, including people I don't particularly like. You've seen me do it. There's a reason I had Clavicular on my show a few months ago. Pure love of the game, and a real belief that talking to each other is how we close these divides. So I can't get past it. The last arrow in your quiver is calling someone anti-American for telling the truth about the economy? You're going to scream GDP numbers at me while people tell you they can't pay their bills? It was ridiculous. Chris handled it well, like a lot of the folks who run these shows do. But it's maddening in this moment. During the segment, Chris put up a statistic showing the average American doesn't have $1,000 saved for an emergency. That floored me. I came home last night and my wife told me our washer and dryer are on their last legs and we'll probably have to replace them. Thanks to the tariffs, that's going to run about $1,500. We'll be fine. We're a dual-income household and we've done well for ourselves. But for the average person, that bill would be a wrecking ball. It would force impossible choices: the medication or the rent. Whether they can take a family trip this year. That is not okay. And it is fundamentally anti-American to let so many people have so little and struggle so much while they work so damn hard. You know they're working hard. You're working hard. And you deserve better than these people. You deserve better than the hacks who will call you anti-American for feeling what you feel, for seeing it with your own eyes, hearing it with your own ears, holding it in your own hands. You deserve better. And if we elect a Democratic Congress in November, and we do it right, it'll be the beginning of taking this country back. **Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41596%2E3422442%2E31U9X8)
Peter,
Today marks just four weeks left until the midterm elections, but that doesn’t mean we have four weeks until ballots are cast.
Many states offer early voting and vote-by-mail. That’s good for our democracy, but it gives campaigns in close races an extra challenge: reaching the voters they need to win _before_ they cast a ballot.
Many of the candidates on our [2026 slate](https://act.katieporter.com/go/22173?t=2&akid=41596%2E3422442%2E31U9X8) don’t have until November to reach voters— _they have to get to them right now._
Winning back the House and Senate will come down to razor-thin margins in places like California, Michigan, and New York. A few thousand people voting before talking to an organizer or seeing an ad could be the difference between real progress and Republican control of Congress.
That’s why we’re in an all-out push to help our candidates reach voters. The more grassroots support we build, the more resources we can give our candidates to help them turn out voters. With time running out and so much at stake, I’m counting on you to step up today.

**Greg Landsman is a Liar**
---
| |
**CINCINNATI, OH** — Today, Conroy for Congress released the following statement after Greg Landsman’s latest bald-faced lie to voters about his stock-trading corruption. In a [recent interview](https://us.list-manage.com/18mCHgr53Kh?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566) with WCPO9, Landsman says, “Yeah, I sold my stocks...I put my money where my mouth is.” _**But he doesn’t remotely tell the full story.**_**The Truth:** Tripling his net worth: Landsman’s first personal financial disclosure filed April 5, 2022, listed six stock holdings worth 90,000 - 300,000 in related income. On January 24, 2025, nearly 3 years later, and four months after trading first drew coverage. He filed an amended 2022 Personal Financial Disclosure listing 56 holdings worth $ 466,052- $1.8 million. The top of his disclosed range grew by roughly $1.5 million.

Landsman also opened his general election with a [TV ad](https://us.list-manage.com/G8PWoE_4rMi?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566) claiming he’s outraged by congressional stock trading and got rid of his stocks. His own filings with the House Clerk tell a different story, and most of that paper trail hasn’t been reported.
**The Truth:** 87 late transactions. His August 2024 periodic transaction report covered 91 trades. 87 of those trades fell outside the required 45-day window and covered more than $1.4 million. Craig Holman of [Public Citizen](https://us.list-manage.com/pXIsSBgtxZf?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566) called it a STOCK Act violation. Todd Zinser, the former Commerce Department Inspector General, [filed an ethics complaint](https://us.list-manage.com/14UtKZMprOX?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566). Landsman said it was a mistake and that he doesn't handle his own trades.

On May 13, 2025, Landsman issued a [release:](https://us.list-manage.com/6gjW0Rum7q3?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566) “Landsman complies with The TRUST In Congress Act before it becomes law.” **The Truth:** The day of both a victory lap and the violation: The same day he filed a PTR disclosing an Exxon Mobil transaction 327 days past the deadline - a second STOCK Act violation- filed the day he declared himself clean.
Greg Landsman claims to be an ethics warrior, but he is really the worst of Washington: corrupt and dishonest. **The Truth:** On July 22, 2026, Landsman voted “Nay” on the “[Stop Insider Trading Act](https://us.list-manage.com/8qJvQsx276O?e=3f87e575ad&c2id=83ae238fa0f76420f201b2501cd8e566).”
“Greg Landsman continues to display a total arrogance and contempt for the voters he represents. He claims that he is cleaning up stock trading corruption, but only after he tripled his net worth in office. This corrupt liar has no place representing the people of Southwest Ohio.” - Collin Wojcik, Campaign Manager, Conroy for Congress.
**###**

Gutting the Roadless Rule is a disaster
Gutting the Roadless Rule is a disaster

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/X3heMItpRBkUVa1j-nfdIQ~~/AAUS1hA~/jYCvtKsLVnIV7JJg22O5px1AoCrEJrcbh2sSropCZs06AgcTA9hqMtdlYXU6ojfvIZbliuA9MBESTwWR1QOpTCYGaIGIcnSWrh2sxFp8pC4Birz7nDT2XucNTJlw_IRP)
| | | | Peter, Right now across the West, hunters are heading into the backcountry for elk season to fill their freezers. If you hunt, you know the most fundamental rule: you go where the roads aren't. Big game needs food, clean water, and secure cover—none of which exist when an industrial road is bulldozed through the timber. That is why the Roadless Rule was put in place: to protect 45 million acres of pristine backcountry in our national forests from corporate development. And it is overwhelmingly popular. When the government asked for feedback, a staggering 99% of public comments opposed stripping roadless protections. So what does the administration do when 99% of the public opposes handing our national forests over to the timber lobby? They refuse to hold public meetings. They slam the doors shut, lock out sportsmen and recreationists, and ram the rollback through behind closed doors because they know they would get laughed out of the room. [**They are trying to bulldoze 45 million acres of our best hunting and fishing grounds in secret. Will you pitch in $10 today to our rapid-response war chest so we can drag this corrupt giveaway into the light?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/dVbpsVqWn1lv9iHXv4t_VQ~~/AAUS1hA~/PuhqQ-HF47ST1LLT2vL8jDgrvNFZdd9U8SaYZ926MKQUtUDF0M2aILS-aieSvyUFynQOjdmFGLs-kRpyrg2gFck6q3QJI-HEWrBiT1LST9VRfIfsTHVcHdMYKq8vplfWsHZzmQ1XC3G8PZFWmaOnb8jKZ3-0YUhKAIl2ndybMurHuDj26ywFrMnoCFBonJ6LWBflKvC4210CUnmqVMPTS1TOM-ik1fuMVoDqT6NlpnyiygGqsAm5XaysOqye_sCJ) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/t7XnJQGZVEyuco5y7Y_9cQ~~/AAUS1hA~/fEcSDkLuNQko2c0UZ7BJX6j3W5o7Ilmnz9hHsLU6z3_HSegW2tzYWTWbv-PhMaVSM2hWuWctyQR_VQr-nUZjaJED2EKsHeOifext7U4lzdYgW-ECrlvDdYMHJiEHwNRavmKe0ONmd9HddlyzvUfteCcJvvvRJG60t1FCTLtpRKZVRhWKaRYNMRfwd3QJAv7TxQa-y1pek-MI-4qAWzWdIsMSE_7jJoSfXw3yb6Q2d6rxJtvouWxflp4F1AQraH2x) ** The corporate spin they are peddling to justify this heist is an insult to anyone who spends five minutes in the woods. First, they claim building more logging roads will reduce wildfires. It is total garbage. The science shows that 80% of human-caused wildfires start within a half-mile of a road. Roads bring the traffic and the sparks. Intact backcountry prevents fires; roads ignite them. Second, they claim we need more roads for the economy. The U.S. Forest Service already manages 371,000 miles of roads—eight times more than the entire Interstate Highway System—and sits on a staggering $6.1 billion maintenance backlog they can't even afford to fix. Meanwhile, the outdoor recreation economy generates $1.3 trillion in economic output every single year, with hunting and fishing driving over $107 billion. Our roadless backcountry is an economic powerhouse precisely because it is intact, wild, and accessible to every American. They aren't repealing the Roadless Rule to "manage" the forest. They are repealing it because former timber lobbyists running federal agencies want to reward their industry buddies with taxpayer-subsidized clear-cuts. They won't hold public hearings because they know outdoorsmen and women would take them to the woodshed. But while they can dodge a public hearing, they cannot dodge Election Day. With just one month until the midterms, we are going to ensure that every hunter, angler, and voter knows exactly who voted to clear-cut their favorite elk ridges. [**Will you chip in $10, $25, or $50 today to fund the counter-offensive and hold them accountable at the ballot box?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/t7XnJQGZVEyuco5y7Y_9cQ~~/AAUS1hA~/fEcSDkLuNQko2c0UZ7BJX6j3W5o7Ilmnz9hHsLU6z3_HSegW2tzYWTWbv-PhMaVSM2hWuWctyQR_VQr-nUZjaJED2EKsHeOifext7U4lzdYgW-ECrlvDdYMHJiEHwNRavmKe0ONmd9HddlyzvUfteCcJvvvRJG60t1FCTLtpRKZVRhWKaRYNMRfwd3QJAv7TxQa-y1pek-MI-4qAWzWdIsMSE_7jJoSfXw3yb6Q2d6rxJtvouWxflp4F1AQraH2x) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/t7XnJQGZVEyuco5y7Y_9cQ~~/AAUS1hA~/fEcSDkLuNQko2c0UZ7BJX6j3W5o7Ilmnz9hHsLU6z3_HSegW2tzYWTWbv-PhMaVSM2hWuWctyQR_VQr-nUZjaJED2EKsHeOifext7U4lzdYgW-ECrlvDdYMHJiEHwNRavmKe0ONmd9HddlyzvUfteCcJvvvRJG60t1FCTLtpRKZVRhWKaRYNMRfwd3QJAv7TxQa-y1pek-MI-4qAWzWdIsMSE_7jJoSfXw3yb6Q2d6rxJtvouWxflp4F1AQraH2x) ** They thought they could quietly lock out the public and auction off our hunting grounds to the highest bidder. Let's make sure it costs them their seats. You take our land—we take your seat. For the wild,

Every election cycle, political commentators love to talk about the "swing districts" that will decide the balance of power in Washington. But very few candidates actually embody the work ethic, background, and grit required to win and hold those high-stakes seats.
Enter Congressman Gabe Evans (CO-08).

Derek, it's Angie Nixon.
A grand jury report has raised serious questions about whether Ashley Moody knew about the diversion of $10 million intended for programs serving sick and needy children.
I've called on Moody to resign, because Floridians deserve real answers, not silence.
[**Can you split a donation between the DNC and me right now to help hold Ashley Moody accountable and power Democrats to victory in Florida and beyond?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-nixon-split?refcode=em_20261006_9697_fr&amount=20&refcode2=9697_22930333__QQVm0&akid=9697%2E22930333%2E_QQVm0)
**[SPLIT $20](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-nixon-split?refcode=em_20261006_9697_fr&amount=20&refcode2=9697_22930333__QQVm0&akid=9697%2E22930333%2E_QQVm0)**
Republicans have controlled Florida for years. They cannot hold that much power and pretend they bear no responsibility for what working families are experiencing right now.
Everyday Floridians aren't worried about political scandals for their own sake. They're wondering whether they can afford groceries, make rent, pay the electric bill, find childcare, or see a doctor. I'm running to make sure life is better for working-class Floridians. Ashley Moody and her allies would rather make the conversation about anything else.
I'm not going to let that happen. Accountability isn't optional for anyone asking to represent Florida in the United States Senate.
[**Can you chip in $20, or whatever you can, to help the DNC and me keep pushing for the answers voters deserve and take back the Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-nixon-split?refcode=em_20261006_9697_fr&amount=20&refcode2=9697_22930333__QQVm0&akid=9697%2E22930333%2E_QQVm0)

#
| | | | | Hi, Peter – Roy Cooper here. My friend Adam Hamilton is running for U.S. Senate over in Kansas, and he needs our support. If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19681?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1620&amount=5&t=7&akid=4327%2E124072%2EpX6PX4)

---|---
Peter, I wanted you to see this incredible news right away: **The Cook Political Report just announced they’re shifting our race to a _toss-up,_ meaning it is among the most competitive across the whole country.**
This comes just after a New York Times/Siena poll showed me tied with Roger Marshall.
All these dead heat polls and updated ratings tell me two things:
**1.** We can win this race.
**2.** The attacks from Sen. Marshall and his super PAC allies are about to get much worse.
[**_That second point is worrying, especially with only days until Kansans start casting their ballots. That is why, I’m asking you to please donate to help keep up our momentum all the way through Election Day._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19681?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1620&amount=5&t=9&akid=4327%2E124072%2EpX6PX4)

I’ll be honest, resources really do make a difference in a tight race like this one. Between TV ads, canvassing, field offices and everything else it takes to run a winning campaign, your support really does add up — and unlike my opponent, I don’t take money from corporate PACs.
**This campaign is fully funded by people like you donating to emails like this one, and I’m proud of that.**
But Marshall and his allies are already spending $23 million to defeat me. That is more than we have budgeted to spend for the rest of the race.
Their team is running 24/7 misleading attack ads, all in an effort to drown out our message. Our campaign has given folks hope that we can fix our broken system. But the truth is, their plan might work if we don’t meet this moment, raise our goals and fight back. They’re betting we won't, and I’m counting on you to prove them wrong. We’ve already proven to be far more competitive in this race than they could have imagined — now, we need to carry that momentum through Election Day.

body:

Hi there, it's Elizabeth Warren.

I want to be clear about something: I never take it lightly when I ask folks to pitch in $7 or $14 to help Democrats win. The way I see it, if someone contributes $7, it's a leap of faith.

They may know that if they're the only ones donating, their $7 won't go too far. It might seem like a drop in a bucket against all the funding from national Republicans and powerful interests.

But when they make that gift, they know in their bones that they are not alone. They know they're a part of a team ‐‐ _this team_ ‐‐ of people across the country who believe **we CAN defeat these MAGA extremists and make our government work for everyone.**

We can't kid ourselves, though: The other side has big heaps of money. Republicans are spending MILLIONS to try and hold onto their vulnerable Senate majority so they can keep pushing their billionaire‐first agenda. **[The only way we can compete is if the people reading this email who _can_ pitch in respond with a donation.](https://go.dscc.org/go/24212?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20261006-ElizabethWarren-WarrenAmericanDream-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20261006-ElizabethWarren-WarrenAmericanDream-Pros-sl1&akid=26615%2E9716520%2EEsKmDV)**

The good news is, our grassroots movement is powerful enough to overcome all of that ‐‐ it's why Trump and his allies are spending so much to drown us out. The many have defeated the money before, and we're going to do it again.

[**When we all work together, everyone contributing what they can, we will be able to halt Trump's looting of the American Dream and start making life more affordable by taking back the Senate. We can't let the momentum slow down now, so I greatly appreciate you giving what you can.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

Fellow Conservative: What's with liberals and our children? Every election cycle, Democrats tell us they're moderates. They talk about faith, decency, and "bringing people together." Then you look at the record, and you find the same thing again and again: when it comes to protecting kids, they look the other way. You've likely heard about **James Talarico** , the liberal candidate for U.S. Senate in Texas. He's a former seminarian who quotes Scripture on the campaign trail, but despite his attempts to wrap himself in Christianity, _**he voted against a bill to protect our children from sex-change surgeries, puberty blockers, and cross-sex hormones**_. So much for believing that we're all made in the image of God. Talarico even refused to oppose a bill banning sexual performances in front of minors, saying he didn't want any legislation to target the performers. He's more concerned about protecting drag queens than children in Texas. Now consider **Adam Hamilton** , the liberal candidate for U.S. Senate in Kansas. He's the founding pastor of one of the largest churches in America, and he wants Kansans to see him as a shepherd. But in November 2005, teenage boys at his church's sleep-away retreat reported that a man came into their cabin at night and touched them in their sleeping bags. A Kansas appeals court later found that camp leaders "were dismissive of their claims." The church ran its own internal review instead of calling the police. **_The next fall, the church sent the man back to the camp as a counselor._** The man was later convicted of sexual battery. Boys from Hamilton's church camp had to relive what happened to them on the witness stand. Hamilton now says he "absolutely" should have handled it differently.

Both of these men wrap their politics in the language of faith. But we're told to judge by fruits, not words. Jesus warned us: "Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves. Ye shall know them by their fruits" (Matthew 7:15–16). Both of these men wrap their politics in the language of faith. But we're told to judge by fruits, not words. Scripture is just as clear about how seriously God takes harm to children: "It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones" (Luke 17:2). There is a real spiritual battle over our children's innocence. It's being fought in classrooms, libraries, and doctors' offices. And it will be decided in the U.S. Senate. If Talarico and Hamilton win, Democrats are one step closer to a Senate majority, which will block every effort to protect kids from radical gender ideology. These fake pastors will have succeeded in perverting our faith and using it to bring harm against our children. The election is now just days away. body:
This November is all or nothing for the Left. And they're counting on patriots like you to stay home.

| | | | Patriot,
---
Let me tell you why we're fired up about this November... Because 2026 is all or nothing for the Left. If they don't win the midterms, they know they'll be out of power for at least a decade. And right now, most polling in every swing state is a coin flip. Within the margin of error, either way. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: My story.
body:
I’ve been winning tough fights for my entire life.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
This is me. I grew up in the Rio Grande Valley, attending Brownsville public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&refcode=em20261006-2342&amount=5&t=1&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)_Picture day at Egly Elementary in Brownsville, TX_
At an early age, my grandmother taught me an important lesson: _No te dejes. Fight back._ It’s a lesson that I’ve carried with me for my entire life — and it’s what I’m doing today as I run to be the next Governor of Texas.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&refcode=em20261006-2342&amount=5&t=2&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)_Born and raised in the Valley_
I never planned to run for office. But when my son’s elementary school was threatened with closure by state budget cuts, I rallied other parents, ran for Austin ISD School Board, and won. I kept my son’s school open, along with every other public school in the district.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&refcode=em20261006-2342&amount=5&t=3&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)_The Austin Chronicle endorsed my race for school board_
But neighborhood schools kept closing across the state because Republican leaders kept diverting Texas tax dollars away from schools. So I ran for a seat in the Texas House of Representatives — and I won. In 2019, I helped win an investment of more than $11 billion in Texas public schools.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&refcode=em20261006-2342&amount=5&t=4&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)_On the floor of the Texas State House_
**Now, I’m the official Democratic nominee running to unseat Greg Abbott.** I’ve been winning tough fights for my entire life, and I’m ready to win this November and lead Texas.
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&refcode=em20261006-2342&amount=5&t=5&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)_Years later, I’m still fighting back._
A new New York Times poll shows me ahead by 3 points. That same poll had us behind by 7 points in June — a whole 10 point swing in just 4 months, Peter.
That means we have the momentum behind us, but with less than a month until Election Day, I’m relying on your urgent support to scale up this campaign before it’s too late.
**[If you’re with me, will you please donate $5 right now to power our fight to November 3rd? Any amount you can contribute will go a long way in building a campaign strong enough to flip Texas.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&refcode=em20261006-2342&amount=5&t=6&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_2_bio.6_kDmz&amount=5&refcode=em20261006-2342&t=25&akid=2342%2E299639%2ErHr-ui)
Thank you,
Gina

| | | | | | Peter,

Election Day is less than a month away, and Dover needs a representative who will put families and constitutional rights ahead of Concord bureaucracy and special interests.

**Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire is proud to endorse Daniel Furman for State Representative in Strafford 13, bringing our**[**total number of endorsed candidates**](https://us.list-manage.com/11nZmiMoyFs?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)**to 154.**

Dan has signed [The Pledge](https://us.list-manage.com/15i1e_OqVAT?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70) and put his commitment in writing to limited government, individual liberty, parental rights, and the Live Free or Die values Granite Staters expect from their lawmakers.
---
[|

---
| | **Dan is a Navy veteran who served on nuclear submarines, including the USS New Hampshire, and later worked at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard before settling in Dover.**

On the issues that matter to our Pledge, he is clear.

✅ He opposes a state income tax and a sales tax.

✅ He will fight for parents to play the primary role in their children’s education and upbringing.

✅ He will defend the Second Amendment for law-abiding citizens, support girls’ and women’s sports for biological females, protect property rights against unnecessary government overreach, cut regulations that hold back small businesses, and demand balanced budgets that respect taxpayers.

Those commitments match the principles our Pledge Champions in Good Standing have already agreed to uphold.

**Sending another signer to Concord strengthens the fight for educational freedom, lower taxes, and a state government that stays in its proper place.**

Our teams are knocking doors around the clock across the state. Your support keeps those liberty door knockers in the field until polls close on Tuesday, November 3.

body:
| | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140813511/651599908/-1951883517?refcode=261006-debate&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTdkYjk3Zi1hZWMxLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uqd56Brf1okQvGK4Z_PP26I7EMKBObkvTMPbARR-reU=)

Tonight I’ll be stepping on stage to debate my opponent for the first time. Before then, let me remind you who Rick Jackson is — in his own words.
* **About the President:** _“I’ll be President Trump’s favorite governor...I'll be like him, but with a southern tone.”_ _
_
* **About Election Day:** _“We’ll get the National Guard.”_
* **About Medicaid expansion:** _It’s “a bumper sticker” issue.__
_
* **About Georgia’s dangerous abortion ban:** _“I’m real pleased that I was a part of that behind the scenes.”_

**Let me be clear: we have made too much progress in this state and this country to take ten steps back. # **Join Us for Our October Autism Support Group**
---
|
---
| **Join Us for Our October Autism Support Group tomorrow!** You are invited to join us for our next **Autism Support Group on Wednesday, October 7th at 5:00 PM PST / 8:00 PM EST via Zoom**. Our monthly support group is a welcoming space for parents, caregivers, professionals, and families impacted by autism to come together, connect, and learn from one another. This is an opportunity to **ask questions, share experiences, hear parent testimonials, exchange resources, and receive encouragement** from a community that understands the challenges and victories that can come with the autism journey. At Autism Health, we believe families need more than information. They need **connection, support, and a community where they feel heard**. Whether your family is navigating a new diagnosis or you have been on this journey for many years, you are welcome to join us. **Advance registration is required to attend.** Once registered, you will receive the Zoom information for the meeting. We look forward to seeing you and continuing to build a strong and supportive Autism Health community! Register at the link below.
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/4U8TkBgqHKW?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332 "REGISTER HERE")
---
|
---
|
# Join Us at the 2026 Big Blue Bash
---
|
---
| Autism Health is excited to share an incredible upcoming event, the **2026 Big Blue Bash** , taking place **November 17, 2026, at The Mar-a-Lago Club in Palm Beach, Florida**. This exclusive black-tie gala brings together leaders, supporters, celebrities, and members of the law enforcement community for an unforgettable evening dedicated to honoring America's law enforcement officers and the families of wounded and fallen officers. Guests can look forward to an elegant evening featuring **live entertainment, a cocktail reception, three-course dinner, open bar, live and silent auctions, special presentations, and surprise moments throughout the night**. Confirmed celebrity guests include **Kevin Sorbo, Dean Cain, and Lou Ferrigno** , with additional special guests expected to be announced. Proceeds benefit the **Federal Law Enforcement Officers Foundation** , the 501(c)(3) arm of the Federal Law Enforcement Officers Association. Attendance is limited, with the event website noting a maximum capacity of **700 VIP guests** , so those interested are encouraged to reserve their place early. **Tuesday, November 17, 2026**
**The Mar-a-Lago Club | Palm Beach, Florida** Click on the link below to get your tickets and learn more.
---

|
---
|
# Join Us at the Sovereign Health Summit
---
|
---
| Autism Health is excited to partner with the **Sovereign Health Summit** , taking place **October 27 through 31, 2026** , at **Vanhoy Campground in Harmony, North Carolina**. This multi-day event will bring together individuals from across the country who are passionate about health, wellness, education, and taking a more proactive role in their health. The Summit will feature an exciting lineup of guest speakers, including **Barbara O'Neill, Dr. Henry Ealy, Tracy Slepcevic, and Dr. Lee Merritt** , along with additional speakers and educational opportunities throughout the event. Attendees will have the chance to learn, connect with like-minded individuals, and explore a variety of perspectives on health and wellness. As a member of the Autism Health community, you can receive **5% OFF your ticket** by using our exclusive promo code **AutismHealth5** at checkout. When purchasing your ticket, please use the special Autism Health registration link below. By registering through our link, you will not only save on your ticket, but your purchase will also help support the ongoing mission and programs of **Autism Health Inc.** **October 27–31, 2026 | Vanhoy Campground | Harmony, NC**
**Save 5% with promo code: AutismHealth5** We are grateful to partner with the Sovereign Health Summit and hope to see members of our Autism Health community there!
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/3bs9oaBYkLd?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332 "REGISTER HERE")
---
|
---
|
# Join Us for the Documenting Hope Conference!
---
|
---
| We’re excited to share an upcoming event from our friends at Documenting Hope. The **Documenting Hope Conference** is happening **November 21–22, 2026 in Orlando, Florida** , with a virtual attendance option for those who can’t join in person. This conference brings together **parents, practitioners, researchers, and health experts** to explore the growing challenges facing children today and practical approaches to supporting their health and well-being. It’s an opportunity to learn, connect, ask questions, and leave with information you can put into action for your family. **Special Savings Through October 15**
Register by **October 15** and receive **$50 off your ticket with promo code 50OFF**. Every in-person General Admission ticket also includes **Virtual Access** , and all attendees, both in person and virtual, receive unlimited lifetime access to the conference replays. There are a few important deadlines to keep in mind: the specially discounted room block at **Rosen Shingle Creek** is available through **October 27** , and conference ticket prices increase to their final price on **November 1st.** **November 21–22, 2026 | Orlando, Florida + Virtual** [Reserve a Discounted Room at Rosen Shingle Creek](https://us.list-manage.com/Hc9a7EsNZ32?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332) We hope many of our Autism Health families and professionals will take advantage of this opportunity to come together for a weekend of education, connection, and hope. Be sure to **register by October 15** and use **50OFF** to save $50 on your ticket!
---
| [REGISTER HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/eJGJTtel9Hw?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332 "REGISTER HERE")
---
|
---
|
# Save the Date for Our Winter Gala!
---
|
---
| **Join Us for an Unforgettable Evening at the Autism Health Winter Gala** We are thrilled to invite you to the **First Annual Autism Health Winter Gala** , taking place on **Saturday, January 30, 2027** , at the beautiful **Trump National Golf Club in Jupiter, Florida**. This elegant evening will bring together supporters, physicians, researchers, community leaders, and families for a memorable celebration. Guests will enjoy an inspiring evening featuring a VIP reception, dinner, exciting live and silent auctions, and presentations from nationally recognized leaders. We are honored to announce **General Michael Flynn** and **Del Bigtree **as our featured speakers. We have also extended an invitation to **Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.** , whose participation will be confirmed at a later date. The Winter Gala is more than a celebration. It is an opportunity to invest in the future of Autism Health. Proceeds from this special event will directly support our mission to provide educational webinars, parent support groups, scholarships for families, research initiatives, biomedical grants, and community programs that improve the lives of individuals with autism and related neurological conditions. For a limited time only, you can receive **10% off** your admission ticket with promo code **Gala10 for the month of October**. Whether you are a longtime supporter or are just learning about Autism Health, we invite you to join us for an evening of inspiration, generosity, and meaningful connection. Together, we can continue expanding access to education, advancing research, and providing hope to families across the country. **Reserve your seat today using the registration link below. We look forward to celebrating with you in Jupiter, Florida!**
---
| [BUY TICKETS HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/PrmcFV0JPeG?e=3a42edfdc4&c2id=8db3279a53aa0d16c24f727ce5cda332 "BUY TICKETS HERE")

|
