clean_body: Fuel the climate fight year-round| | | | | | Dear Peter, As Director of Science for Save the Redwoods League, I spend a lot of time thinking about climate change. That means I also spend a lot of time asking myself hard questions: What can we save? What should we save? What might we be missing? Science can inform these questions, but if we are to truly combat climate change and protect what we love, we must lead with our values. We must listen to one another, strive to do better, commit to doing the right thing, and see it through. The challenges are great, but so is our resolve. Our values at Save the Redwoods lead us to think not just about what we can save, but what we can grow. The answer lies with the redwoods themselves. Climate change is an undeniable danger to the redwoods. It amplifies every threat, from drought to invasive species. In the last decade alone, 17% of mature giant sequoias have been lost to extreme wildfires. But these trees are also our greatest allies in this fight. Coast redwoods store more carbon than any other forest ecosystem on Earth. That is why I’m asking you to help us protect and restore the redwoods, helping to foster climate resilience, carbon storage, and awe-inspiring beauty for generations to come. Your support keeps us going, allowing our teams to proactively monitor forest health, measure effectiveness of restoration efforts, fund and advance practical science and research, and innovate to create a more climate-resilient redwood range. Climate change is here, and it is not waiting for us. But we are far from hopeless. We refuse to be paralyzed by the magnitude or inherent uncertainties of climate change. | | | | | With gratitude and hope, Dr. Chris Swanston Director of Science | | | P.S. name: Troy Jackson
subject: amazing
body:
Wow, I’m blown
away.

Just as I wrapped up my debate, my staff told me the good news: you helped
us raise $170,000 just while I was on stage?! I can’t thank you enough –
really.

They said they were aiming for $200,000, but fell just short. I told them
it wouldn’t be a problem – that would help us get over the
finish line. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261006_4.v63HBB&refcode=em20261006-4&t=1001&akid=9375%2E582294%2EfEV9G_ ]So before I go on, do you think you spare a couple of
bucks, split between our campaign and Chris Pappas, to help us reach our
goal before midnight? A recent poll shows us down by 3 points, so your
support would mean a lot to me right now.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261006_4.v63HBB&refcode=em20261006-4&t=1002&akid=9375%2E582294%2EfEV9G_ ]GIVE ANY AMOUNT RIGHT NOW »

I have to tell you, Susan Collins gave the exact performance I had
expected. Lies, false promises, and a whole lot of concern.

And when I reminded her that today is the anniversary of her deciding vote
to confirm Brett Kavanaugh to the Supreme Court, and gave her the chance
to explain the decision, she showed no regret whatsoever. Millions of
women across the country lost their reproductive rights because of that
vote.

Look, I’ll
tell you the same thing that I just told thousands of undecided Mainers:
I’m for Medicare-for-all, making billionaires pay their fair share and
bringing down the cost of living.

Susan Collins also told those undecided Mainers what she’s for: tax breaks
for billionaires and continuing to vote with Donald Trump 96% of the time.

We can defeat Susan in less than a month from now, but I can’t take on
this fight alone. We have been out-spent on TV ads by a 2-to-1 margin! And
there’s more cash to come before Election Day.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261006_4.v63HBB&refcode=em20261006-4&t=1003&akid=9375%2E582294%2EfEV9G_ ]So please, if you were waiting for the perfect day to donate, I hope
you’ll make today that day. Your $5 right now would help us
reach our fundraising goal and flip the Senate.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261006_4.v63HBB&amount=5&refcode=em20261006-4&t=1022&akid=9375%2E582294%2EfEV9G_ ]Donate $5 »

Solidarity forever,

Troy

Friend, Donald Trump — a known rapist whose name shows up 40,000 times in the Epstein files — just rolled back Biden-era Title IX protections for students. He weakened support for survivors of sexual assault and took away important protections for LGBTQ+ students. And last week, news spread about the “Cornell 7,” male students who raped a female student and faced hardly any consequences. My race will be the most competitive Senate race in the country.

Susan Collins continues to roll over for Donald Trump, and their MAGA billionaire allies will do everything they can to keep her seat – and keep his agenda intact. Just ask Elon Musk, who’s made clear he’s ready to shell out millions to save Susan.

I’m in this race to put an end to billionaires’ buying power and give folks a government that actually works for working Mainers.

**This is going to come down to our grassroots campaign versus Susan’s $10 million billionaire-backed machine, so I need you on my team. **

Listen, I’m a fifth-generation logger from Allagash with no political family name or personal fortune behind me. Powered by Ancestors: A community call to remember, resist, and build an altar together. | | | Peter, Mass delegalization and the violence federal agents have brought to our communities have resulted in the death of dozens of people in our neighborhoods and inside detention centers. **This Wednesday, October 21 at 7 pm ET, we will come together to honor all of the people who have lost their lives at the hands of federal agents.** Our communities have always found ways to care for one another. In moments of uncertainty and loss, coming together reminds us that we are not alone and that the care we have for each other is part of what keeps us moving forward. [**Join us for Powered by Ancestors: Recuerdos and Resistance on Wednesday, October 21 at 7pm ET**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHppmiRA61m8BkCHH3b_teELGEhD0-89jT181dzWTMahBFib96fvTt7HN9-L8ccIKTyKd3jBBzw7JOa7t9H9yRuQIH0bGockSmjuiK9Bl5mH9tWNnyIdW1HYwIusAUqruZyeGG2jZVWPG7ihoys3Cjb82gd1UHgvIFtAmFol3Y358f8k5xR76F8YIukq1n-J923qI3wvA691FQIkSKjurnqw1D4OvHqk43pcGGyEFGrKoK_H6fuG2d5CYyqehvHGMNfJfOKATj3xjOLxdAGl3bCkg/4un/D295noxRSxKJImm2318DMw/h0/h001.30HzEVkGU0dOE2P2ECLZ28iKWWTM841HwdKbIP5YWuw) for a community call to honor our ancestors and build a community altar together. Bring a photo of a loved one who has passed, a beloved pet, or someone who is currently detained to take part in our digital ofrenda. We’ll make a community altar and we will use the tradition of dia de los muertos to make meaning of the tragedies our communities have endured. **[RSVP NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHppmiRA61m8BkCHH3b_teELGEhD0-89jT181dzWTMahBF75I_1MlosHYaJn1dIiAlGHu81EWdvuScmF3OEA1BWDq6jefcf8B4xLZZ6GerGfMlf3vLN2G-JSjRya0QV2dAtg2mwxkN7PaIHFHa8St6NVIW_hKlEfs5G6UZsjsMYZwRLPRO2Dz7P30WrvsxK6q0Jc3SsJ2xwnFSeVF-oi_HIYtJKhoHPhBtgqBFJx5mzNQzt25ZXHWGVHacmytSjJ9iEKV2kfuqNHoaInp3YR5LzGw/4un/D295noxRSxKJImm2318DMw/h1/h001._i3uImGC7U0UGyuOMtqc2UeZSmt-3L9wPwO_Z2A0zn8)** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMchKqTlnDL9HV9V-hz_r8qN5sFN7uyIDHDQ_kqfTbgHpw9l-ngjXclNoM0Ou8ZiAaIE1OF_xDI2niJbM2MS9qErDXtn_HuYyXQWWU_Oj4HaDKlGqvAOJGseZsts-6KszKi5_vDuiXuwMq9lC4J_31oX0NTIp8WfCQyR1D6OBS-64pV2Pk4A46wzWijy4V4VdQGnyE07669LS5Tl7sM2fgCFimmIifLMU0Xvsjv1ha6HQxPyn5op3m4tBbHCrK1GXYlvnZBr2H0seYEnpMipKlLnZxmykRsxBcQVyHeSRb4pGQqcOPSeMhdmoLYkw4EiZ9g/4un/D295noxRSxKJImm2318DMw/h2/h001._cT87PeA3P2X_8jOk3L8pRg35IAr93Waoe37Xu5_B_w)

clean_body: Powered by Ancestors: A community call to remember, resist, and build an altar together. | | | Peter, Mass delegalization and the violence federal agents have brought to our communities have resulted in the death of dozens of people in our neighborhoods and inside detention centers. This Wednesday, October 21 at 7 pm ET, we will come together to honor all of the people who have lost their lives at the hands of federal agents. Our communities have always found ways to care for one another. In moments of uncertainty and loss, coming together reminds us that we are not alone and that the care we have for each other is part of what keeps us moving forward. for a community call to honor our ancestors and build a community altar together. Bring a photo of a loved one who has passed, a beloved pet, or someone who is currently detained to take part in our digital ofrenda. We’ll make a community altar and we will use the tradition of dia de los muertos to make meaning of the tragedies our communities have endured. If you have never created an altar before, don’t worry, we will give you instructions on how to create one. If you’re planning to set up your own Dias de Los Muertos altar at home, we’ll also provide you with a printout honoring the lives of those who lost their lives at the hands of federal agents, and listing their names, so you can add it to your altar. We will also be making Spooky calls and writing emails to key house members who have not yet signed on to the Dream and Promise Act discharge petition. Our strength is generational, and it’s in community that we find it. Will we see you there? – Ximena and the rest of the UWD Team | Follow us on: | | | | |

Hi team,
I'm about to head into our Annville town hall, but I wanted to tell you something first.
If you're from around here, you know that in our part of Pennsylvania, we show up, we do our jobs, and we look out for each other. The least we could ask is for our representative to do the same.
But Dan Meuser can't be bothered. He doesn't live here, he doesn't listen to us, and he doesn't represent us.
**In a few minutes I 'm doing something Dan has never done and hosting a real town hall. And I'll do it six more times this month.**
When I talk about leaders who show up and listen, this is what I mean. When I talk about bringing people together to solve local problems, this is how I do it.
**I can promise you this:** If you send me to Congress, I will never hide from you, and I will never stop showing up for you.
But you have to help me get there.
**[We have never had a better opportunity to flip this seat, and we have four weeks to get it done. Please chip in if you can to help me keep showing up for our part of PA.](https://substack.com/redirect/a3a18d05-561f-4794-bfc7-f40b08950a20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Rachel Wallace

* [**00:05:38**] The new New York Times/Siena polling is stunning: James Talarico is over 50%, while Republicans appear to be hitting a ceiling.

clean_body: | | | With four weeks until the midterm elections, we want to make clear what’s at stake, Peter. If Working Families champions in red districts can’t defeat their MAGA opponents and take back Congress, we’re in for another two years of unchecked attacks on our communities, illegal wars, dangerous AI and data center development, and skyrocketing costs. That’s the future Trump and power-hungry Republicans want, and it’s why their super PACs are spending millions of dollars on ads and attacks against our WFP Champions who have a real shot at beating their far-right buddies. But despite the MAGA movement’s best efforts, the polls still show razor-thin margins in must-win districts. It’s anyone’s game, and every move we make could be the difference. We’ve got good news, Peter. We recently released a memo with new polling showing that voters in swing districts are hungry for change,1 and they’re ready to elect leaders like educator Randy Villegas (CA-22), community organizer Will Lawrence (MI-07), union ironworker Brian Poindexter (OH-07), firefighter Bob Brooks (PA-07), and public servant Justin J. Pearson (TN-09). By electing these must-win Working Families champions, we can take away Trump’s rubber stamp of approval from Congress and mount a formidable opposition that fights for working people. But to get swing voters to the polls for our champions, we need to out-organize the super PACs dumping millions into these races — and we need your help. In solidarity, Team WFP P.S. body:

Oppose Trump’s Attacks on Our Clean Drinking Water!

Trump’s EPA is proposing to eliminate federal safeguards for our drinking water sources, including tens of millions of acres of our nation’s wetlands and millions of miles of streams.

This is the second proposal to strip Clean Water Act protections from our
critical waterways, allowing Big Polluters to profit off the destruction of the
waters our families depend on.

The comment period ends October 9 — we must act quickly. Add your voice today
and oppose this dangerous proposal.

Tell the EPA: protect our drinking water! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/2zZrMNj-epcm/NU9EcERCZHdGUmMrWnhFb28rS2ZMY3VXdUhCVitocExxcnZDK2J6ekpjL1cvcS9DR1M1QkJCVEE1bHk4Y0xrNWNPWGtKRjhVNjZNeTI0eFZBekZnSU1qcUl2TXpqZjlBK0l3TmlMODdXUFE9S0/MnJFMXRCQ0tOeVdnZGFFci83RUFXbFJHZU5qQ0liaGFmUGhKQ2FHRlVBVUpRRDNYM3VLQ0xzcm56RzZXSE9zZkkwd2s0T044MUNEeEt4WlhRRFBSamtJMlZNL1BDZ2hVT1JIRCtaZnpMR1U9S0 ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ec- Peter, We need to pull together to defend our clean water. Trump and EPA Administrator
Zeldin are trying to eliminate critical clean water safeguards for nearly 94% of our wetlands and millions of miles of streams. Sign your name today and tell the EPA to protect our waters! https://links.messages.lcv. TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZMNYw~-cL/NU9EcERCZHdGUmMrWnhFb28rS2ZMY3VXdUhCVitocExxcnZDK2J6ekpjL1cvcS9DR1M1QkJCVEE1bHk4Y0xrNWNPWGtKRjhVNjZNeTI0eFZBekZnSU1qcUl2TXpqZjlBK0l3TmlMODdXUFE9S0/MnJFMXRCQ0tOeVdnZGFFci83RUFXbFJHZU5qQ0liaGFmUGhKQ2FHRlVBVUpRRDNYM3VLQ0xzcm56RzZXSE9zZkkwd2s0T044MUNEeEt4WlhRRFBSamtJMlZNL1BDZ2hVT1JIRCtaZnpMR1U9S0 Everyone deserves access to clean water and a safe environment — which is why
it’s so critical that we act now.If this proposal moves forward, it would open the doors for polluters to
discharge waste into the waters on which we all rely. It would mean fewer
safeguards for our drinking water, endangering public health, and put the fish,
birds, and other wildlife that depend on these ecosystems at great risk. And on
top of that, it would mean higher water bills for people like you and me, when
the cost of living is already too high. Make no mistake: this proposal threatens the availability of safe, clean
drinking water for millions of people across the country.Wetlands help filter pollutants before they reach rivers, lakes, and other
waters. They’re a vital part of our drinking water infrastructure, helping to
refill underground aquifers that many towns and cities rely on. The administration is trying to downplay this extreme measure by framing it as
just a “supplement” to the dangerous proposal they released last year. But we know what this really is: another attempt by Trump to put the profits of
his corporate cronies ahead of the health and safety of our families and the
places we love. The comment period ends October 9.We can’t afford to give up these protections for our waters, our wildlife, our
lands, and our communities. Tell Trump and EPA Administrator Zeldin to keep our
waters clean and protected! Add your voice today, Peter. It takes less than a minute to help stop this dangerous proposal >> https://links.messages.lcv. Thank you for making your voice heard and advocating for the safe, just, and
equitable planet we all deserve. Lizzy Duncan

body:

__The Senate majority is not safe.__

[STAND WITH MAGA](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Night has settled on the midterms, and it is not a gentle night.
The lamps in the Oval Office burn low. Outside, something keeps tapping at the glass, patient as a verdict. **We may hold the Senate. We may not.** I will not lie to you and call the dark a dawn.
I have walked the halls in the White House when the majority felt solid underfoot. __It does not feel solid now.__ ____
One seat slips, then another, and the gavel changes hands like a throat being cut in silence. The other side does not need a landslide. They need the dark to do their work for them. **_A tired voter. An empty chair. A man who tells himself the night will pass if he stays indoors._**

[DON’T BE THAT PERSON](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
[STAND WITH MAGA](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
There is a blackness that comes for republics the way it comes for houses. It does not kick down the door. It waits until the people inside decide the fight is already lost. I have felt that blackness at my own shoulder. It knows my name. It would like to know yours, and then forget it.
**_[So stand with me and the MAGA movement while the outcome is still unwritten. Do not leave this fight to the people who want us gone. # "Crushed it!"..."Home Run!" - We Spoke for You, Maryland.
Friend,
We won the debate hands down! That's what observers have told me. Tune in tonight at 7pm to watch.

All of my attacks were on Wes Moore's policies. All of his attacks on me were ad hominem - at times downright ridiculous, including one moment when he lost his cool and said that he had only "invited me to debate to have a conversation, not lie..." but there were no lies. Every statement was valid and on his failed record.

Get your popcorn!

Two big deals we obtained for Maryland and America tonight:
1\. Wes Moore refused to promise not to raise taxes and fees.
2\. Wes Moore refused to promise to serve as Governor for his term, or promise not to run for president.

We proved our point - he doesn't have Maryland as his focus. He's left the state for 300 days of his term - nearly an entire year. We prosecuted your case tonight. Watch - we fought hard to speak for you.

Will you [chip in to help us win](https://us.list-manage.com/sDCTXhEBcWy?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b)? We want to run TV ads with these clips and expand our latest TV purchase. Thank you. Let's win!

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Nominee for Governor of Maryland

# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=2062%2E1086043%2EHafisT)
Peter,
**President Trump barred me from speaking in Baltimore today,** but he can’t stop me from standing up for Maryland.
Earlier today, we were set to announce plans for a manufacturing facility that will create thousands of good-paying, permanent jobs before the Trump administration removed me from the event.
**I won’t bow to anybody** -- and I won’t let Trump stop us from delivering for Maryland. While he’s playing politics, I’m proud to say this deal is the largest private investment in over a decade. No matter who takes the credit, these jobs will bring work, wages, and wealth to our state.
That’s because I’m committed to making progress for every Marylander, and together, we’re continuing to make ours a state where we leave no one behind.
But I need you with me to stay in this fight. My opponent is Trump’s man in Maryland and we have just 28 days left in this race to defeat him

Thank you for all that you do.
Elevate,

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: We have a real shot
body:
We’ve led in 3 independent polls, but we’re still trailing in the polling average.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I want to give you an honest read on the state of our race as we get closer to the polls opening here in Texas.
Over the last three weeks, we've led in three independent polls. Not long ago, a lot of people would have told you a Democrat leading in a race for governor of Texas was impossible.
We’re proving the doubters wrong. The polls clearly show we could actually win this. **But I'd be doing you a disservice if I told you it's locked up. It's not even close to locked up.**
Here's where things stand. We're still down about 1.6 points in the polling average:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_3_natesilver.2sxwg4&refcode=em20261006-2347&amount=5&t=1&akid=2347%2E299639%2EqlF-mU)And Nate Silver’s forecast gives us roughly a 1 in 3 chance of winning:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_3_natesilver.2sxwg4&refcode=em20261006-2347&amount=5&t=2&akid=2347%2E299639%2EqlF-mU)
We are the underdogs, and we still have work to do. If we pull this off, it will be one of the biggest political upsets in the country. Texas hasn't elected a Democratic governor since Ann Richards in 1990. _**But because of your support, taking Texas back is genuinely within reach for the first time in decades.**_
Greg Abbott started this year with more than $100 million in his campaign war chest. We will never match that dollar for dollar, and we don't have to. We’ve gotten this far with just a fraction of his resources.
But too many Texans still haven’t heard from our campaign, and turning this 1 in 3 shot into a win comes down to whether we have the resources to reach every voter we need between now and November 3. And with ad reservations being snapped up right now,_**the money we raise goes further today than it will at any other point in this race.**_
If you've ever thought about giving to this campaign, even once, this is the moment. I need every person who's ever considered it to chip in right now, as much as you can afford. **[Will you make your first contribution today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261006_3_natesilver.cL6Coe&refcode=em20261006-2347&t=4&akid=2347%2E299639%2EqlF-mU)**

We've come further than anyone expected. Let's finish it.
Thank you,
Gina

The Guardian just reported that top Democrats are running exercises to prepare for election threats — deepfakes, attacks on election workers, federal overreach, and even attempts to put federal agents near polling places. Because this is not hypothetical anymore. Donald Trump and his allies have spent years attacking the legitimacy of our elections. Now they are looking for new ways to intimidate voters, undermine confidence, and seize power they do not have. **In Oregon, we do not wait around and hope democracy survives.** _We prepare._ Our vote-by-mail system is secure, fair, and trusted. They are coming at our public lands from every direction at once, betting that the American people are too exhausted to notice and too divided to fight back. They think their billionaire extraction donors have bought them complete immunity. The single best answer to that arrogance is a surgical, inescapable digital ad blitz right in their home districts—putting their dirty voting records in front of every hunter, angler, hiker, and voter before they cast a ballot. [**That’s what your donation funds. clean_body: It's time to defend our public lands It's time to defend our public lands | | | | | Peter, Is there anything we can say to convince you to chip in today to help us topple anti-public lands politicians this November? What if we told you that the administration gutted Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante by over 90%—wiping out protections for nearly three million acres of pristine backcountry so mining executives could immediately stake uranium claims? What if we told you that the Chief of the U.S. Forest Service is a former timber lobbyist who is now moving to repeal the 25-year-old Roadless Rule, opening up 45 million acres of untouched national forests to corporate clear-cutting? And what if we told you that in Minnesota, politicians like Pete Stauber are trying to hand the Boundary Waters over to a toxic sulfide-ore mining company owned by a Chilean billionaire who provides a luxury rental home to the President’s daughter? They are coming at our public lands from every direction at once, betting that the American people are too exhausted to notice and too divided to fight back. They think their billionaire extraction donors have bought them complete immunity. The single best answer to that arrogance is a surgical, inescapable digital ad blitz right in their home districts—putting their dirty voting records in front of every hunter, angler, hiker, and voter before they cast a ballot. You take our land—we take your seat. For the wild, Public Land Warriors | Public Land Warriors728 Gilbert StHelena, MT 59601United States "Website"

Peter, Did you see Trump’s disturbing new videos that aired during an NFL Sunday football game? Rep. Jamie Raskin sent a letter to the Government Accountability Office demanding an investigation into the ads.** Senators Murray and Murphy are raising alarms of reports that $20 million was diverted from other funds to pay for them. Trump got headlines yesterday for promising to pay taxpayers back—but today he says that his promise only applied for future ads (and a new one started airing today). And none of that changes the fact that he, and the chain of bureaucrats who went along with him, thought he could get away with this in the first place. [**Trump thinks he’s above the law. But he answers to Congress and to the American people. Write a letter today standing with Rep. clean_body: | | | | | Minnesota has tried one-party control for 20 years, and here’s where that got us: At least $9 billion in fraud and stolen taxpayer money, rising crime, and failing schools. Peggy Flanagan, a failed career politician who enabled the policies that got us here. Her way doesn’t work. And yet we’ve been paying Peggy Flanagan with our hard-earned money for 20 years. It’s not the time to give her a promotion. It’s time to fire her for good. Right now, the “expert” pollsters say she has the edge in this race, but it’s a toss-up that could come down to a few hundred votes on election night. Not only is Peggy as extreme as they come, but she was also Tim Walz’s running mate. She was the sitting Lieutenant Governor during the largest COVID-19 scam in the country – the Feeding Our Future scandal. She’s done everything possible to distance herself from this debacle, and so far it’s worked! We can’t let all the rampant, unprecedented fraud that took place under her watch go unnoticed. It’s a national disgrace. That’s why Tim Walz was forced to end his re-election campaign... Meanwhile, his right hand wants to be our next U.S. Senator. She’s cut from the same cloth as every other Socialist pretending to be moderate today. Peggy Flanagan is a far-Left, extremist politician who will vote to allow girls competing against boys in sports, block voter ID requirements, open up our borders, raise your taxes, and sabotage anything the President wants to do. I’m not a career politician; I cut my teeth at the highest levels of media and sports broadcasting, and my campaign is focused on honesty, common sense, stopping fraud, and doing the small things right. That’s why we are going to win. We have to. Be brave. Do good. – Michele Republican Nominee for Senate, Minnesota | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Flipping the House starts with keeping Delaware’s seat blue
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Over the past few years, I’ve sat at kitchen tables up and down Delaware with families who are doing everything right and still falling behind.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3950%2E21716%2EaoedPU)
With just **4 weeks left** until Election Day, I want to tell you a little bit about why these next 28 days matter so much to me.
Over the past few years, I’ve sat at kitchen tables up and down Delaware with families who are doing everything right and still falling behind. Parents choosing between prescriptions and grocery bills. Workers picking between a paycheck or caring for a sick loved one.
These aren’t abstract policy debates. They’re real people, and they deserve a representative and a government who will fight for them.
That’s why I fought to pass paid family leave in Delaware, and it’s why I’m fighting in Congress to lower costs, protect and expand access to health care, and defend our freedoms.
**But in order to actually pass legislation on these issues and more, we need to flip the House on November 3rd.**
That starts with keeping Delaware’s seat blue. I’ve never taken a single vote in this state for granted, and I’m not going to start now. I launched this re-election campaign by visiting all 57 of Delaware’s towns and cities in just 3 days, and we haven’t slowed down since.
That being said, Delaware’s seat alone won’t win back the House. That’s why I’m also supporting my fellow Democrats across the country who are working to flip key swing districts. If we can flip just a few seats, we’ll finally get a House that works _for_ working families instead of against them.
**And I can’t do this without your support. Every dollar that comes in over these last four weeks goes straight to reaching more voters, so[can I count on you to chip in $5 right now to help us keep Delaware’s seat blue and flip the House?](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20261006-1.XBlBQf&refcode=em20261006-3950&amount=5&t=2&akid=3950%2E21716%2EaoedPU)**

We’ve got 4 weeks left, so let’s make every one of them count.
In solidarity,
Sarah McBride

body:

---
| | [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0017IcVplsdBMPNjQCaxQAQbvOzvoU-rMcaBZPzvDD2rSZCaEljLimPhiaMung6Y4-lv7L2Gt0s-sWE-3_KC29n3b_XMZV9LmHPSWkcI8owR7Wej7QrwubIkWnJpAlDgGJvy4-rT9Qj86Ti_RO5E1IbzlAz-ZIqb82rY36_fUNRqnPqChtq04f_s4hhW6dPZdu0csLijbnS0napV3vI9XgEeutLqs9yGSJwVzHNl7Jq62JiHHR9r8uNqeSMJiuE7ehNelc9FDloz-frDbEMoANlvAvyTEI0iZW-vRPwSwDZcBnfsiJp2iaQUw0N2cbQmLsjXRMZc1KLih80cc-hDGO7_w==&c=iUsA4qwwtKeyjRSECegn9oOwESQqr9vSfeZKO3pkMvqgZm7cQIR1nQ==&ch=ZNx7ssU3t-UQh8yCT9F8gRSWErzXa5cBFQDDd8axiGeT-3Xec5wo9w==) I think it was somewhere off Route 7. I was 12 years old, homeless, and living in a tent. It wasn’t easy, but it made me tough. Folks, by the time I was in middle school, I had been a frequent flier with children’s services. I had lived in over a dozen homes and experienced abuse, hunger, and homelessness. But I was determined to find a way out. I credit public schools with saving my life. And I worked three jobs in college and medical school to fulfill my dream of becoming a doctor. **I’m not sharing this story to earn sympathy points. I’m sharing it because these experiences shaped who I am and how I fight.** They’re why I’ll never look the other way while Ohio families struggle to afford groceries, healthcare, childcare, or a place to call home. I know what it’s like to need someone to fight for you. **That’s why I’m running for governor.** Look, there’s no doubt this will be a tough fight. I’m up against an out-of-touch billionaire who has no idea what it’s like to struggle. He’s spending tens of millions to buy this state for his own selfish gain. **But I’m ready for a tough fight. And if I learned anything from my childhood, it’s that no one gets through anything alone. name: President Trump
subject: Your continued support is what keeps me fighting.
body:
| | | | Today I'm making you a promise.
---
[](https://email.at-realdonaldjtrump.com/ga/click/2-97867-4-758-3488-4641-52db389439-0iec321c56)
---
Ten years ago, I could never have imagined where I would be today.

Serving my second term as President of the United States of America. Leading a movement whose sole goal is to make our nation the Greatest in the world.

In 2016, you placed your faith in me, and through it all, you have never wavered.

**_Never broken._**

**_Never surrendered._**

Even when it would have been easy to.

That’s why it is my greatest honor, every day, to be your President. I will never forget the trust you have bestowed upon me.

So today, I’m reaching out to you to make a promise, a solemn vow to the supporters that have been with me since the beginning.

Right now, as you read this, the Radical Left is working overtime to dismantle the movement that we have built together, destroy our great country, and halt the Golden Age we began just two years ago.

They will stop at nothing to destroy what we have built. We cannot let them.

I promise to YOU, the American People, hand over heart:

**_That I will NEVER surrender. I will never give up, and I will never stop fighting to Make America Great Again._**

We have fought every single day to create an America that our children, grandchildren, and great-grandchildren can be proud of, and defeat now is not an option.******
---
[](https://email.at-realdonaldjtrump.com/ga/click/2-97867-4-758-3488-4641-52db389439-0iec321c56)
---
That’s why today, I’m hoping I can count on your support, one final time.

The most pivotal election of our lifetime is right around the corner. The Radical Left is frothing at the mouth thinking about the chance to dismantle the MAGA movement if they win.

Everything we have accomplished in the last two years will be swept away overnight.

We CANNOT let that happen.

Please, if you are financially able, can I count on your support for just $20.26? Your contribution today could be the deciding factor in determining MAGA’s future.

I’m asking you today with a humble heart, please keep your faith in me******
---

If you'd like to unsubscribe, click here. Folks, we just got incredible news, and I wanted you to see it right away. Now: The attacks are working, team. Competitive races like mine will decide if we take back a Democratic House majority in November. That is why I am grateful for our strong coalition

| | Dear Supporter,
We are only 28 days out until Election Day.
Just yesterday, Trump suggested that Iran bombing Los Angeles and San Diego is “a very small price to pay.”
**This is treasonous** , and it’s another example of why we have no choice but to take back the House this November.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | If we want to hold the Trump Administration accountable, I need your help to keep this seat blue.
**Last cycle, I flipped this seat by just 653 votes.**
Competitive races like mine will decide if we take back a Democratic House majority in November. That is why I am grateful for our strong coalition of supporters that **knocked on over 12,700 doors in September.**
Our coalition spreads across Orange and Los Angeles Counties, bringing together working families who believe in a future where the American Dream is a reality for all.
As we kick off the month of October, I would be honored if you [**organized with us**](https://us.list-manage.com/A17gmPNydAZ?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4) , [**chipped in a few dollars**](https://us.list-manage.com/W6zhuVbseO2?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4) , or [**shared our message on social media**](https://us.list-manage.com/Q0djY0uI4Mh?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4).

**LEGISLATIVE WINS**
---
| | _**Congressman Derek Tran Fights for Southern California Renters with New Legislation**_
---
| | To lower housing costs nationwide, frontline candidate and Democratic nominee Derek Tran introduced the Housing Cost of Living Support for Tenants Act (Housing COST Act) establishing tax credits for renters.The Housing COST Act creates a baseline 8% refundable tax credit for renters who make a gross income of $150,000 or less. This tax credit has a maximum household cap of $333 a month, resulting in approximately $4,000 in annual savings. 75,000 households across Orange and Los Angeles Counties would benefit from this legislation. Read more: [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/pBdsiodEPGC?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4)
---
| | _**Congressman Derek Tran Leads Effort to Expand Tax Savings for Service Workers**_
---
| | In a major legislative effort to deliver economic benefits to working families, frontline candidate and Democratic nominee Derek Tran cosponsored the Tipped Income Protection and Support Act (TIPS Act) to expand permanent tax savings for service workers.The TIPS Act would permanently increase the maximum amount that service workers can deduct from an adjusted gross income of $25,000 to $112,500. This legislation applies to cosmetology, hospitality, food and beverage, parking, and custodial service employees. Read more: [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/e82oAjSuutz?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4)
---
| | _**Congressman Derek Tran Defends Families from Harmful Effects of Data Centers**_
---
| | In case you missed it, frontline candidate and Democratic nominee Derek Tran voted in favor of bipartisan legislation to defend working families from rising energy costs as a result of data centers.The Ratepayer Protection Act requires state utility regulators to create policies to protect communities from rising energy costs from large-load customers, such as data centers. The legislation passed the House by a vote of 417-3 and was received in the Senate for consideration on September 17, 2026. Read more: [**HERE**](https://us.list-manage.com/mfy1DgWN13_?e=fa48019594&c2id=2d2f4814b3c86de5c7569386ec1a86b4)

| | ###
_The son of refugees who worked hard and sacrificed for the American Dream, Congressman Derek Tran joined the Army at 18 to give back to the country that has given him so much. Wanting to continue his career in public service, he ran in California's 45th district to put people ahead of politics and protect democracy, and won. Now, he's running again to ensure everyone no matter what neighborhood they come from has the opportunity to succeed without fear of their freedoms being taken away._
_California’s 45th Congressional District remains one of the most contested battleground races in the country. Last cycle, Derek Tran flipped the seat by just over 600 votes (a 0.2% margin) in the second-closest and most expensive House race ($46 million spent) in the country. A majority-minority district, the District has the third largest AAPI population (41%) of any Congressional District, is 28% Latino, and is home to the largest Vietnamese community in the country. Following Proposition 50, this district brings in over 15,000 new Hispanic voters and over 7,000 new Vietnamese voters, and has a DPI of 52.8%._ _It includes all or part of the cities of Garden Grove, Westminster, Fountain Valley, Cerritos, Buena Park, Placentia, Hawaiian Gardens, Cypress, Artesia, Los Alamitos, La Palma, Norwalk, Stanton, Lakewood, Santa Ana, Seal Beach, and Fullerton, as well as the unincorporated community of Midway City._
_Use of Derek Tran's military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Dept. of Defense or U.S. Army._

Friend, my finance team just told me that today's donations have been a bit slow.

Here’s why this concerns me:
1️⃣ This race is neck and neck, and The New York Times just released a new poll showing we're TIED.
2️⃣ Nate Silver and Cook Political Report just shifted this race to a TOSS-UP.

subject: I have never been more furious.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Trump said a foreign government attacking Los Angeles and San Diego would be "a small price to pay."
| Team,

This is Marni von Wilpert, Democratic candidate running to flip CA-48.

Donald Trump said that Los Angeles and San Diego being attacked by a foreign government would be **_" a small price to pay."_**

I don't have words for how appalling that is.

In my view, a president who dismisses the potential destruction of American cities as collateral damage for his reckless war has no place in the Oval Office or in public service. The 1.4 million people in this city are not a small price. They are our neighbors, our coworkers, our kids' teachers, the people who make this community what it is.

Unlike Jim Desmond, I will never stand next to a president who treats them like anything less.

[Can you split a $7 donation between me and the Voter Protection Project right now to help elect someone who refuses to stand next to a man who treats our city like collateral damage?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/136223?t=6&akid=29633%2E878179%2EimT4-F) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Marni von Wilpert and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/136224?t=7&akid=29633%2E878179%2EimT4-F)

It's time to end it, and it starts by sending someone to Congress who will say so.

— Marni

Five and a half years.
That's how long we've been fighting to get a plaque installed on the West Front of the Capitol. A plaque honoring the Capitol Police and DC Police officers who held the line on January 6th. Congress passed the law. President Biden signed it. The Architect of the Capitol has refused to comply.
So Daniel Hodges and I sued.
Last Wednesday, a federal judge dismissed our lawsuit. She ruled we have no standing.
Let that sink in for a second. The officers whose names are supposed to appear on the plaque have no standing to sue over the plaque.
If we don't have standing, who does?

Wow. The first few weeks since I launched my run for U.S. Senate have been a whirlwind! I've done as many interviews, press events, and TV hits as I possibly could to spread the word about what we're trying to do here:
1\. Clean up the mess that the political class has left us in 2\. Hold our corrupt leaders who sold us out to account 3\. Retake this Minnesota Senate seat in the name of sanity
I hope that plan resonates with you.
